jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix’s Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Data, AI & Experimentation Platforms accelerate product velocity and business impact by providing cohesive, reliable foundations for data, analytics, machine learning, and experimentation. We reduce friction across the insight-to-production loop so teams can move from questions to decisions and from prototypes to shipped features quickly, with confidence, and with measurable outcomes.

We enable teams to build and scale ML-powered products end-to-end with AI platform capabilities for training, model management, evaluation, observability, developer tooling, and production inference. Our experimentation platform makes it easy to design, launch, monitor, and interpret experiments so teams can iterate faster and validate impact with statistical rigor and accountability.

Our data and analytics foundations make information usable and trustworthy: streamlined data movement (ingestion, streaming, processing), standardized online data stores for real-time serving, and analytics experiences that accelerate discovery while enforcing consistent metrics, quality, lineage, ownership, and access controls. Ultimately, we make data- and AI-driven product development faster, safer, and more dependable at scale so teams can focus on building great experiences that entertain the world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead Data Developer & Analytics Experiences within the Analytics Platform & Experiences team.

Your primary mission is to deliver a unified, AI-native experience that spans how practitioners build data assets, build and operate data agents, and orchestrate data workflows at scale. On the Data Developer side, you will own the practitioner “inner loop”; SQL and Python-first code authoring in AI-native IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, JupyterLab), Python libraries, lifecycle and CLI tooling, data quality tooling, and the developer experience for building data agents that can securely discover, query, and act on data. On the Workflow Orchestration side, you will own the end-to-end experience for defining, scheduling, executing, monitoring, and operating data workflows, including dependency management, backfills, retries, and workflow observability—making it easy for practitioners to reliably move data pipelines and agents from development to production.

Analytics engineers, data engineers, and data scientists will be your primary customers, with a focus on making it easier for them to build data assets, orchestrate reliable workflows, and develop data agents. Partnering closely with engineering, design, and data leaders, you will shape product direction and deliver impactful capabilities across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, data quality and observability, and AI-native development.

In this role, you will shape the future of Data Developer Experiences and Workflow Orchestration at Netflix by leading a high-impact product portfolio. You will operate with significant autonomy to set strategic direction, define multi-year roadmaps, and make high-leverage tradeoffs across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, reliability and observability, data quality, and AI-native development—including how practitioners build and operate data agents.

What makes this role exciting is the blend of strategic vision and hands-on leadership. You'll maintain a broad portfolio view while selectively diving deep where your expertise makes the biggest difference. Your success will be measured by enabling Netflix's growth, innovation, and competitive advantage, while delighting users with exceptional experiences that empower teams to work more efficiently and with greater satisfaction.

What You Will Do

As the Product Manager forAnalytics Experiences, you will have the following responsibilities:

  • Set Direction: Develop a compelling long-term vision and strategy for your portfolio, aligning user needs with business objectives and industry trends for the Analytics Experiences.

  • Champion Users: Build deep user understanding and empathy through regular engagement, research, and feedback loops to identify pain points and opportunities.

  • Manage Roadmap: Develop and prioritize initiatives across the portfolio, from IDE-centric inner-loop productivity to centralize Semantic layer and conversational analytics, balancing immediate needs with strategic evolution.

  • Guide Development: Partner with design and engineering to define requirements, create intuitive interfaces, and validate solutions that ensure cohesive user journeys across the platform ecosystem.

  • Support Architecture: Partner with engineering on critical architecture decisions that ensure platform sustainability, scalability, and flexibility while strategically managing technical debt.

  • Drive Adoption: Create effective rollout strategies and promote new capabilities through targeted communication, education, and roadshows, while providing comprehensive documentation, learning resources, and self-service tools that accelerate adoption and reduce support burden.

  • Drive Improvement: Define success metrics centered on user delight and productivity gains, and implement tracking to continuously improve platform capabilities through data-informed experiments.

  • Establish Governance: Develop platform standards and processes that balance flexibility with standardization and innovation with stability to maintain quality and consistency, including API design guidelines, versioning policies, and deprecation protocols.

  • Align Stakeholders: Build strategic relationships and foster cross-functional collaboration to drive alignment and create shared ownership of outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

We value candidates who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, technical depth with user empathy, and decisive leadership with collaborative partnership. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can navigate complex technical and organizational landscapes, and ultimately delivers significant impact for your users and Netflix as a whole.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following attributes and experiences:

Technical Excellence

  • Expertise: 8+ years of Technical Product Management experience (or equivalent technical role) in complex technical domains. Comfortable discussing technical design trade-offs and system quality attributes with engineering teams.

  • Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures and data developer tooling — including dbt-based transformation workflows, workflow orchestration and scheduling, and deep familiarity with the practitioner stack: IDEs and notebooks (Cursor, JupyterLab, VS Code), Python/SQL developer tooling, interactive compute environments, and data quality/observability frameworks.

  • Curiosity: Demonstrated passion for Analytics with a pulse on emerging trends. Actively seeks new perspectives and brings fresh thinking to technical challenges. Regularly uses products and observes customers to identify improvement opportunities.

Product Leadership

  • Strategic Vision: Proven track record of managing product portfolios in complex technical domains with clear vision and strategy to maximize portfolio impact. Skilled at connecting business objectives with user needs, balancing quick wins with strategic bets, and making thoughtful trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession: Deeply understands user needs through continuous engagement. Exceptional at identifying and articulating clear problem statements. Develops innovative solutions with strong product intuition and taste, thinking holistically about end-to-end user experience.

  • Business Acumen: Understands how platform investments drive business outcomes. Articulates the ROI of technical investments in business terms and connects platform capabilities to Netflix's strategic priorities. Balances technical excellence with business pragmatism.

  • Data Driven: Deeply analytical mindset that leverages quantitative and qualitative data to understand user behavior, validate assumptions, and inform product decisions. Builds a metrics-driven culture with clear success metrics to measure impact and drive continuous improvement.

  • Decisive Leadership: Makes timely decisions that provide clear direction and reduce ambiguity without analysis paralysis. Shows conviction in product opinions while remaining open to new information. Removes decision bottlenecks and shields teams from unnecessary scope creep.

Collaboration & Influence

  • First Team Player: Creates psychological safety through vulnerability and assuming best intent. Values diverse perspectives and operates with a collaborative mindset where team success trumps individual accomplishments. Skilled at giving and receiving feedback with a growth mindset.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Builds strong relationships across organizational boundaries based on mutual respect and shared goals. Navigates complex organizational dynamics to drive alignment. Adapts communication style to different audiences and contexts to maximize effectiveness.

  • Influential Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and inspire. Great at rallying teams around a vision and motivating others to action.

Execution Excellence

  • Delivery Focus: Builds reputation through consistent, high-quality delivery. Disciplined prioritization with clear timelines and accountability. Drives initiatives to completion rather than letting them linger. Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and adjusting course as needed.

  • Learning Mindset: Champions incremental learning and fast feedback loops with customers. Values progress over perfection and breaks down large initiatives into manageable increments that deliver value at each stage. Adapts quickly based on real-world user feedback.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead – Supply Chain Resources

Company: Lux Decor Collection

Lux Decor Collection is a growing multi-channel e-commerce company operating across leading global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN. We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Lead – Supply Chain Resources to oversee and optimize our end-to-end supply chain operations, ensuring product availability, cost efficiency, timely procurement, and seamless inventory movement across multiple sales channels.

Job Summary

The Lead – Supply Chain Resources will be responsible for managing the complete supply chain lifecycle, including demand planning, inventory management, sourcing, procurement, supplier coordination, logistics, and fulfillment.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical, leadership, negotiation, and operational management skills, with hands-on experience in managing supply chain operations for an e-commerce, retail, or consumer products business.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Strategy & Planning

Develop and implement effective supply chain strategies aligned with business objectives and marketplace growth.

Oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, from product sourcing and procurement to warehouse delivery and fulfillment.

Identify operational bottlenecks and implement strategies to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance productivity.

Ensure smooth coordination between supply chain, marketplace, warehouse, finance, and operations teams.

Demand Forecasting & Inventory Management

Analyze historical sales data, marketplace trends, seasonality, and promotional activities to forecast product demand.

Maintain optimal inventory levels across warehouses and fulfillment centers.

Develop replenishment plans to prevent stockouts, overstocking, and excess inventory.

Monitor inventory turnover, aging stock, sell-through rates, and stock availability.

Coordinate inventory planning for Amazon FBA, Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN.

Logistics & Fulfillment Management

Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, freight forwarding, shipment tracking, and warehouse coordination.

Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping companies, customs brokers, 3PL providers, and fulfillment centers.

Ensure timely delivery of inventory to Amazon FBA, Walmart fulfillment centers, and other relevant distribution channels.

Monitor shipping costs, lead times, and logistics performance.

Proactively resolve shipment delays, inventory discrepancies, and supply chain disruptions.

Cost Optimization & Operational Efficiency

Identify opportunities to reduce procurement, transportation, warehousing, and fulfillment costs.

Optimize landed cost per unit while maintaining product quality and supply reliability.

Develop and implement SOPs for procurement, inventory management, logistics, and supply chain operations.

Continuously improve supply chain processes through data-driven decision-making.

Team Leadership & Coordination

Lead, supervise, and develop the supply chain team to achieve operational targets.

Assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of tasks.

Establish clear KPIs and performance standards for team members.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between inventory availability, marketplace sales, and business objectives.

7. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

Prepare regular supply chain reports, dashboards, and management updates.

Monitor key performance indicators, including:

Inventory Turnover Ratio

Demand Forecast Accuracy

Stockout Rate

Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate

Procurement Cost Savings

Inventory Aging

Purchase Order Cycle Time

Logistics Cost per Unit

Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Operations Management, or a related field.

Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, inventory management, or logistics.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead or supervisory role.

Proven experience in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or multi-channel marketplace operations.

Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory planning, procurement, supplier management, and logistics.

Experience with Amazon FBA and Walmart Marketplace supply chain operations is highly preferred.

Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN fulfillment requirements will be an added advantage.

Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets; experience with ERP, WMS, or inventory management systems is preferred.

About Matter Health

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a Vice President, Market Expansion & Patient Engagement to lead two of our most important growth priorities: launching new markets and connecting attributed members to care.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end process of bringing new payer markets into operation—from contract execution through go-live and early market performance. You will also lead the enterprise strategy and execution infrastructure that converts attributed members into active patient relationships.

You will build and continuously improve our market launch toolkit, ensuring each new market benefits from a repeatable, reliable operating approach. As the leader of patient engagement strategy, you will guide the development of playbooks, outreach capabilities across channels, and field enablement tools that support member activation and care conversion at scale.

This role requires a leader who can set enterprise strategy while staying close to execution, build teams, and drive accountability across cross-functional partners. This is a remote position reporting to the SVP, Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Market Implementation & Launch

  • Own the strategy and execution of a repeatable market launch operating system, improving the approach with each new market.

  • Lead the 90-day market sprint from contract execution through the first patient visit and early market performance.

  • Translate executed payer contracts into operational requirements, workflow triggers, and readiness checklists so teams understand their responsibilities before go-live.

  • Lead pre-launch readiness assessments across Clinical, Operations, HR, Training, Technology, and Compliance.

  • Own operational sign-off on launch timing during contracting, certify readiness, and escalate recommended launch delays to the SVP, Operations when appropriate.

  • Drive staffing and credentialing timelines for each new market and serve as the internal escalation point when timelines are at risk.

  • Coordinate launch activities across Growth, Legal/Compliance, Clinical, Operations, HR, and Technology to manage dependencies and support timely execution.

  • Establish the strategy and governance for implementation tracking, including timelines, milestones, and status reporting from contract execution through go-live.

Patient Engagement & Member Activation

  • Own the enterprise strategy and execution infrastructure that connects attributed members to active patient relationships.

  • Lead the strategic development of patient engagement playbooks, outreach capabilities across channels, and tools that enable field teams.

  • Build scalable approaches that support member activation and conversion into care.

  • Coordinate with payer teams to support accurate patient attribution and enrollment.

  • Oversee attribution reconciliation to identify gaps, improve accuracy, and coordinate corrections.

Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Build alignment and accountability across teams responsible for market readiness and patient engagement.

  • Identify implementation gaps, lead root-cause analyses, and translate findings into lasting operational improvements.

  • Maintain and improve launch playbooks and standard operating procedures.

  • Balance enterprise planning with hands-on execution to support reliable launches and early market performance.

Qualifications

  • Experience leading market expansion, implementation, or operational launch initiatives within healthcare.

  • Deep understanding of value-based care and payer operations.

  • Experience translating payer contract requirements into operational workflows and launch plans.

  • A track record of scaling patient or member engagement functions.

  • Experience developing operational playbooks, governance processes, and tools that support consistent execution.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive accountability across teams with different reporting relationships.

  • Experience coordinating staffing, credentialing, compliance, technology, and operational readiness.

  • Strong strategic planning, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain closely involved in execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • New markets launch through a consistent, repeatable process with clear ownership and readiness standards.

  • Payer contract requirements are translated into actionable plans before go-live.

  • Staffing, credentialing, technology, and operational dependencies are managed proactively.

  • Leaders have clear visibility into launch milestones, risks, and early market performance.

  • Patient engagement playbooks and field tools support member activation and conversion into care at scale.

  • Attribution and enrollment gaps are identified and resolved in coordination with payer partners.

  • Lessons from each launch lead to stronger playbooks and more reliable execution.

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date.

jobs.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
Asimov gets built at scale on someone else's line. As Product Quality Engineer, you are Menlo's quality owner at our contract manufacturer, responsible for the final assembly and test of the robot from the first trial build through mass production. You make sure what comes off the CM line matches what our engineers designed, every unit, at rate.
You will own process yield, define and enforce final inspection criteria, and run the customer side of quality at the EMS partner. You will live in the phase gates, EVT, DVT, PVT, and into MP, catching the defects, drift, and process gaps that decide whether a ramp succeeds or stalls. This role sits between our design teams and the factory floor, and holds both to the standard.

What You'll Do

  • Own final assembly and test quality at the CM (Tier-1 / EMS), from trial production through mass production

  • Drive process yield: monitor first-pass yield and defect rates at each station, run the analysis, and lead the CM to close the gaps

  • Define, document, and maintain final inspection criteria, including inspection standards, limit samples, workmanship standards, and pass/fail criteria for the line

  • Own the customer inspection and acceptance process: OQC, outgoing quality gates, AQL sampling plans, and lot disposition before shipment

  • Represent Menlo through the NPI phase gates (EVT, DVT, PVT), driving build readiness, defining test coverage at final assembly and test, and signing off on quality exit criteria for each phase

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action on line failures and test escapes, using structured methods such as 8D, fishbone, and 5-whys, and verify the fix holds

  • Set up and audit the CM's process controls: FAI, in-process inspection, SPC on critical parameters, and change control on the line

  • Manage non-conformance at the CM: MRB, containment, rework and sorting decisions, and disposition of held material

  • Track and report quality metrics (yield, DPPM, defect Pareto, RTY) and drive continuous improvement reviews with the CM

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering to feed field and line failures back into design and process

What We Look For

  • 3 or more years in a product, supplier, or manufacturing quality role owning final assembly and test at a contract manufacturer or EMS partner

  • Direct experience taking a product through NPI phase gates (EVT / DVT / PVT) and into mass production

  • Strong command of yield analysis and defect reduction, and the discipline to chase a failure to its real source rather than its symptom

  • Hands-on ownership of final inspection and outgoing quality: inspection criteria, AQL sampling, limit samples, and lot acceptance

  • Fluency in core quality tools and methods: 8D, FMEA, SPC, control plans, FAI, and MRB / non-conformance handling

  • Comfort reading mechanical drawings and GD&T, electrical schematics, and test specs across a complex electromechanical product

  • Strong communication and influence skills to hold a CM accountable while keeping the ramp moving, working across engineering, manufacturing, and the supplier

  • Willingness to travel to and work on-site at manufacturing partners

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other high-reliability electromechanical products

  • Experience managing quality at CMs in the region (for example Vietnam, China, or elsewhere in Asia)

  • Familiarity with quality systems and standards such as ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, and IPC-A-610

  • Motor, actuator, or drivetrain assembly and test quality experience

  • Experience defining final assembly and test (FATP) test coverage and station-level test strategy

  • Scripting for quality data analysis and automation, for example Python or SQL

  • Experience standing up CM quality processes from near-zero at an early-stage hardware company

Why Join Menlo
You will own the quality of a humanoid robot as it moves from a handful of hand-built prototypes to real production volume, the phase where most hardware companies either learn to ship or quietly stall. You will define the inspection standards and yield discipline for a product that has to move in the real world, not pass a bench check, and you will hold both our engineers and our factory to them. On a small team, your sign-off is what stands between a design and a shippable robot.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.

Training. Left of Launch.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Q2 Holodeck™ Sales Executive

Join a talented founding team and help put an AI-enabled defense training platform into the hands of the people protecting our communities and critical infrastructure.

Position Summary

Elessar is hiring two ambitious Sales Executives to help bring Q2 Holodeck™ to government, defense, public-safety, sports, critical-infrastructure, and commercial customers. This is a hands-on sales role for someone who wants more than a narrow territory and a scripted pitch. You will learn a new and sophisticated product, build relationships with buyers, create opportunities, support live demonstrations, shape pilots, and help close the company’s first generation of customers.

You will join a small, talented team of technologists, operators, trainers, and business builders. Success will be visible. Your work will directly influence Elessar’s revenue, customer strategy, product roadmap, and growth. The role is designed for a high-energy early-career seller who is coachable, persistent, organized, comfortable opening doors, and excited by the opportunity to grow with an emerging defense technology company.

About Elessar and Q2 Holodeck™

Elessar is a defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training and decision-rehearsal platform. Q2 Holodeck™ helps security, force-protection, and first-responder personnel identify a drone, select a lawful and effective response, and report the incident before a real event occurs. The platform is built to support practical readiness across defense, homeland security, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and allied markets.

Our immediate commercial objective is straightforward: identify customers with urgent operational problems, demonstrate the platform, launch well-designed pilots, prove value, and convert successful pilots into annual subscriptions and larger deployments. The Sales Executive will be at the center of that effort.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • You will sell a differentiated product addressing a timely challenge in c-UAS preparedness that is ubiquitous and also engage in national-security and public-safety challenges.
  • You will work directly with senior leaders, technical experts, operators, and customers rather than being buried in a large sales organization.
  • You will have room to build a network, shape the sales playbook, and earn responsibility quickly.
  • Your compensation has meaningful upside: reaching the individual $1.5 million Year 1 sales goal produces target cash earnings of $135,000.
  • You will be part of the team building Elessar from early commercialization into a scalable recurring-revenue company.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (approximate % of time)

  • Prospecting and Opportunity Creation (30%). Build and maintain a disciplined list of named accounts; research buyers and funded entry points; conduct outbound outreach; use events, referrals, partners, and digital channels to secure qualified meetings.
  • Customer Engagement and Discovery (20%). Lead early conversations, uncover operational problems, identify buying authority and funding, qualify timing and fit, and translate customer priorities into a clear next step.
  • Demonstrations, Pilots, and Proposals (20%). Coordinate with technical and training teammates to prepare compelling demonstrations; help define pilot users, scenarios, success measures, pricing, conversion terms, and proposal content.
  • Pipeline and Sales Execution (15%). Maintain accurate CRM records, next actions, close dates, probability, and forecast; follow up consistently; advance opportunities through a defined sales process; and surface blockers early.
  • Closing and Expansion (10%). Help negotiate and close qualifying sales, then work with customer success to position renewals, additional seats, new scenarios, and enterprise expansion.
  • Market Learning and Team Contribution (5%). Share customer insight, competitive information, objections, and product feedback; improve messaging and sales tools; and contribute energy, ideas, and accountability to the founding team.

Key Performance Objectives

OBJECTIVE, HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED, & HORIZON

Ramp and product fluency

Deliver a credible Q2 Holodeck™ pitch and demonstration narrative; understand target users, buyer problems, pilot offer, pricing, and key objections.

Months 1

Qualified pipeline

Build a named-account pipeline with documented customer need, buyer, funding path, next action, and realistic timing.

Months 1-3

Meetings and demonstrations

Consistently create qualified customer conversations and progress appropriate prospects to demonstrations or pilot design.

Ongoing

First sales

Close early Q2 Holodeck™ customers and establish references that support follow-on growth.

Months 3-12

Year 1 sales goal

$1.5 million in qualifying individual sales under the company commission plan.

Year 1

Sales discipline

Maintain current CRM data, reliable forecasts, rapid follow-up, and clear ownership of every next step.

Ongoing

Qualifications

Required

  • High school and/or bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of software sales, education, training, military service, or relevant professional experience.
  • One to five years of sales, business development, recruiting, customer success, fundraising, account management, or another results-driven customer-facing role. Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of initiative and persuasion will be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to start conversations, build relationships, ask thoughtful questions, handle rejection, and follow through.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organization, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Comfort learning technical and operational concepts and explaining them in straightforward customer language.
  • U.S. citizenship and willingness to complete any customer-required background or security process.
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, exercises, and events.

Preferred

  • Experience or interest in defense technology, drones, counter-UAS, homeland security, emergency management, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, training, simulation, AI, or SaaS.
  • Experience selling to government, defense, public-safety, or business-to-business customers.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools, outbound prospecting, pipeline management, demos, proposals, or consultative sales.
  • Military, first-responder, athletics, entrepreneurial, campus-leadership, or other background demonstrating competitiveness, resilience, teamwork, and accountability.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Hunter mentality. Energetic about creating opportunities rather than waiting for leads.
  • Coachability. Actively seeks feedback, learns quickly, and applies the team’s expertise.
  • Customer curiosity. Asks good questions and cares about the mission problem before presenting a solution.
  • Persistence with judgment. Follows through consistently without damaging trust or forcing a poor-fit opportunity.
  • Commercial discipline. Keeps accurate records, protects time, prioritizes qualified opportunities, and knows the next action.
  • Team orientation. Works closely with technical, training, operational, proposal, contracts, and leadership colleagues.
  • Integrity. Represents current product capability accurately and does not overpromise to win a sale.
  • Executive presence. Can prepare well, communicate clearly, and earn credibility with senior customers while remaining authentic and eager to learn.

Compensation and Growth

  • Base salary. $60,000 annually.
  • Commission. 5% of qualifying Q2 Holodeck™ sales, governed by a written company commission plan that defines crediting, payment timing, adjustments, and treatment of shared or team-supported opportunities.
  • Year 1 sales goal. $1.5 million in qualifying individual sales.
  • Target cash earnings. $135,000 at the Year 1 goal, consisting of $60,000 in base salary and $75,000 in commission. Actual earnings depend on qualifying sales and the terms of the commission plan.
  • Career growth. Strong performers may earn larger accounts, greater market responsibility, leadership opportunities, and increased influence over the company’s go-to-market model as Elessar grows.

Working Conditions

  • Travel. Approximately 20-30% for demonstrations, customer meetings, exercises, and industry events.
  • Remote work. This is a remote role requiring dependable availability, disciplined communication, and proactive coordination with a distributed team.
  • Security and confidentiality. Employment is contingent on appropriate background review and execution of confidentiality, intellectual-property, and company policy documents.
  • Performance environment. This is an accountable, goal-oriented role in an early-stage company. Priorities may change as customer evidence, funding, and market opportunities develop.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Elessar, a subsidiary of Q2IMPACT™, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud-based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics-intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them. Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product area within the Warehouse Management value stream of our eCommerce portfolio. Our WMS serves third-party logistics providers, brands, and retailers whose operations depend on our software every hour of every day, receiving, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and billing, often for many clients inside a single warehouse. This is a senior individual contributor role with high expectations. You’ll own outcomes, not a backlog: deciding which problems are worth solving, validating them directly with customers, and driving delivery with Engineering through to measurable business results. The WMS business was recently acquired by Descartes, so you’ll also help shape how it connects to the rest of our portfolio; order and inventory management, shipping, and transportation.

What You’ll Do

Own Your Product Area and Its Outcomes

  • Define and communicate a focused strategy and roadmap for your product area, tied to clear business objectives and customer outcomes.
  • Be accountable for results of adoption, retention, revenue, and operational efficiency does not feature shipped.
  • Know your numbers: revenue, growth, usage, churn drivers, and where the product wins and loses against competitors.
  • Prioritize with discipline and be clear about what we will not build, and why.

Lead Discovery

  • Spend real time with customers; on calls and on warehouse floors to understand the problems behind the requests.
  • Validate problems before committing to solutions, using interviews, usage data, prototypes, and experiments.
  • Turn ambiguous, messy problems into structured, actionable plans.

Drive Execution with Engineering

  • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver complete solutions workflows, edge cases, integrations, and performance at scale.
  • Go deep enough technically to understand the architecture, APIs, and data model, and make sound tradeoffs with engineers.
  • Balance roadmap work, technical investment, and customer commitments; remove blockers and keep scope disciplined.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools daily to move faster in discovery, analysis, specs, and prototyping.
  • Identify and deliver AI-driven capabilities that create real value for warehouse operators and know where AI doesn’t belong.

Shape the Commercial Side

  • Contribute to pricing, packaging, positioning, and upsell decisions, grounded in customer value and financial impact.
  • Build the business case for investments using market insight, customer evidence, and financial models.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Professional Services on launches, enablement, and competitive positioning.
  • Stay ahead of the market – competitors, customer expectations, and emerging technology in fulfillment and logistics.

Connect the Portfolio and Lead Without Authority

  • Work with Product Managers across Descartes to identify integration and partnership opportunities so our products work as a connected suite.
  • Help bring the acquired WMS business into Descartes’ operating model without losing what made it successful.
  • Earn trust with executives and cross-functional partners through clear communication, sound judgment, and data.
  • Mentor other PMs and help raise the bar for product practice across the team.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, owning products through discovery, delivery, and iteration.
  • Experience in warehouse management, fulfillment, 3PL, order management, inventory, shipping, or logistics software strongly preferred.
  • A track record of delivering business outcomes, not just features – and you can describe them in numbers.
  • High agency: you take initiative, create momentum, and own outcomes end to end without waiting to be asked.
  • Strong, hands-on discovery skills with direct customer exposure.
  • Technically fluent and comfortable in complex, multi-system, integration-heavy environments; a technical background is a plus.
  • Commercially fluent – you understand pricing, packaging, unit economics, and how your product makes money.
  • A daily, hands-on user of AI tools, with a point of view on how AI should shape both the product and the way product teams work.
  • Clear, concise communicator who brings structure to ambiguity and adapts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Early signs of leadership – mentoring others, leading cross-functional initiatives, or influencing decisions above your level.
  • Willing to travel periodically to customer sites, warehouses, and team locations.

What We Value

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You don’t just accept the problem; you unpack it. You ask the second and third questions. You seek to understand, then act.
  • Bias for Ownership: You step into gaps, drive clarity, and take accountability for the result; not just the process.
  • Customer Empathy: You treat the customer’s problem like your own. You test assumptions and listen with the intent to solve.
  • Product Rigor: You know the difference between a roadmap and a strategy. You demand high-quality thinking and bring data to decisions.
  • Team-First: You make the people around you better. You share credit, own misses, and help others raise their game.

Why Join Us

This role offers real ownership of a product area at the core of physical warehouse operations at a moment when the portfolio is being shaped rather than maintained. Your work will be highly visible to leadership, and your ability to deliver outcomes will directly influence the growth of the business.
Location: This is a remote opportunity open to individuals who are legally entitled to work in Canada or the United States (with 10–20% travel across North America)..

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky-in-a-good way problem solvers. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

About This Role

Caylent’s Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic.

The Agentic Architect is the strategic and architectural lead on AI engagements. Paired with a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who handles hands-on implementation, you own the engagement arc: shaping AI strategy, designing operating models, mapping AI outcomes to business value, and guiding executive stakeholders through adoption. You lead the room — the FDE builds what you architect.

This is a cross-functional role. You engage across lines of business, not just engineering, connecting AI initiatives to the outcomes that matter to each part of the organization. Every engagement is anchored to Anthropic’s platform and focused on real AI adoption outcomes.

Your clients span PE portfolio companies, growth-stage software businesses, and enterprise organizations. You are the strategic face of Caylent from kickoff through handoff.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Architecture

  • Own AI engagements end-to-end as the strategic lead, from discovery through executive handoff, partnered with an FDE who drives implementation
  • Run structured discovery across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to map organizational context, AI readiness, and strategic goals across lines of business
  • Design AI operating models that define how the organization adopts, governs, and scales AI. Not just within engineering, but across the business
  • Define AI outcome maps that tie initiatives to measurable business results: efficiency gains, revenue impact, risk reduction, and time-to-value
  • Lead AI maturity assessments and architect near-term and long-term adoption roadmaps aligned to Anthropic’s platform capabilities
  • Facilitate executive workshops and enablement sessions for audiences ranging from engineering teams to C-suite leaders
  • Deliver executive presentations to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and line-of-business leaders covering current-state findings, ROI projections, and strategic recommendations
  • Direct FDE work on Claude Code tooling, prompt architecture, and workflow automation. You set the technical direction, the FDE executes

Client Relationship and Business Development

  • Identify expansion opportunities across lines of business. AI strategy work naturally surfaces adjacent needs in departments beyond the initial engagement
  • Shape follow-on scope throughout the engagement: by Week 1, you should have a working hypothesis for the next engagement; by the final on-site block, you present it
  • Build executive relationships that position Caylent as a long-term AI strategy partner, not a one-time vendor
  • Attend on-site for the final Catalyst block: readout, workshop, and executive presentation

Internal Contribution

  • Contribute reusable strategy frameworks, delivery artifacts, and methodology improvements back into the practice at engagement close
  • Lead AI strategy engagements spanning multiple teams, platforms, and business functions
  • Collaborate with FDEs to refine the architect-engineer delivery model and improve handoff patterns

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of software development or technical architecture experience across varied stacks, including hyperscaler environments
  • 3+ years in engineering leadership, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a combination
  • Demonstrated ability to engage across lines of business. You can talk to a VP of Engineering about CI/CD and a COO about operational efficiency in the same week
  • Experience designing or advising on AI operating models, technology adoption strategies, or digital transformation programs
  • Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development tools — you don’t need to configure them daily, but you need to speak the language credibly and direct an FDE’s work
  • Certified Claude Architect
  • Experience running structured stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and facilitated workshops with both technical and business audiences
  • Strong executive communication: writing and presenting to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and line-of-business leaders
  • Experience delivering professional services engagements, including scope management, deliverable ownership, and client advisory
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software development workflows

Preferred

  • Experience mapping AI initiatives to business outcomes (revenue, efficiency, risk, time-to-value) with executive-level ROI framing
  • Familiarity with PE portfolio company environments and board-level communication
  • Background in solutions architecture, platform engineering, or enterprise technology strategy
  • Experience with LLM prompt engineering, agentic AI workflow design, or AI product development
  • Direct experience with Claude Code’s extensibility model
  • Familiarity with SDLC maturity frameworks or workforce analytics (DORA, DevEx)
  • Experience designing and facilitating workshops for mixed audiences — engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders

  • Sat in the seat. You’ve led engineering teams or technology strategy inside a product company and understand the pressures executives navigate when adopting AI. Clients can tell.
  • Thinks across the business. You don’t stop at engineering. You see how AI impacts operations, product, and go-to-market — and you can have those conversations with the people who own them.
  • Knows when to slow down. You surface risks before committing to an approach. When the client’s definition of the work is wrong, you say so.
  • Closes the next engagement. The final week of a Catalyst is a conversion window. You treat it that way — and the cross-LOB relationships you’ve built give you multiple paths to expand.
  • Makes the methodology better. Every engagement teaches you something. You feed it back into the practice rather than keeping it in your head.
  • Earns trust at the executive level. You’re as comfortable presenting an AI operating model to a COO in the morning as reviewing prompt architecture with your FDE that afternoon.

  • AI-native by default: this team uses AI in how it works. Specification-First Engineering is how we move from prototype to production fast
  • Outcomes, not hours: advancement tied to delivery performance and account growth, not utilization

  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents

jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will operate, monitor, and continuously improve client cloud environments, lead the response to incidents within agreed SLAs, and drive automation that reduces operational risk. This position participates in a rotating shift and on-call schedule to provide round-the-clock coverage for Valtech's managed services clients.

Role responsibilities

• Monitor cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) using observability tooling; triage alerts and respond to incidents within defined SLAs as part of a 24x7 rotation, including nights, weekends, and holidays as scheduled.
• Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management for production issues, escalating to vendors or engineering leadership when required.
• Execute and support change requests, patching, backups, and routine maintenance following Valtech's change management and least-privilege access processes.
• Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) and CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning and reduce manual toil.
• Own and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Azure Monitor) to increase visibility and reduce mean time to detect/resolve.
• Support security operations: apply patches, respond to vulnerability findings, and follow incident escalation procedures in line with client and Valtech security policies.
• Maintain accurate runbooks, knowledge base articles, and shift handover notes to ensure smooth 24x7 continuity across teams and time zones.
• Collaborate with client stakeholders, account teams, and cross-functional Valtech engineering teams on service improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and reliability improvements (SLOs/SLIs) for managed environments.
• Participate in on-call rotation and follow escalation/paging procedures for priority incidents outside scheduled shifts, where applicable.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

• Advanced/Fluent English

• 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure support roles, ideally within a managed services or 24x7 operations environment.
• Deep, hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP); multi-cloud experience is preferred.
• Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows Server administration.
• Scripting/automation experience (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools.
• Solid experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) is expected.
• Familiarity with monitoring and incident management tooling (e.g., Datadog, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).
• Understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management practices.
• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to remain calm and methodical during high-pressure incidents.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift handovers and client-facing updates.
• Willingness and ability to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays, to support 24x7 coverage.
• High adaptability and curiosity around emerging tools
• Strong analytical judgement to assess AI outputs
• Systems thinking with the ability to understand full incident to resolution chains with AI support
• Experience with an AI-first approach to triage, RCA generation and observability insights

Nice to have qualifications

• Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional/DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect).
• Experience supporting enterprise or multi-tenant client environments in a managed services or MSP setting.
• Exposure to security frameworks and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience with IT Service Management platforms enriched by AI

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Full Time position based in Brazil, open for remote or hybrid work (São Paulo or Florianópolis)

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

jobs.description:
About Onnit:

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

JOB SUMMARY

ONNIT is doubling its launch cadence in 2027 and expanding into new categories, and we need a dedicated owner for the pipeline. In this role, you'll lead our innovation pipeline end to end, from spotting promising ingredients to launching products customers love. You'll bridge R&D and Brand. You don't need to be a scientist, but you do need to be fluent in both the evidence behind an ingredient and the commercial case for a product.

  • Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer, in close partnership with the Chief Operating Officer
  • Team: Individual contributor leading cross-functional project teams
  • Scope: Supplements and functional nutrition: new ingredients, formats, flavors, categories, and hero-product renovations
  • Location: Remote (U.S.); NYC, LA, or Austin preferred. Travel up to 25%

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Discover what's next

  • Own the ingredient opportunity map. Prioritize the ingredients most likely to shape Total Human optimization, starting with our core need states (cognition and focus, energy, sleep and stress, recovery) and extending to adjacent ones (gut health, hormonal health, longevity).
  • Separate signal from hype. Track emerging clinical research, branded and patented ingredients, and new delivery technologies, and run ONNIT's trend radar with clear recommendations for leadership each quarter.

Define where we play next

  • Expand our format and flavor range. Evaluate new form factors, from gummies, chews, and stick packs to ready-to-drink and functional foods, and set taste targets with R&D and flavor-house partners, ensuring daily products are ones people look forward to.
  • Make the case for new categories. Recommend which categories ONNIT enters as part of our 2027 expansion, and in what order, informed by consumer evidence and regular competitive teardowns.

Build on credible evidence

  • Lead evidence reviews. Assess dose, delivery, bioavailability, safety, and study quality, and hold the line on clinically meaningful doses with formulators and scientific advisors.
  • Build compliance in from day one. Partner with Regulatory and Legal on regulatory pathway (including New Dietary Ingredient requirements), claims and substantiation, and third-party certifications like NSF Certified for Sport where they matter to our athletes.
  • Turn science into a story people trust. Create a science brief for every launch covering approved claims, the evidence behind them, and a plain-language story.

Own the roadmap and drive concepts to launch

  • Build a balanced roadmap. Turn brand strategy into a rolling 12–18-month roadmap that balances line extensions and hero-product renovations with bigger bets, supporting our goal to double launch cadence in 2027.
  • Run a right-sized stage-gate. Quick-turn gates for extensions and renovations, a fuller path for new ingredients, formats, categories, and monthly pipeline reporting that recommends stopping projects early when the case doesn't hold.
  • Lead cross-functional launch teams. Drive approved concepts to launch with R&D, Operations, Quality and Procurement, owning COGS, margin, and timeline targets and making sure formula, packaging, labeling, and supply are ready ahead of each channel's timeline, including retail sell-in windows.

Prove the case and co-lead go-to-market

  • Stay with every launch past the handoff. Co-lead go-to-market with Brand on positioning, naming and the launch story; equip sales, retail partners, and athletes to talk about each product credibly, and track performance at 30, 60, and 90 days.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in CPG innovation, NPD or R&D, with multiple products taken from concept to launch
  • Experience in supplements, functional or sports nutrition, or a closely related category
  • Strong scientific literacy. You can read a clinical study, judge its quality, and explain what it does and doesn't prove, including on safety (a degree in nutrition, food science, biology, chemistry, or a related field is a plus, not required)
  • Working knowledge of how supplements are made and regulated, including formulation, cGMP, DSHEA, claims substantiation, and NDI requirements
  • A track record of launching quickly while protecting quality, safety, and claims integrity
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, aligning cross-functional partners and leadership around a clear recommendation
  • Commercial judgment. You can build a business case and co-lead a launch, and you care whether a product sells, not just whether it's interesting

Nice to have: Experience in nootropics, performance, recovery, sleep, or longevity; launches across TTS, DTC, Amazon, and retail; ready-to-drink or functional food experience; a fast-moving or early-stage environment.

Onnit takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. This position is bonus eligible and employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays. Any coverages for health insurance will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

Platform Database Engineer

Location: Colombia – Remote

About the Role

The Platform Database Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, administering, and optimizing MongoDB (Atlas and on‑premise) within a large-scale, cloud-based enterprise ecosystem. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE principles to ensure performance, reliability, scalability, and automation across mission‑critical data platforms.

  • Design and enforce resiliency and disaster recovery strategies, including backup, restore, and multi‑region failover.
  • Optimize database performance and query execution to support application development teams throughout all SDLC phases.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure‑as‑code solutions (Terraform, GitOps) for database provisioning and automation.
  • Implement and refine observability and monitoring solutions using Dynatrace, CloudWatch, and MongoDB native telemetry.
  • Manage access control, auditing, and encryption to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with application, DevOps, and platform teams to continuously improve reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
  • Lead incident response for database‑related issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventative measures.
  • Mentor and guide technical teams, contributing to documentation, standards, and design reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: About This RoleLocation: Remote Commitment: Part-time volunteer, pro bono (unpaid) role Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10–15 hours per week; minimum 3-month commitment Professional VolunteeringProfessional volunteering is skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role.
jobs.description:
About This Role

Location: Remote

Commitment: Part-time volunteer, pro bono (unpaid) role

Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10–15 hours per week; minimum 3-month commitment

Professional Volunteering

Professional volunteering is skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. Expectations include consistent weekly availability, timely communication, ownership and follow-through on assigned work, participation in team meetings, and alignment with our values and processes.

About Solution Community

Solution Community is an international 501(c)(3) nonprofit pioneering a social platform built to turn compassion into action. With volunteers from over 80 countries and experience drawn from companies like Apple, Google, Meta, Netflix, and Microsoft, we connect nonprofits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers to solve real social problems.

Our Mission

To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems.

Our Vision

A world where every person has the opportunity to thrive — united by collaboration, compassion, and action.

Summary of Role

As Head of Sales, you will build and lead Solution Community's earned-revenue engine. This is not a donor-fundraising role — you will create sustainable, fee-for-service income for the organization. Your primary mandate is to launch and scale our advisory offering, which connects businesses and nonprofits with our vetted network of expert volunteers, and to develop paid partnerships that fund our mission. You will own the strategy, build the pipeline, close the first deals yourself, and lead a team of five Senior Sales Managers as the function grows.

What Will You Do?

  • Own and execute Solution Community's earned-revenue strategy — advisory/consulting engagements, paid B2B partnerships, and sponsorship packages that deliver real value to the buyer.

  • Stand up our consulting network from zero: define the offer, pricing, and revenue-share model that pays the expert volunteer and funds the organization.

  • Build a repeatable outbound sales motion — cold outreach, discovery, proposal, and close — using lean, low-cost tools.

  • Recruit, lead, and mentor a team of five Senior Sales Managers; set targets, run the pipeline, and hold the team to measurable revenue outcomes.

  • Build and manage relationships with businesses, nonprofits, and partners who buy or fund our services.

  • Track pipeline, conversion, and booked revenue; report results and forecasts to leadership.

  • Partner with Legal and Finance to keep earned-revenue activity compliant with our nonprofit status.

Who Are We Looking For?

  • 8–10+ years in sales, business development, or partnerships, with a proven record of closing revenue and hitting targets.

  • Experience building a sales function or offering from scratch — not just running an existing playbook.

  • Strong at outbound: comfortable owning cold pipeline, not waiting on inbound or warm networks.

  • Skilled at leading and coaching a distributed team.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills.

  • Comfortable operating lean — no big tooling budget, high resourcefulness.

  • Committed to our mission, reliable, and accountable.

What We Offer

  • Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies.

  • Meaningful impact on global causes and communities.

  • A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 80+ countries.

  • A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration.

  • Flexible work-life with full autonomy.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term.

jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products across the organization. Beyond technical delivery, we're looking for someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data — someone who can apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, enabling high-quality, curated datasets while ensuring robust data governance, security, and observability across the data ecosystem. You will also play a key role in supporting AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

This role can be delivered on either of our two core cloud ecosystems — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — and you'll be staffed on projects that match your strongest platform. You don't need experience in both. Additional experience across Snowflake or GCP is considered a strong plus.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams to ensure the data foundation supports production-grade, decision-oriented AI systems.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on whichever of our two core ecosystems matches your strengths — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — with exposure to other environments (Snowflake, GCP) considered a plus. This includes developing reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using technologies such as Spark and Delta Lake, and building ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for both structured and unstructured data.

You will implement modern data architectures including lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold) within Databricks or Fabric, ensuring systems are reusable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise needs.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

Deliver high-quality datasets that support analytics, machine learning, causal modeling, and optimization systems. You will enable data pipelines for GenAI use cases (including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and vector-based data flows), as well as agent-based architectures and intelligent workflows, ensuring that data is model-ready and production-grade — leveraging Databricks' MLflow and Unity Catalog, or the equivalent Azure/Fabric and Azure ML tooling, depending on the platform you work in.

Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation

Design scalable logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring consistency across domains. Orchestrate workflows using tools such as Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or equivalents, with strong focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability of end-to-end pipelines.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

Apply modern architecture patterns including event-driven and streaming architectures, and ensure adherence to best practices in data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC), using tools such as Unity Catalog and AWS Lake Formation, or Microsoft Purview, depending on the platform in use.

Establish strong data observability, including monitoring of data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence, ensuring systems remain trustworthy and production-ready.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

Enable data serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) to support downstream systems, including ML and AI platforms. Continuously monitor and optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across our core cloud ecosystems.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

Bring genuine curiosity to every engagement — ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders are asking for, but why. Apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and refine business requirements, surfacing gaps or better alternatives where they exist rather than simply executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data solutions. Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices across the data and AI ecosystem.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake, and strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Proven experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and production-grade data platforms, with solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance principles.

Cloud & Platforms (Key Requirement) — choose your track:

  • Track A: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with AWS data services (e.g., S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda) and the Databricks Lakehouse Platform
  • Track B: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure / Fabric (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse, Azure Databricks)

You only need deep expertise in one track — we treat both as equally weighted core platforms and will align you to projects based on where your experience is strongest. Familiarity with other modern data platforms such as Snowflake or GCP is a plus but not required.

Architecture & Systems Thinking

Experience with lakehouse architectures and distributed data systems, and strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance considerations in data pipelines.

Mindset

Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills focused on scalability and reliability, and a collaborative approach to working in cross-functional teams. Comfortable applying common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and challenge business requirements rather than taking them at face value. Experience in Agile or consulting environments is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

Deep expertise in both tracks — AWS and Azure/Fabric, across Databricks and native Fabric tooling — is a strong plus, though not required, as is experience with GenAI and AI data systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation), CI/CD for data pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Additional exposure to streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), Spark optimization, or advanced analytics and ML workloads (including causal or experimentation platforms) is valuable. Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms is also beneficial.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a position based in Portugal.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
