Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance (Connected Products) 

Location: United States (Remote) 

Business Unit: Cyber Security  

 

Imagine your customer is a leading industrial component manufacturer, specializing in top-notch manufacturing and transportation equipment. You have ambitious goals: to streamline processes, ensure top-quality security for your client’s products, and assure cybersecurity. That’s where you come in.  Our analysis will bridge any gaps across design, engineering, SDLC and technical control testing, and regulatory readiness, helping clients meet requirements such as the EU CRA, IEC 62443, and other product security standards.

With our expertise in testing, inspection and independent security validation services, you will assist your client in raising their cyber resilience like never before. Your success story? It's written in client readiness and satisfaction, secure products, and audit-defensible evidence. Now also imagine the same story, but for products such as vehicles, medical devices, ships, IoT products, network equipment, software products, etc. Doesn’t it sound like an exciting mission?  

 

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity provides cybersecurity services covering people, organization,  technology, of products, and connected ecosystems. 

 

We have reputable clients and they request expertise to increase their level of cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.

Role Overview 

The Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance is a doer role responsible for delivering product security and compliance engagements while supporting the growth of Bureau Veritas’ Cyber Security services across North America. 

This role focuses on helping clients translate regulatory requirements for North American customers, into practical, engineering-aligned product security controls, harmonized with frameworks across sectors with current compliance standards and frameworks 

The individual will work across industrial, IoT, embedded, software, medical technology, transportation, and cloud-connected product environments, supporting execution of engagements, development of repeatable offerings, and business development activities. 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Client Engagement Delivery 

  • Execute and support delivery of product security consulting engagements, including: 
    • Product security maturity assessments 
    • CRA, IEC 62443, IoT security, automotive, medical device,- standards and regulatory readiness and gap assessments 
    • Threat modeling, abuse case analysis, and product risk assessments 
    • Secure architecture review and security requirement definition for connected products 
    • Secure product development lifecycle (PDL/SDL) and technical product technical requirements implementation support 
    • Product security, maturity modelling, scoring, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps 
  • Translate regulatory and standard requirements into engineering actions, test cases, control frameworks, and evidence expectations 
  • Produce structured, audit-defensible deliverables aligned to BV methodologies 

2. Regulatory Harmonization & Product Security Compliance 

  • Apply and operationalize product cybersecurity regulatory frameworks across engagements 
  • Support harmonization and implementation across product security regulations and standards, including: 
  • Regulatory Standards and Frameworks: 
    • EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)  
    • NIS2 Directive 
    • Relevant North American IoT security initiatives (e.g., NIST, FCC, and related connected-device security expectations) 
  • Secure Development Lifecycle & Process Standards: 
    • IEC 62443-4-1 
    • NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
    • OWASP SAMM 
    • ISO/IEC 27034  and secure software engineering practices 
  • Technical Security Requirements & Baselines: 
    • EU Common Criteria 
    • IEC 62443-4-2 
    • ETSI EN 303 645 (IoT security) 
    • NIST IoT cybersecurity guidance 
    • OWASP ASVS and API security frameworks 
  • Software Supply Chain & SBOM: 
    • SBOM standards and formats (SPDX, Cyclone-DX) 
    • NIST supply chain risk management guidance 
  • Sector-Specific Frameworks (as applicable): 
    • ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155/R156 (automotive) 
    • FDA and MDCG cybersecurity guidance (medical devices) 
    • ISO 14971 (medical risk management) 
  • Develop and use: 
    • Control mappings, and CRA/IEC/sector-specific requirement crosswalks 
    • Evidence matrices, assessment checklists, and regulatory traceability models 
    • Compliance scoring models, maturity models, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps 
    • Help clients move from regulatory interpretation → implementation → verification → readiness 

3. Product Security Engineering & Architecture Support 

  • Support clients in securing connected product architectures, including: 
    • Embedded systems and firmware, device operating systems, and product interfaces 
    • Industrial and IoT devices, network equipment, and operational technology components 
    • Software applications, APIs, and web management interfaces 
    • Cloud-connected product backends, and supporting infrastructure 
  • Contribute to: 
    • Threat models 
    • Security architecture definitions 
    • Identity, communication, and data protection strategies 
  • Assist in defining aligned technical product security requirements and validation criteria mapped to EU CC, CRA, IEC 62443, OWASP, NIST, ETSI, and sector-specific expectations 

4. Security Verification & Validation Support 

  • Contribute to product and system-level security validation activities, 
  • Support development of test cases, validation frameworks and evidence packages aligned to regulatory and standard requirements 
  • Help structure outputs into certification and regulations ready evidence packages 

5. Business Development (Seller-Doer Expectation) 

  • Support growth of product security, and regulatory compliance  services through: 
    • Client discussions, technical solutioning and discovery workshops 
    • Proposal development and response support 
    • Participation in discovery workshops and scoping sessions 
  • Help position BV as a trusted partner for product security, CRA readiness, and connected-product assurance 
  • Contribute to service offering development and reusable artifacts 

6. Capability Development & Team Contribution 

  • Contribute to building repeatable product security, and compliance methodologies and templates 
  • Support development of: 
    • Regulatory aligned frameworks 
    • Product security assessment models 
    • Testing and validation structures 
  • Mentor junior consultants and support team knowledge development 
  • Collaborate with global BV teams and technical specialists 

Required Experience 

Core Experience 

  • 6–10 years of experience in cybersecurity with exposure to product security, industrial systems, embedded systems, or connected devices 
  • Experience working in consulting or client-facing delivery roles 
  • Hands-on involvement in security assessments, risk analysis, vulnerability management, or architecture engagements 

Technical Competencies

  • Understanding of: 
    • Threat modeling and risk assessment methodologies 
    • Secure development lifecycle (SDL) concepts 
    • Product and system security architecture 
    • Software supply chain security (SBOM, SCA) 
  • Knowledge of various laws and regulations related to cyber product security, as well as the current developments in this area.  
  • Exposure to security testing techniques across device, firmware, application, hardware, or system layers is a strong plus 

Consulting & Personal Attributes 

  • Strong structured problem-solving, evidence review, and documentation skills 
  • Ability to balance technical depth with client communication, and engineering practicality 
  • Results-oriented with a seller-doer mindset, and ability to support business development 
  • Comfortable working across multiple industries, product types, and stakeholder groups 
  • Willingness to travel for onsite engagements as needed 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience delivering IEC 62443, IoT security, automotive cybersecurity, medical-device cybersecurity,
  • Experience in technical operations of areas such as SBOM, PSIRT, standards and regulatory readiness, 
  • Experience creating control mappings, evidence matrices, requirement crosswalks, assessment checklists, report templates, or regulatory-readiness frameworks 
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 certificates, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent practical experience are helpful but not mandatory 

WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM US?  

We are an organization with a strong focus on technical cybersecurity, delivering high-quality technical services in the field of digital security. You will be part of a team of motivated international specialists, where knowledge exchange is highly valued.  

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we provide an environment for you to develop your talents and stimulate your professional growth. Together, we work to safeguard the security and integrity of valuable data while facing the challenges of the ever-evolving digital world. Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity is a fast-growing company with ambitious goals. You will have the opportunity to grow along with us and shape your career allowing you to become an expert in your field.  

In terms of content, we offer you a diverse portfolio of exciting clients and projects. We are part of Bureau Veritas, which means that international opportunities are expanding, both for project work and for advancing your career.

jobs.excerpt: Por que a Valtech?  Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo.
jobs.description:
Por que a Valtech? Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreiras internacionais e a chance de moldar o futuro das experiências.

A oportunidade

Na Valtech, você encontra um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto significativo e crescimento profissional.
Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho ajudará a transformar indústrias.

Nós temos orgulho em anunciar:

  • O trabalho que fazemos e a inovação que fomentamos
  • Nossos valores: Compartilhar, Cuidar e Ousar
  • Um ambiente de trabalho que fomenta a criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nossa estrutura global e sem fronteiras permite uma colaboração perfeita

A vaga

Como Strategy Consultant Pleno você fará parte do time de Estratégia da área de CRM & Marketing Automation.

Sua missão será apoiar clientes e equipes técnicas no planejamento e desenho de campanhas e jornadas, trazendo uma perspectiva de marketing e estratégia de negócios para os projetos de automação.

Você vai se destacar nesta função se for:

  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções
  • Colaborativo, que valoriza trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento
  • Motivado pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados
  • Familiarizado com metodologias Ágeis e consultoria (um diferencial)


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com clientes e equipes técnicas nos projetos de CRM & Marketing Automation, com foco em estratégia e performance.
  • Pesquisar benchmarks, realizar brainstormings e desenvolver conceitos e storytelling para campanhas e jornadas.
  • Desenhar estratégias de campanhas e jornadas no Miro, incluindo fluxos e detalhes de documentação, como objetivos principais e segmentação de público.
  • Elaborar briefings para orientar as equipes criativas e revisar textos, layouts e demais materiais de campanha quando estiverem prontos, garantindo que estejam alinhados à estratégia proposta.
  • Analisar performance e boas práticas das jornadas atualmente ativas, gerando insights e propondo otimizações de estratégia, testes A/B e próximos passos.
  • Conduzir sessões de discovery, consultoria e brainstorming com clientes para compreender seus objetivos e necessidades de negócio de curto e longo prazo, além do comportamento e ciclo de vida de seus usuários.
  • Apoiar a criação, o planejamento e a priorização de roadmaps.
  • Apoiar clientes e equipes de desenvolvimento nos processos de implementação, garantindo que a entrega final atenda aos requisitos de estratégia e performance.
  • Apoiar o(a) coordenador(a) de estratégia e as equipes de delivery na criação e atualização de processos de workflow, documentações, templates de briefing, apresentações comerciais e outros materiais relacionados aos projetos de Estratégia de CRM.
  • Apoiar o onboarding e atuar como mentor(a) de estagiários, trainees e analistas juniores de estratégia, compartilhando boas práticas da área.
  • Apoiar as equipes de gestão em atividades comerciais e de parceria, contribuindo com trabalhos estratégicos em cases e apresentações.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação, preferencialmente em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Design ou áreas relacionadas; ou 6+ anos de experiência em posições de marketing.
  • 4+ anos de experiência em projetos de marketing, planejamento e/ou estratégia.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em projetos de CRM Marketing, incluindo automação e/ou campanhas pontuais.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ferramentas de automação similares.
  • Experiência com e-mail, SMS, push notification e/ou WhatsApp.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Visão de negócios e marketing holística, além de excelentes habilidades de escuta.
  • Capacidade de interpretar necessidades implícitas durante reuniões, identificar as principais dores e necessidades reais do cliente e propor estratégias concretas para solucioná-las.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado.
  • Espanhol avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência monitorando e analisando dados do Google Analytics, dashboards do Datorama, PowerBI ou Data Studio, e criando slides para apresentações de relatórios.
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência em outras áreas e canais de marketing digital (por exemplo: conteúdo, mídia social, mídia paga, site, blogs, produtos digitais, etc.)
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência configurando e implementando campanhas de CRM ou Inbound Marketing, HTML, SQL básico ou qualquer outra etapa técnica do processo de automação.
  • Experiência trabalhando em projetos digitais de grandes empresas envolvendo agências ou consultorias (como parte da equipe da agência ou da empresa cliente).

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.

Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.

Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.

Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner. 

Os benefícios

Esta é uma posição em período integral, com base no Brasil.

Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo, oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade, com opções de trabalho remoto e híbrido (dependendo do país);
  • Desenvolvimento de carreira, com oportunidades de mobilidade internacional e programas de desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento, com acesso a ferramentas de ponta, treinamentos e especialistas do setor.

Nossos benefícios são adaptados a cada localidade. Seu Talent Partner (parceiro de recrutamento) fornecerá todos os detalhes durante o processo seletivo.


Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

jobs.description:
About Onnit:

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

Why this role, why now

Onnit is reinvigorating our content strategy and how people will see it. We're looking for a Senior Content Director to make Onnit the most watched, most shared, most recognizable brand in performance and wellness, without a Hollywood budget.

Onnit was built on a simple idea: train the total human, body and mind. That idea earned us a loyal community of athletes, fighters, lifters and everyday high performers, and a product line people swear by, from Alpha BRAIN to our kettlebells and steel maces.

As part of Unilever's Wellbeing Collective, we have the backing to go big. We're choosing to move like a startup.

We're writing Onnit's next chapter, and we want a content leader who sees that as the opportunity of a career. You'll define how Onnit looks, sounds and shows up everywhere: on a TikTok, a product page, a YouTube series, the side of a tub.

The role

The Senior Content Director owns Onnit's content strategy and output across every channel, and builds the in-house engine that produces it. This is a leadership role reporting to the CMO.

You'll set the creative direction, build a lean, high-velocity content operation, and turn our athletes, partners and customers into the stories that drive the brand.

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller and operator: someone who can write the brief in the morning, shoot it on a phone at lunch, and read the retention curve by dinner.

  • Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer
  • Scope: Social, YouTube, Onnit.com, email/CRM creative, Amazon and retail content, packaging, and new formats (podcast, series)
  • Team: A small, scrappy in-house team plus a bench of freelancers, creators and partners you'll shape and grow
  • Location: Remote, with a preference for Los Angeles, New York or Austin

What You'll Own

1. Content strategy across every channel

  • Build and run one content strategy that spans social (TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook), YouTube, Onnit.com, email/SMS, Amazon, retail and packaging.
  • Decide what each channel is for, what we post, how often, and how pieces flow from one platform to the next.
  • Turn brand and business priorities (launches, seasonal moments, retail resets, promotions) into a content calendar that ships on time.
  • Own the content metrics: reach, engagement, watch time, follower growth, and the content's contribution to traffic and conversion.

2. An ownable Onnit look and feel

  • Define the visual and verbal identity of Onnit content so a post is recognizably ours within the first second, with or without a logo.
  • Create the playbook: tone of voice, formats, editing style, typography, color, sound, and the do's and don'ts that keep everyone on-brand.
  • Make sure the same brand shows up on a 7-second Reel, a YouTube episode, a PDP and a package on shelf.

3. A lean, in-house content engine

  • Build a content operation that produces a high volume of quality work without a big team, a studio or expensive equipment.
  • Favor speed and iteration over polish: phone-first shoots, rapid edits, reusable templates, and one idea cut into many pieces.
  • Set up the workflows, tools (including AI-assisted editing and production) and freelancer bench that let a small team punch far above its weight.
  • Ship in days, not months. No months of storyboarding, no five-figure photo shoots for a single post.

4. Algorithm-obsessed distribution

  • Know how each platform's algorithm rewards content right now, and adjust as it changes.
  • Engineer for performance: hooks, retention, pacing, captions, thumbnails, posting cadence, trends and sounds.
  • Own a real-time feedback loop: daily performance reads, a weekly content review, and a living scorecard by platform, format and talent. Double down on winners within days, kill what doesn't work, and feed every lesson straight back into the strategy.
  • Use social listening and comment sections as a source of ideas, not just a metric.

5. Athletes, talent and creators

  • Partner with Onnit athletes, ambassadors and personalities (from elite athletes and fighters to coaches, creators and everyday customers) to tell their stories in a way that feels real, not scripted.
  • Help shape who we partner with, and get the most content value out of every relationship.
  • Write clear, smart briefs for creators and influencers that protect the brand and leave room for the creator's voice.
  • Work with the social and influencer leadto turn creator content into paid, organic and on-site assets.

6. Community and fandom

  • Use content to turn customers into a community and a community into fans.
  • Build recurring formats our audience shows up for: training series, challenges, education, behind-the-scenes, member and customer stories.
  • Work with the community and events team so live moments become content, and content drives people to live moments.

7. New formats: podcast, series and beyond

  • Develop and launch Onnit's own shows: a podcast, YouTube series, and other longform or episodic formats.
  • Orchestrate the whole thing: concept, talent, production model, distribution and clipping strategy.
  • Treat long-form as the engine that feeds short-form, and short-form as the funnel back to long-form.

Who You'll Work With

Social & influencer lead: Co-own the creator program, briefs, and the flow of creator content into owned and paid channels

Community & events: Turn events, challenges and member moments into content, and content into turnout

Growth / performance marketing: Supply and iterate creative for paid social and search; learn from what converts

DTC (Onnit.com): Bring the brand to life on the site: PDPs, landing pages, email and SMS creative

Amazon: Elevate listings, A+ content, brand store and video to lift conversion

Retail: Shelf-ready assets, packaging content and retailer marketing

Product & innovation: Tell the story behind new products from concept to launch

CMO and leadership team: Set direction, report on impact, and be a voice for the brand

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 12–15+ years in content, creative or brand storytelling, with at least 5 years leading content strategy and people for a consumer brand, media company or creator-led business.
  • A portfolio that proves you can build an audience: channels you grew, formats you invented, content that moved real numbers.
  • Deep, current fluency in platform algorithms across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and the instinct to change course when they shift.
  • A builder'strack record: you've stood up a lean, in-house content function and made it produce at volume.
  • Hands-on craft. You can write, direct, and give sharp edit notes, and you're not above picking up the phone and shooting it yourself.
  • Experience working with athletes, talent or creators, including writing briefs and managing those relationships.
  • Modern storytelling instincts: you know a great story has to earn attention in the first two seconds and still mean something at the end.
  • A relentless analytical mindset. You live in the numbers daily, not monthly: you always know what's working, what isn't and why. You turn those reads into changes in real time, shifting formats, hooks, talent, cadence and spend within days, not quarters. To you, the content strategy is a living system that gets smarter every week.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to rally many teams around one brand.

Big pluses

  • Sports, fitness or an adjacent category (outdoor, combat sports, endurance, athleisure, gaming, wellness media).
  • Supplements, beauty or wellness experience: a huge plus. You understand how to tell product stories credibly in a regulated category (claims, substantiation, FTC disclosures).
  • You've launched or produced a podcast or YouTube series.
  • Experience creating content for Amazon and retail, not just social.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: You've audited every channel, shipped quick wins, raised posting cadence, and sent out the first new creator briefs.
  • First 60 days: The content strategy and Onnit look-and-feel playbook are set. The inhouse engine ships daily across core platforms, and the performance scorecard and weekly review are running.
  • First 90 days: Engagement, watch time and follower growth are measurably up. Athlete stories and creator content run on a steady rhythm, and the first recurring community series is live.
  • First 6 months: Onnit content is instantly recognizable, the engine runs at high volume on a lean budget, and a podcast or YouTube series has launched.

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Would rather ship ten ideas this week than perfect one this quarter.
  • Get energy from building something, not maintaining it.
  • Check the comments before you check your email.
  • Believe the best brands today behave like media companies.
  • Want the freedom, and the accountability, that come with helping lead a brand's comeback.

Onnit takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. This position is bonus eligible and employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays. Any coverages for health insurance will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Basic Life Insurance
  • Immediate 401(k) eligibility with company matching
  • Unlimited vacation
  • Paid holidays
  • Flexible workplace policy
  • $100/month flexible benefit stipend
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Fringe benefits include in-office meals, product credits and discounts, lifestyle spending account, family planning, online learning, fitness stipend, among many others

jobs.title: Jr. AI Native Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The opportunityAt Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth.
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

Why Valtech?

At Valtech, we are transforming how people experience the world through technology. Our culture is built around a mindset to make, learn and grow, bringing together technology, creativity and experience to solve meaningful business challenges. [valtech.com]
AI is rapidly changing what it means to build software, and we want people who are excited to be part of that change.
We are looking for an AI Native Engineer who has spent the last few years building strong software engineering foundations while actively exploring what's possible with AI. You are someone who didn't wait for AI to become part of your job description. You started experimenting, building, breaking things and learning.
You may have built an agent because you wanted to understand how agents actually work. You may have experimented with several models to understand their strengths and limitations. Maybe you've created a RAG application, automated part of your development workflow, contributed to an AI project, or simply spent countless hours turning new ideas into working prototypes.

That curiosity matters to us.

If you're an engineer who sees the emergence of AI as an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how software is built, we'd like to meet you.

The role

As an AI Native Engineer, you'll work with multidisciplinary teams to design, prototype and build intelligent digital products and experiences.
You'll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI capabilities, working across large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, APIs, cloud platforms and emerging development tools.
Importantly, you'll help us discover what's next.
The AI landscape is moving quickly. We don't expect you to have all the answers. We expect you to be excited about finding them.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship AI-native applications and experiences for real-world use cases.
  • Build applications using large language models, generative AI APIs and agentic architectures.
  • Develop high-quality software using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or comparable modern languages.
  • Work with models and platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and open-source models.
  • Build RAG and knowledge-retrieval solutions using embeddings, semantic search, vector databases and enterprise data.
  • Experiment with AI agents, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration and multi-step workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, existing platforms and enterprise systems.
  • Rapidly prototype new ideas, test assumptions and turn promising experiments into scalable solutions.
  • Build approaches for evaluating and testing AI systems, considering quality, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to explore new ways of designing, developing, testing and maintaining software.
  • Apply sound engineering practices around security, privacy, responsible AI, observability and human oversight.
  • Share what you're learning and contribute to the evolving AI engineering practices across Valtech.

What we're looking for

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering or application development experience.
  • Strong programming experience with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or another modern programming language.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including application architecture, APIs, testing, debugging, version control and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience building with generative AI, whether through client work, production applications, prototypes, internal innovation, hackathons, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
  • Practical experience working with LLMs and model APIs, including prompting, context management, structured outputs and model selection.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, semantic search or vector databases.
  • Exposure to agents, function/tool calling or AI workflow orchestration.
  • Experience connecting applications to APIs, data sources, databases and cloud services.
  • An understanding that building a great AI demo and building a dependable AI product are two very different challenges.
  • Most importantly, a demonstrated habit of exploring emerging technology and turning your curiosity into something tangible.

We'd love it if you've...

We don't expect you to check every box. You might have:
  • Built your own AI application, agent, copilot or developer tool.
  • Experimented with multiple models and learned where each performs well, and where it doesn't.
  • Built RAG solutions using real-world or enterprise data.
  • Explored agentic architectures, tool use or multi-agent workflows.
  • Worked with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or LlamaIndex.
  • Used technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or Weaviate.
  • Built applications on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Used tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Created evaluations or testing approaches for AI outputs.
  • Participated in AI hackathons, internal innovation initiatives or open-source communities.
  • Seen a newly released AI capability and thought,“I need to try that.”
Specific frameworks will come and go. We're more interested in how you learn, what you've built and what you've discovered along the way.

You are

A builder.
You don't just read about AI. You build with it. You're comfortable moving from an idea to a prototype and learning through experimentation.
An explorer.
New models, multimodal experiences, agents, reasoning systems and AI development tools genuinely interest you. You're energized by a technology landscape where the playbook is still being written.
An engineer.
You care about what happens after the demo. Reliability, maintainability, architecture, security and testing matter to you.
A pragmatic thinker.
You understand that AI isn't the answer to every problem. You're interested in finding where it creates genuine value, not adding AI for AI's sake.
A learner.
You won't know every new model, framework or technique. That's okay. What matters is being able to say: “I haven't worked with that yet. Let's figure it out.”

What you can expect from us

You'll join an environment where experimentation and continuous learning are part of how we work. You'll collaborate with people across engineering, data, experience and strategy, and have opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to meaningful client and business challenges.
Valtech currently recruits across AI-focused roles alongside engineering, cloud, data and digital experience disciplines, reinforcing that AI is being embedded within the broader technology organization rather than existing solely as a standalone specialty.
You'll have room to make, learn and grow, while helping shape what AI-native engineering means at Valtech.

jobs.title: Freelance Business Analyst (Data)
jobs.excerpt: This is a freelance position: Expected project duration is 6 months, starting as soon as possible, full-time.
jobs.description:
This is a freelance position: Expected project duration is 6 months, starting as soon as possible, full-time.

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for a Business Analyst (Data) to join the delivery squad building a Loyalty Revenue Accounting solution on Databricks. The solution takes data from the Loyalty platform and other source systems and produces the accounting outputs Finance needs, including journals and reports. You will define the data requirements, business logic and mapping rules that the data engineers build from, and keep them current as requirements evolve.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, finance and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Define and document data requirements for a data platform solution, working closely with Product Teams from Finance, Loyalty and architecture stakeholders
  • Define business logic in precise, testable terms, including calculations, allocations and rules for how transactions are treated
  • Produce source-to-target mapping specifications, covering field-level mappings, transformations and reference data
  • Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira, with enough detail for engineers to build from and testers to validate against
  • Maintain traceability from business need through requirements to mappings and design, and keep documentation up to date as requirements change
  • Identify gaps, edge cases and anomalies early, and raise them with options and impact
  • Work with the product manager, data engineers, architects and QE through delivery, answering questions and validating what is built against the requirements
  • Support walkthroughs and sign-off with Finance and other business stakeholders

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst on data-focused projects, such as data platforms, data warehouses or data migration – a must
  • Experience defining both business logic and data mapping logic, not only high-level process requirements – a must
  • Strong written requirements skills, including writing and managing requirements in Jira
  • Ability to read and reason about data structures, tables and fields, with working knowledge of SQL
  • Strong communication skills, able to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in an agile delivery team where requirements iterate

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks or a similar cloud data platform
  • Experience in finance, revenue accounting or accounting journals
  • Experience with loyalty, airline or travel data
  • Familiarity with event-driven or streaming data sources

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Job Description

JOB TITLE

Senior Data Developer

LEVEL/BAND

MM22

DEPARTMENT

Technology

DIRECT REPORT (JOB TITLE)

Data Development Manager

Overall Purpose of the Position

To drive and perform the activities to develop, maintain and support the Banks’ Enterprise Data Warehouse, Business Intelligence and Reporting Solutions, ensuring that the business has timely access to quality data in an efficient and effective manner and that our data stores are maintained inline with industry standards.

Operational Responsibilities

·To carry out all assigned tasks efficiently and effectively, in adherence with internal policies and procedures.

·To participate in the design and implementation of process improvements for the team.

·To participate in periodic system reviews to identify possible gaps and process inconsistencies and propose re-alignment strategies including the necessary training programmes.

Data Warehouse

·To participate in the architecture design and development of the Data Warehouse, including recoverability, resilience, data quality, data integrity and security in accordance with the Bank’s standards and industry best practices.

·To implement and maintain version control.

·To ensure proper segregation of duties within the team when it comes to implementing changes on test and production environments.

·To ensure, at all times, a current version of the documentation related to Data Warehouse architecture, data model and data dictionary is maintained.

·To monitor the state of data quality, including integrity, accuracy and consistency, within the Data Warehouse and establish goals for data quality improvements and take corrective action where necessary, including recommending updates at source with the data stewards.

·To perform the design and development activities of Data Warehouse integration with third party systems.

·To research and stay abreast of emerging Data Warehouse technologies and design methods.

Business Intelligence and Reporting

·To design and drive the development and implementation of BI solutions.

·To provide ad-hoc reports as per client/end user requirements.

·To assist our internal clients/end users in the definition of their business requirements.

·To assist/train end-users in the use of data query analysis and reporting tools.

·To promote the use of BI, BI Initiatives and Reporting tools.

Performance Management

·To establish and monitor process improvements and efficiencies to improve on the defined KPIs.

·To carry out performance benchmarking, tuning and optimisation to achieve the Bank’s desired performance results on/from the Data Warehouse.

Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

Mandatory

Skill

  • Excellent communication skills (including written and oral) - able to relate to various members of the organisation;
  • Ability to challenge the status quo and inspire others to identify opportunities and areasfor improvement;
  • Proven experience of working under pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Customer Driven with an ability to prioritise issues based on impact.
  • Excellent understanding of data administration and management functions (collection, analysis, distribution etc.)

Experience

  • Minimum of two years’ experience in Data Development/ Data Warehousing ;
  • Working knowledge of ETL and ETL techniques (technologies include Microsoft SSIS and SAP Data Services)
  • Experience in designing, developing and implementing Data Warehouse environments;
  • Hands on experience with SQL, PL/SQL and Transact SQL;
  • Knowledge of Data Reporting and KPIs.

Qualification

  • Possess a first degree level of education in IT or Engineering or equivalent specialised training in data warehousing and/or BI;.

Desirable

Skill

  • Requirements gathering;
  • Business and Process ANalysis;

Experience

  • Software Development;
  • Sprint planning.

Qualification

  • Banking/ Accounting Qualification.

Position level (1 being the highest level)

  1. Head of Department
  2. Managerial & Specialist Positions
  3. Middle Management & Specialist Positions
  4. Technical & Clerical Positions

jobs.description:
Solution Engineer, Post-Sales

Remote, United States

About Blumira and Our Culture

Blumira is the security operations platform built for growing teams and partners supporting them, integrating comprehensive visibility, tools, and expert guidance to give IT and security teams peace of mind from knowing they never have to go it alone. Every business needs strong security and deserves tools built for them, not just the largest enterprises. In helping them, we help their customers, and, overall, make the Internet a safer place.

Our team is passionate about putting resilience in reach for every organization and team, keeping the business running smoothly and helping teams build their own expertise through daily security practice. To realize our vision, we're looking for inquisitive and driven teammates, like you! jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

Desirable

Experience

About the Company:
JSI is a leading full-service consulting firm specializing in broadband solutions. For over 60 years, we have provided independent communications service providers with expert financial, engineering, management, operational, regulatory, and strategic guidance. Our extensive industry knowledge and proven track record of success have empowered clients to achieve sustainable growth and profitability. With clients nationwide and a powerful presence in markets across the United States, JSI empowers rural and regional broadband providers to expand, evolve, and excel in a rapidly shifting digital world.
Position Overview:
As a Permit Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing and supporting the permitting process across all active projects. This role serves as a key operational resource, coordinating between internal project teams, municipal agencies, and external stakeholders to ensure permits are obtained in a timely and compliant manner.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate permitting activities across multiple active projects, ensuring adherence to permit schedules and timely submission of complete permit packages.
  • Track permit status, supplemental information, approvals, and as-built staking sheet submissions while maintaining accurate permitting records and documentation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with municipal, county, and state agencies regarding permit applications, inquiries, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and collaborate with project engineers, designers, and internal teams to resolve permit-related issues and minimize project delays.
  • Maintain organized digital and physical permitting files and ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible.
  • Provide regular permit status updates to project managers and leadership, identifying potential risks and recommending solutions to keep projects on schedule.

Qualifications

Required:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in permitting, construction coordination, project administration, or a related role.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, site plans, and technical documents.
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Preferred:
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in a related field preferred.
  • Experience in the telecommunications, utility, or infrastructure industry.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k))

  • Ongoing professional development and educational opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Reimagined Parking, we believe great people drive great results.
jobs.description:
At Reimagined Parking, we believe great people drive great results. That’s why we prioritize our teams, champion a positive culture, and relentlessly pursue excellence.
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Senior Data Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and growth of Reimagined Parking’s commercial data products.
This role is responsible for identifying opportunities to turn Reimagined Parking’s data, analytics, and insights into differentiated products and services that create measurable value for customers and the business.

The Senior Data Product Manager will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for commercial data products, working closely with customers, business leaders, commercial teams, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.
The role combines product management, data strategy, customer discovery, and commercial development. The successful candidate will understand customer problems and market opportunities, translate them into compelling data products, and work cross-functionally to bring those products to market and continuously improve them.
In addition to developing external-facing data products, this role will identify opportunities to leverage data products and analytics to improve Reimagined Parking’s revenue, operational performance, customer experience, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Data Product Strategy
  • Define the vision and strategy for Reimagined Parking’s commercial data product portfolio.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to transform proprietary data, analytics, and insights into products and services that deliver customer and commercial value.
  • Develop product business cases, including target customers, value propositions, use cases, competitive differentiation, revenue potential, and investment requirements.
  • Maintain a prioritized product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and company strategy.
  • Establish product success metrics and measure customer adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, retention, and other key business outcomes.
Customer & Market Discovery
  • Partner with customers, prospects, sales, marketing, and business leaders to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging market opportunities.
  • Conduct product discovery to validate customer problems and determine where data can provide meaningful competitive advantage or business value.
  • Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements, use cases, and product opportunities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and evolving expectations for data, analytics, and intelligence products.
  • Establish ongoing customer feedback loops to inform product development and prioritization.
Data Product Development
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and discovery through development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
  • Translate business and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Work closely with data engineering, data science, analytics, software engineering, and technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable data products.
  • Ensure data products are intuitive, actionable, performant, and fit for their intended customer use cases.
  • Balance customer requirements, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, data availability, and time-to-market when prioritizing product investments.
  • Define and manage product launches, releases, enhancements, and ongoing product improvements.
Data Commercialization & Monetization
  • Identify opportunities to commercialize Reimagined Parking’s data assets through new products, services, insights, APIs, reporting, analytics, and other data-enabled offerings.
  • Partner with commercial leadership to support product positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Develop compelling product value propositions that clearly articulate the business outcomes customers can achieve.
  • Evaluate opportunities for new revenue streams and expansion within existing customer relationships.
  • Monitor product and market performance to identify opportunities for growth, product expansion, and improved customer value.
Data-Enabled Business Outcomes
  • Identify opportunities to use commercial data products and analytics to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business decision-making.
  • Establish clear business outcomes and KPIs for data products and measure value delivered after launch.
  • Use product and customer data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.
  • Partner with internal business teams to ensure insights generated by data products are translated into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Serve as the primary product leader connecting customers, commercial teams, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
  • Build strong relationships with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, finance, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, priorities, and performance to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional product teams through discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and optimization.
  • Create alignment around product priorities while effectively managing competing stakeholder needs.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Proven experience (2 years) as a Data Product Manager or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of data management, data analytics, and data visualization concepts.
  • Experience with data engineering, science and visualization technologies (e.g. Redshift, DBT, Microsoft Power BI)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, product management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello), and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience in the parking industry is a plus.

Benefits

Join our team and enjoy an outstanding benefits package, including:

Annual Discretionary Incentive plan: Designed to align pay with performance.

Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 20 days of paid time off, plus 8 paid holidays, so you can rest and recharge.

Comprehensive Health Plans: Access top-notch Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for you and your family.

Life and Disability Insurance: Company paid basic life and Short-Term Disability to secure your future with essential protection for you and additional options for your loved ones.

401(k) Plan: Benefit from a generous employer match with immediate vesting to help you save for retirement.

Employee Assistance Program: Access behavioral Health Care to assist with personal needs for you and your family members.

jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:

Come As You Are!

jobs.excerpt: The Database Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day administration, performance and resilience of the Microsoft SQL Server estate.
jobs.description:
The Database Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day administration, performance and resilience of the Microsoft SQL Server estate. This estate supports the software platform we provide to our customers, as well as our internal systems. The role also supports the Windows and Active Directory infrastructure around it. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role in a regulated financial services environment. Our platform is directly accessed by customers and connected to third-party trading, settlement and market data services.

The successful candidate will bring strong SQL Server database administration skills together with solid Windows Server, Active Directory and Azure experience. They will be comfortable owning business-critical database changes and migrations end-to-end, working directly with customers, and producing high-quality documentation for the wider team and for our audit and compliance obligations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administering and supporting the Microsoft SQL Server estate, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades and day-to-day operational support
  • Maintaining our SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery configurations, including Always On availability groups and failover clustering
  • Monitoring and tuning database performance, including query optimisation, indexing, statistics and capacity planning
  • Managing database security, logins, roles and permissions in line with least-privilege principles and audit requirements
  • Designing, running and maintaining SQL Agent jobs, maintenance plans and database integrity checks
  • Testing and maintaining backups and DR processes (including invocation testing) so they meet contracted RPO/RTO obligations
  • Supporting database migrations and upgrades, including moving workloads towards Azure-native services where appropriate
  • Administering and maintaining Active Directory, including trusts, Kerberos delegation (including SQL Server SPNs and service accounts), certificate services and certificate lifecycle management
  • Administering the Windows Server and IIS infrastructure that hosts our platform, including routine patching and maintenance
  • Maintaining our software and associated components on Third Platform Services (TPS)
  • Working alongside group information security to make sure the database and server estate is configured and maintained in line with security policies, control frameworks and audit requirements, and helping to fix any risks and vulnerabilities found
  • Responding to IT audit and customer due-diligence information requests and providing supporting evidence
  • Managing relationships with third-party vendors and suppliers, including technical liaison, escalations and coordinating delivery of changes
  • Producing and maintaining clear technical documentation, runbooks and knowledgebase articles to support the team and meet audit requirements
  • Monitoring and responding to alerts from the database, infrastructure and monitoring platforms
  • Out-of-hours work for routine maintenance and occasional project work
  • Working on other IT projects relating to databases, infrastructure and security as required
  • Contributing to team planning

Key attributes and Skills

Essential
  • Proven experience in a similar technical role, with a significant focus on Microsoft SQL Server database administration
  • Experience in an environment providing and supporting B2B customer-facing technology
  • Experience working within a regulated or externally audited industry, with an understanding of contractual obligations and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 / ISAE 3402 / AAF, and CIS benchmarks/controls (or equivalents such as NIST)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated, and capable of tackling complex projects either on their own or as part of a team
  • Able to work collaboratively across different departments/teams with differing technical capabilities, and with external customers and vendors, to deliver effective solutions
  • Microsoft SQL Server administration in production environments, ideally SQL Server 2022: installation and patching, backup/restore and point-in-time recovery, security/permissions, SQL Agent job management, and performance tuning (query optimisation, indexing, execution plans)
  • Proficiency in T-SQL for writing, reviewing and troubleshooting queries, stored procedures and maintenance scripts
  • Strong Windows Server administration
  • Advanced Active Directory administration, including trusts, Kerberos delegation and certificate management
  • Knowledge of Windows-based IIS application administration
  • PowerShell scripting
  • Experience with backup and DR tools and processes
  • Strong documentation skills and experience managing third-party vendors/suppliers

Desirable
  • SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery design: e.g. Always On availability groups, clustering, log shipping
  • Azure SQL experience: Azure SQL Database and/or Azure SQL Managed Instance, including migration from SQL Server on VMs
  • Basic Microsoft Azure administration: VMs, storage, networking fundamentals and resource management
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM administration
  • ADFS administration
  • Redgate SQL Monitor (or similar SQL monitoring/tooling, e.g. the wider Redgate toolset)
  • PostgreSQL administration
  • Microsoft BizTalk Server administration
  • Microsoft SharePoint Server administration
  • Fortinet/FortiGate firewall administration
  • Experience with PRTG, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms
  • Atlassian suite: Jira ticketing and project management, Confluence documentation
  • Industry-specific experience: payment/settlement gateways (e.g. CREST/Euroclear), trading interfaces, CASS, and similar financial-market infrastructure
  • Wealth management / stockbroking domain knowledge

A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.
