At EIS, DevOps ownership spans the complete path from cloud foundation to a running application. We are looking for a senior, hands-on engineer who can connect AWS infrastructure, secure networking, platform services, CI/CD, and application deployment into one reliable delivery system.
You will design and provision AWS environments, automate configuration, build delivery pipelines, deploy and configure EIS Suite applications, operate Kubernetes workloads, and troubleshoot issues across the stack. You will work closely with developers, QA engineers, architects, project managers, and customers. This role offers genuine end-to-end ownership, influence over technical standards, and the opportunity to mentor other engineers. EIS One Suite is delivered as a SaaS product, so your decisions directly influence the availability, security, scalability, performance, observability, release experience, and cloud efficiency that customers depend on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own solutions end to end - from AWS infrastructure and network design through CI/CD, application configuration, deployment, observability, and production support.
  • Design and evolve secure, highly available AWS environments, including customer connectivity and hybrid-cloud integrations.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and maintain clean, reviewed, version-controlled infrastructure code with controlled change and minimal drift.
  • Design, improve, and operate Jenkins delivery pipelines and their GitLab integrations, including pipeline-as-code and Groovy-based automation.
  • Deploy and operate containerized services on Amazon EKS using Docker, Helm, and YAML-based configuration.
  • Automate Linux and platform configuration with Ansible, including the installation and lifecycle of services such as GitLab, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube, and OpenGrok.
  • Operate GitOps-based EIS Suite deployments across development, pre-production, and production environments through Argo CD, using GitLab as the configuration source and cloud-hosted Helm and container registries as artifact sources.
  • Implement and troubleshoot AWS networking, DNS, load balancing, identity, permissions, and secure access using least-privilege principles.
  • Build actionable monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts; lead diagnosis of complex incidents across cloud, platform, pipeline, and application-delivery layers.
  • Embed security and quality controls into automation, including privileged access, secrets handling, code quality, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Improve engineering standards, create clear operational guidance, review technical solutions, and mentor less experienced engineers.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to improve automation, code quality, documentation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows, with appropriate security, review, and human oversight.
  • Help evolve the internal developer platform as a shared cross-department capability: gather feedback from engineering and delivery teams, contribute reusable self-service patterns and platform improvements, and share ownership of adoption and outcomes across departments.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

We look for depth in AWS cloud and platform engineering, supported by strong hands-on capability across the adjacent delivery lifecycle. Equal mastery of every tool is not required; what matters is the ability to own, deploy, and troubleshoot EIS Suite environments end to end and to deepen adjacent skills.
Core dept
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related role.

  • Strong production experience with Terraform, including module design, state management, code review, and safe infrastructure change.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, building, troubleshooting, and maintaining Jenkins pipelines, including pipeline-as-code and Groovy automation.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of GitLab as a source-control platform, including repository configuration, access controls, merge-request workflows and code reviews, and integration with Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid Linux administration and networking knowledge, including routing, DNS, firewalls, VPN/IPsec, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Strong adjacent capability
  • Hands-on experience with Argo CD and GitOps-based deployment of EIS Suite applications across Kubernetes environments.
  • Strong Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm skills, including deployment configuration, troubleshooting, scaling, and high-availability considerations.
  • Practical experience with Ansible for repeatable software installation and configuration management.
  • Strong Git skills and the ability to automate with Bash and/or Python.
  • Working knowledge of Java application build and delivery ecosystems, including tools such as Maven, and familiarity with artifact repositories.
  • A systems-thinking approach to production troubleshooting, with the ability to follow a problem across multiple technical layers and drive it to resolution.
  • Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and experience collaborating across teams; mentoring or technical leadership experience is expected at senior level.
Broader awareness and useful experience (nice to have)
  • Experience with AWS CloudFormation or AWS CLI in addition to Terraform.
  • Experience with Azure or IBM Cloud and an interest in applying common engineering standards across cloud platforms.

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception.

As a Staff AI-First Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks.
  • Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used.
  • Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture.
  • Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines.
  • Automate repetitive security workflows (evidence collection, access reviews, alert enrichment) and build or operate AI-assisted security agents — with human-in-the-loop approval gates, least-privilege credentials, and explicit attention to each agent's own blast radius.
  • Integrate security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, DAST/SAST, vulnerability scanners) with LLM layers to surface actionable insight and automated responses.
  • Define and enforce security requirements for AI-powered features: model access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, output validation, and data-handling boundaries.
  • Conduct threat modelling on agentic and LLM-based systems, accounting for novel attack surfaces such as tool misuse, indirect prompt injection, and supply chain risk.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated AI/ML security depth (prompt injection, model supply chain, adversarial inputs, RAG).
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) and LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to accelerate and elevate your work.
  • Hands-on identity and access expertise across modern enterprise and cloud identity stacks, including access models for AI systems and non-human identities.
  • Infrastructure and policy-as-code (e.g. Terraform, OPA/Rego) and proficiency in a scripting language for automation (Python preferred).
  • Cloud security expertise: AWS Solutions Architect / Security Specialty or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including multi-account governance, preventive guardrails, and policy-as-code.
  • Application security (OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, secure SDLC) and threat-modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent). Practical experience building or operating AI agents, and integrating security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, SAST/DAST/SCA) so it surfaces action rather than raw alerts.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 control frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating AI agents in a production environment.
  • Awareness of privacy regulation (GDPR/CCPA) as it touches AI including privacy-by-design and DPIAs.
  • Red teaming or adversarial ML research backgrounds.
  • Experience implementing privileged-access, key-management, posture-management, or data-protection programs.
  • Experience with EDR, CASB, DLP, Security automation and SAST, DAST, IAST and SCA tools.
  • Cloud Architecture or Security certifications (CCSK, TAISE, AWS).

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $170,000-$220,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.

The Community Health Worker (CHW) operates within the New Mexico Department of Health (NMDOH) Community Health Worker Scope of Work and plays an essential role in connecting families with ABA services, supporting client engagement, and fostering community partnerships.

The CHW provides culturally responsive outreach, coordination, and family-centered education so that every family has the support they need to begin and sustain services with FronteraCare.

The CHW serves as the primary intake representative for an assigned group of families, providing consistent support and communication from initial referral through completion of the intake process. They partner closely with the Intake and Scheduling teams to help families move smoothly toward evaluation and service start, making sure no one gets lost between referral and the first appointment.

Beyond intake, the CHW provides ongoing case management for these families. This means understanding each family’s needs, connecting them with community resources, and building trusting relationships that continue well after services begin.

Intake & Referral Coordination

  • Serve as the primary intake representative for an assigned group of families, providing consistent communication and support from initial referral through completion of the intake process.

  • Conduct proactive outreach and follow-up with new leads and referrals — via calls, texts, and emails — to reduce backlog and help families move from initial inquiry toward evaluation scheduling.

  • Partner with Intake Specialists, the Family Intake Coordinator, and Care Liaison to coordinate evaluation scheduling, required documentation, and next steps for assigned families.

  • Help families understand what to expect during the intake process, including evaluations, required documentation, and timelines.

  • Track intake progress for assigned families and flag delays or barriers to the Intake team.

Case Management

  • Serve as the ongoing point of contact for assigned families once intake is complete, continuing the relationship built during referral and onboarding.

  • Conduct monthly outreach to each assigned family to check in on how services are going and how the family is doing overall, including factors beyond therapy that may affect their engagement and stability.

  • Identify barriers facing each family, such as housing, food security, transportation, financial hardship, and emergency needs, and connect them with community, state, and local resources.

  • Follow up on referrals and resource connections to confirm families received the support they need, and adjust as circumstances change.

  • Provide timely support between scheduled check-ins as needs arise.

  • Partner with the care team and Care Liaison to address non-clinical barriers to care, including attendance and access challenges, and share relevant family context to support service continuity.

  • Help families navigate insurance and benefits, including Medicaid reapplication and coverage changes that could interrupt services.

  • Document all family contacts, identified needs, referrals, and follow-up in accordance with organizational and NMDOH CHW standards.

Clinical Quality

  • Coordinate client referrals, assessments, and onboarding for families on FronteraCare’s waitlist.

  • Support families in understanding the ABA process, clinical goals, and care expectations.

  • Assist with ongoing service coordination, including client scheduling and follow-up support.

  • Engage families who have paused services or experience frequent cancellations to identify and address barriers to care.

  • Promote adherence to treatment recommendations and consistent participation in services.

  • Operate within NMDOH Community Health Worker Scope of Work, contributing to:

    • Community outreach and engagement

    • Care coordination and case management

    • Home-based and community support

    • Health promotion, training, and system navigation

Professional and Ethical Conduct

  • Maintain confidentiality, discretion, and professional boundaries in all interactions with clients and colleagues.

  • Follow all Frontera Health policies and applicable state and federal regulations.

  • Demonstrate integrity and ethical behavior consistent with NMDOH CHW standards and ABA service expectations.

  • Uphold a strengths-based, family-centered approach in all work.

  • Accurately document all outreach, case coordination, and family interactions.

Communication and Family Interaction

  • Serve as a trusted liaison between FronteraCare, clients, and community partners.

  • Provide clear, empathetic, and culturally responsive communication to families.

  • Educate families on the benefits of ABA therapy, service processes, and available community resources.

  • Support families through changes in service status (e.g., on hold, paused services, or new onboarding).

  • Reinforce family understanding of care plans and encourage collaboration with clinical staff.

  • Facilitate translation and interpretation as needed to enhance understanding and engagement.

  • Support full alignment with FronteraCare’s technology platforms, including assessment tools and digital phenotyping systems; ensure families are actively engaged in providing consent, using the parent training app, and understanding video-based technology.

  • Utilize technology to enhance family engagement, monitor adherence to digital protocols, and identify opportunities for additional guidance or support.

Leadership and Mentorship

  • Model professionalism, collaboration, and accountability for other team members.

  • Promote a positive, solutions-focused clinic culture aligned with Frontera Health’s values.

  • Serve as a resource for families and staff on community systems and service navigation.

  • Participate in meetings, parent training, and team discussions to enhance care coordination and service delivery.

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and communication to address client and family needs

Qualifications and Requirements

Required:

  • Community Health Worker Certification from the NMDOH Office of Community Health Workers

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish for effective family communication

  • Organization & task management skills to ensure families are being wholly supported and following up consistently through the care initiation journey

  • Empathy to support families through challenging situations

  • Patience to support families through complex care coordination & navigation activities

Preferred:

  • Experience working with families or children in health, social services, or behavioral health settings

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

  • MSW or LCSW candidates are strongly encouraged to apply (not required)

  • Experience with intake coordination, lead follow-up, or scheduling in a healthcare or behavioral health setting

Work Environment and Travel

jobs.description:
New B2B Real-Money Game Provider

Location: Remote (Europe preferred) | International travel required

Salary: Negotiable / Flexible, based on experience and profile

About the Opportunity

Our client is a private investment group led by accomplished technology entrepreneurs with experience building and scaling international businesses.

The group is backing the launch of a new B2B real-money game provider, with the objective of building a fully operational, revenue-generating business serving casino operators, aggregators and platforms. The business will develop and distribute a commercially relevant portfolio of real-money games.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial CEO / Co-founder with direct leadership experience inside the B2B games-provider industry. The role is to turn a market opportunity into a commercially successful provider, with responsibility for market strategy, P&L, the leadership team, game production, distribution, operator launches and portfolio economics.

The Role

You will determine which operators, game types and competing providers perform in the priority markets, why specific game mechanics and mathematics can produce commercial results, and where the new provider can win market share. You do not need to design games personally or act as the Product Manager, but you must bring sound product-market judgement and make informed portfolio and investment decisions.

This is a hands-on business leadership mandate: build the operating model, establish commercial distribution, guide the first releases into the market and create a business capable of generating and growing revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an evidence-based market thesis, defining priority GEOs, customer segments, competitors, portfolio positioning and distribution channels.
  • Build the operating model, leadership structure and game-production system required to launch and scale the provider.
  • Agree and manage a game release roadmap with clear quality controls and the capacity to achieve the agreed annual release cadence.
  • Take the first games through production, certification, integration, operator launch and monetisation.
  • Develop a qualified commercial pipeline of operators, aggregators and platform partners.
  • Drive the full commercial journey from qualified lead to contract, integration, live launch, game visibility, promotional support and revenue.
  • Secure meaningful lobby placements and promotional commitments with operators, rather than focusing solely on making games technically available.
  • Own the P&L, cash plan, financial forecasting and unit economics by game, operator, GEO and distribution channel.
  • Propose changes to organisational structure and leadership to the Board, then implement agreed decisions.
  • Create a unified management dashboard with consistent, clearly defined delivery, distribution, player, revenue and reliability metrics.
  • Use AI where it measurably reduces production cycle time or cost, or increases throughput, without compromising quality, compliance or originality.

What We're Looking For

  • Direct senior leadership experience inside a B2B real-money game provider, specifically slots, instant or crash games. Experience solely with a casino operator, platform, affiliate, payments business or general B2C product is not a substitute for provider experience.
  • A demonstrable track record of building a provider from the ground up or materially scaling a provider, a game portfolio or its commercial distribution.
  • An active personal network of operators, aggregators and platforms that can be put to work, supported by evidence of completed launches, live integrations and revenue-producing relationships.
  • P&L ownership or comparable responsibility for the economics and performance of the business as a whole.
  • A genuinely hands-on management style, with examples of personally diagnosing and resolving delivery, commercial or organisational bottlenecks.
  • Strong product-market judgement: the ability to explain which games and providers perform in specific GEOs, how game mechanics and mathematics influence commercial outcomes, and how to translate that insight into a portfolio investment thesis.
  • Experience hiring, developing and leading an effective core team, and establishing practical management routines.
  • A career track record consistent with taking on a multi-year business-building assignment.
  • The ideal background is a current or former CEO or Co-founder of a game provider. We will also consider a CCO or COO from a provider with genuine P&L ownership, cross-functional leadership and experience building the business and its distribution. Leadership of a successful 20–30-person provider team may be relevant where that team delivered and monetised a strong portfolio; bringing a proven core team can also be considered.

What's on Offer

  • Build a new business: Lead the launch and commercial development of an international B2B real-money game provider.
  • Experienced investment backing: Work with established technology entrepreneurs supporting a new gaming business.
  • Business-wide responsibility: Shape the market approach, operating model, portfolio and team while working closely with the Board.
  • Flexible and competitive compensation:Our client is open to discussing attractive, individually tailored terms with exceptional candidates and a proven track record.
  • Participation in outcomes:Performance-based incentives, profit participation or equity arrangements will be discussed as part of an individually tailored compensation package.
  • International working arrangements:Remote working, with Europe preferred and travel for partner and investor meetings as required.

Interested?

If you have already built or materially scaled a B2B real-money game provider and can bring the commercial network, operational judgement and hands-on leadership needed to do it again, we would welcome a conversation.

Reach out to our Associate Partner at or via Telegram @tmalinouskaya to discuss more.

Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a dedicated Reconciliation Analyst to drive the efficiency and accuracy of our financial operations by managing the end-to-end reconciliation process for multiple banking partners. In this vital role, you will be responsible for gathering data, analyzing and matching transactions, and ensuring the precise reconciliation of all client deposits, withdrawals, conversions, and inter-product fund transfers. You will perform daily investigations into reconciliation breaks across assigned accounts, actively supporting the team in resolving and preventing future discrepancies. Beyond routine operations, you will also play a key role in strategic projects focused on enhancing automation and long-term process effectiveness to support the organization’s growth.

This role will work closely with our payments, trading, and middle office functions.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Contribute to the execution and improvement of our existing reconciliation processes.

  • Support the reconciliation framework, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all stages.

  • Investigate discrepancies and breaks in reconciliations, assisting in taking corrective actions to resolve and prevent future issues.

  • Contribute to the implementation of process improvements to enhance automation and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate on cross-functional projects aimed at optimizing the reconciliation process and integrating new systems or tools.

  • Running the daily reconciliation process, including data gathering, analysis, and matching of transactions.

  • Identifying and investigating discrepancies, breaks, and variances in financial transactions.

  • Assisting in developing and implementing solutions to resolve reconciliation issues and prevent recurrence.

  • Contributing to the enhancement of the efficiency of the reconciliation process through automation and system improvements.

  • Collaborating with internal teams and external banking partners to ensure seamless and accurate financial reporting.

What You Need:

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation discrepancies.

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a SAN Engineer / Storage Administrator for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Migration & Syndication (DMS) initiative within the Electronic Health Record Modernization Integration Office (EHRM-IO). The engineer will be responsible for administering, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise storage infrastructure, including HPE, NetApp, Pure Storage, and Brocade technologies, while supporting data migration, backup and recovery, and storage integration across on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary infrastructure and engineering team, collaborating with storage administrators, systems engineers, database specialists, cloud engineers, vendor support teams, and federal stakeholders. The engineer will support ongoing storage operations, capacity planning, infrastructure modernization, technical troubleshooting, and documentation activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical healthcare systems.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, administer, and optimize enterprise Storage Area Network (SAN) infrastructure, including Brocade Fibre Channel switches, HPE 3PAR, Primera and Alletra storage arrays, NetApp AFF clusters, Pure Storage FlashArray and FlashBlade systems, supporting approximately nine petabytes of storage across VA healthcare environments.
  • Monitor and maintain storage capacity, utilization, performance, and availability using tools such as HPE InfoSight, HPE SSMC, NetApp ONTAP, NetApp Unified Manager, Pure Storage Pure1, SolarWinds, and SANnav, producing capacity forecasts, performance metrics, and weekly status reports.
  • Administer enterprise backup, recovery, and data protection operations using Commvault, storage snapshots and snapclones, SQL Server backup tools, HPE tape libraries, and Microsoft Azure archival storage to ensure data availability, integrity, and recoverability.
  • Support storage infrastructure integration, technical refresh initiatives, and large-scale data migrations across EHRM, BISL, and Azure environments, including provisioning new storage devices, migrating existing workloads, and maintaining secure and reliable connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot complex storage connectivity, hardware, firmware, and performance issues across SAN fabrics, storage arrays, and cloud environments, coordinating with vendor support teams to perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and minimize operational disruptions.
  • Maintain comprehensive storage infrastructure documentation, including system technical guides, topology diagrams, build and configuration guides, capacity planning reports, and Authorization to Operate (ATO) documentation, while evaluating approved AI-assisted tools for storage automation, predictive analytics, troubleshooting, and reporting.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise SAN and storage infrastructure, including NetApp ONTAP, HPE Primera, HPE 3PAR 20850, HP Lefthand Centralized Management Console, HP Storage Essentials, and HP SN8700 Fibre Channel director switches.
  • Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting Fibre Channel SAN environments, enterprise storage arrays, and storage connectivity, performance, and availability issues across on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise backup and recovery technologies, including Commvault, storage snapshots, snapclones, hierarchical storage management, and storage integration supporting data migration and disaster recovery operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues, optimize storage performance, identify operational risks, and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, technical documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to participate in detailed technical discussions, coordinate with vendor support teams, and develop and present technical reports and briefing materials to stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal government infrastructure environments, particularly data migration, data syndication, and EHR modernization initiatives, with knowledge of database architecture, administration, and security across on-premises and cloud-hosted systems.
  • Experience with enterprise storage management and automation tools, including HPE InfoSight, HPE SSMC, HPE 3PAR CLI, HP SSSU, NetApp ONTAP CLI, Pure Storage Pure1, SANnav, and PowerShell, with familiarity in AI-driven predictive analytics for capacity forecasting, performance monitoring, and proactive infrastructure maintenance.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and validate storage automation scripts, analyze logs and vendor diagnostics, generate performance reports, and maintain technical documentation, with an understanding of secure AI practices, non-production testing, protection of sensitive infrastructure information and PHI/PII, and compliance with federal responsible AI guidance.

Security Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

  • Provide objective financial perspectives on growth opportunities, operational investments, organizational capacity, and business risks.
  • Develop executive-level financial narratives that connect results, operating performance, assumptions, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Lead scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to evaluate alternative strategies and potential business outcomes.
  • Support leadership discussions concerning organic growth, new offerings, market expansion, pricing, investments, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Present financial analyses, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.

Enterprise Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting

  • Own and continuously improve the organization’s annual budgeting, recurring forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.
  • Establish planning calendars, methodologies, assumptions, templates, governance standards, and accountability across participating business units.

Financial Analysis and Performance Management

  • Establish an enterprise performance-management framework that connects strategic priorities with financial and operational measures.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly analysis of actual performance compared with budget, forecast, prior periods, and strategic expectations.
  • Identify the underlying drivers of financial performance and convert findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Reporting, Analytics, and Business Intelligence

  • Lead the development of accurate, timely, and decision-oriented management reporting.
  • Establish consistent definitions, methodologies, and governance for financial and operational performance measures.
  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting packages that highlight results, trends, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.

Capital Allocation, Investment, and Transaction Support

  • Lead financial modeling and due diligence support for potential acquisitions, integrations, investments, and partnerships.
  • Evaluate expected returns, cash requirements, financial risks, sensitivities, and strategic alignment.

Financial Governance and Risk Management

  • Identify financial, operational, and market risks and develop mitigation recommendations for executive consideration.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships with leaders across the organization and serve as the primary FP&A point of contact for strategic financial planning.
  • Increase financial understanding and accountability by helping leaders interpret performance and evaluate trade-offs.
  • Facilitate planning and performance discussions that generate clear decisions, owners, and follow-through.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions while maintaining productive, solutions-oriented relationships.
  • Coordinate with Accounting, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and other teams so plans and forecasts reflect current business conditions.

People Leadership and Functional Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the FP&A team, establishing clear expectations for performance, quality, responsiveness, and business partnership.
  • Determine team priorities, allocate resources, and balance recurring deliverables with strategic projects.
  • Build team capabilities in financial modeling, forecasting, analytics, executive communication, and business partnership.

Experience

jobs.description:
HAPPY HOWL®

Demand Capture Manager

Remote (US) · Full-Time

About Happy Howl

We started Happy Howl because we believe dogs deserve better — and better wasn’t available. Not from the legacy brands cutting corners with feed-grade ingredients, not from the fresh players who can’t survive a pantry shelf, and not from anyone willing to accept that the industry standard for pet nutrition is “good enough.”

We’re on a mission to help dogs live longer, healthier lives. Every recipe is 100% human-grade, single-source animal protein, zero preservatives, backed by real science and formulated by a PhD nutritionist who obsesses over every ingredient. Our food is shelf-stable for two years without refrigeration — real, whole-food nutrition that’s ready whenever and wherever your dog is. That combination doesn’t exist anywhere else.

But we’re more than a product. We work hand-in-hand with rescue organizations across the country because we believe every dog deserves a great meal — not just the ones who already found their forever home. Giving back isn’t a marketing campaign for us. It’s why we exist.

We’re backed by some of the most respected investors in consumer and pet, and we’re building the team that scales this brand past $100M in annual revenue. This is not a slow build. We move fast, we think big, and we hold ourselves to a standard most companies talk about but never actually live.

The people here are energetic, passionate, thoughtful, and intentional. We’re a team in every sense of the word — we win together, we solve hard problems together, and we’re building something that genuinely matters. If you want to do the best work of your career at a company that refuses to settle, Happy Howl is where you belong.

We’re headquartered in Huntingdon Valley, PA with team members across the US.

About the Role

The media buying team creates demand. You capture it. As Demand Capture Manager, you’ll own every organic and bottom-of-funnel touchpoint that converts interest into revenue — from SEO and organic social to product page optimization and Amazon listings. This is a high-impact role that directly influences conversion rates, CAC efficiency, and revenue growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own SEO strategy and execution across the Happy Howl website and blog.
  • Manage organic social media presence and content distribution.
  • Optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout flows for conversion.
  • Lead Amazon listing optimization and organic ranking strategy.
  • Build and optimize quiz funnels and guided shopping experiences.
  • Track organic traffic, search rankings, conversion rates, and attributed revenue.
  • Coordinate with content and paid media teams on integrated campaign execution.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve spent 3–5 years in digital marketing and you understand that the best acquisition strategy in the world is worthless if the landing page doesn’t convert. You’ve done SEO, organic social, and CRO — and you’ve tied all of it to revenue, not vanity metrics.

You own outcomes. When conversion rate drops, you don’t wait for the next team meeting to bring it up — you’re already testing a hypothesis. You measure yourself by revenue influenced, not by traffic volume or keyword rankings in isolation.

You move with urgency. We’re launching on Amazon, scaling TikTok Shop, and rebuilding our website simultaneously. You thrive in that pace because you prioritize ruthlessly and you ship fast without sacrificing quality.

You embrace the underdog spirit. Most of the organic traffic and conversion infrastructure doesn’t exist yet. You’re building it from scratch, and that’s exactly what excites you.

You’re locked in. When a product launch or campaign demands extra effort on the conversion side, you rise to the moment. You understand that the demand your teammates create with paid media is only as valuable as the conversion experience you build to capture it.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Amazon SEO and marketplace optimization.
  • Background in DTC food, pet, or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop and social commerce.
  • CRO certification or demonstrable A/B testing experience.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary ($85K–$105K) plus bonus opportunity and equity.
  • Own the full organic and conversion function at a fast-growing DTC brand.
  • Remote work flexibility.
  • Collaborate with an experienced growth team and cutting-edge AI tools.
Salary: $85,000 – $105,000 / year

jobs.description:
Vice President, Research & Development – Harris School Solutions, FINS


This is a unique opportunity to own and drive all facets of Research & Development for Harris School Solutions' FINS expanding growth products, at a moment when AI is reshaping both how software is built and what K12 customers expect from it. This is a technical leadership position that requires a strong blend of people management and hands-on software development experience, product vision, deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies and the multi-tooled AI ecosystem, fluency with modern AI-assisted development practices, and a working command of the agile scrum process.

The Vice President of Research & Development is responsible for a continuous flow of product research and development that improves our existing products, brings more capability to the web and the cloud on a consistent, standard technical platform, and embeds AI into both our products and our engineering practice. You will lead the shift from AI experimentation to AI at scale: raising developer productivity through AI-assisted coding and testing, shipping intelligent features that save school business offices real time, and doing it responsibly with the data governance that public sector customers demand.

As the Senior Leader of R&D, you will inspire and collaborate with a diverse team of developers and managers located in multiple offices and a remote workforce throughout the US, across multiple products. You are a highly motivated self-starter and team player, focused on team success, operational efficiency, and execution, and you lead by example in adopting new tools yourself. You will manage and inspire a team of 40+ people.

This position reports to the Executive Vice President, Harris School Solutions, FINS Enterprise Solutions.

What your impact will be:

  • Translate business goals and product requirements into actionable development plans, including a clear, prioritized AI roadmap for each product.
  • Ensure development projects are delivered on time and within budget, using AI-assisted development, testing, and documentation to compress cycle times and raise quality.
  • Provide strategic planning, direction, and control of product development activities, and contribute technical input into the overall business unit strategy, including where AI creates differentiation and where it creates risk.
  • Drive adoption of AI developer tooling (for example GitHub Copilot and agentic coding assistants) across the team, set the standards for how it is used, and measure the productivity and quality results.
  • Lead the delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities for K12 finance, HR, and administrative workflows, such as intelligent automation, natural-language reporting, anomaly detection, and assistive experiences that reduce manual effort for district staff.
  • Establish responsible AI practices for the business unit: data privacy and student-data protections (FERPA and state requirements), model governance, human-in-the-loop controls, and transparent communication with customers about how AI is used.
  • Communicate strategy developments, provide ongoing executive updates, prioritize initiatives, and escalate roadblocks to executive leadership.
  • Communicate development progress and issues to senior management and across the organization.
  • Manage both onsite and offshore development teams.
  • Proactively foster and build channels of communication across business units to ensure collaboration and achievement of organizational objectives, and share AI learnings and reusable components across Harris.
  • Provide technical direction and guidance for all product development and support services needs throughout the organization.
  • Continually evaluate the organizational structure, current technology, and engineering practices as a means to enhance productivity, and implement appropriate changes.
  • Track and communicate industry trends and emerging technologies, with particular attention to AI, that can provide the organization with a competitive advantage.
  • Perform a full range of leadership responsibilities, which may include but are not limited to: interviewing, hiring, coaching and developing employees, assigning and directing work, driving performance management, and managing department budgets.
  • Display a consistent desire to learn and seek professional growth opportunities, and build the same learning culture in the team as AI capabilities evolve.
  • Attend training and develop relevant knowledge, techniques, and skills.

What we are looking for:

A Technical Visionary

  • Provide an overall vision for the product and technical roadmap, with AI as a core pillar rather than a side project.
  • Drive best practices for all R&D processes including product delivery, rollout, feedback, and internal and external communication.
  • Set the engineering standards for AI-assisted development, secure coding, and cloud-native architecture on the Microsoft stack.
  • Drive initiatives and solutions for the product and technical teams, and know when to build, buy, or partner for AI capability.

A Business Visionary

  • Be financially savvy, including understanding the cost model of AI services and how to price and position AI features.
  • Innovate and evolve the business.
  • Integrate customers into the overall strategy, using their real workflows and data challenges to decide where AI earns its place.

A People Visionary

  • Build effective teams and develop team members for an AI-augmented engineering world.
  • Work with existing teams and structure, and bring people along through change with clarity and empathy.
  • Build, listen to, and develop effective teams and team members.
  • Bring departments together.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of management experience leading software development teams.
  • P&L experience.
  • Portfolio management of multiple products and tech stacks.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and demonstrated experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities into production software.

What will make you stand out:

  • Agile expert.
  • Experience in public sector or K12 solutions.
  • SaaS deployments and infrastructure.
  • Experience with the AI platforms, LLM integration, or building agentic and copilot-style experiences into enterprise applications.
  • A track record of establishing responsible AI or data governance practices in a regulated environment.
  • Innovative examples of driving measurable value in products.

What we offer:

  • Culture for growth
  • Top notch employee health and wellbeing benefits
  • Every voice matters
  • Global reach
  • Careers with purpose
  • World class career development programs

About us:

Harris School Solutions is dedicated to using innovative technology, increasingly powered by AI, to bridge gaps in communication, workflows, connectivity, safety, and efficiency within school districts, county offices of education, and related organizations. We consistently strive to help K12 teams optimize their time so they can focus on what's most important: teaching and learning.

Salary range: $120,000 - $130,000 USD per year.

jobs.excerpt: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Healthcare Data Informaticist, you will design, manage, and maintain all reference data assets in the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), including clinical, and claims-related coding standards. In this senior role, you will ensure high-quality, standardized, and actionable data to support therapeutic area frameworks and a comprehensive, reference data library. You will collaborate closely with data engineering, analytics, and product teams to deliver scalable, interoperable, and trusted healthcare data solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Curate, standardize, and validate medical and pharmacy claims data to ensure accuracy and usability across Compass products
  • Map drugs to indications and therapeutic areas using coding standards such as ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, RxNorm, and ATC
  • Design, maintain, and document hierarchical structures, taxonomies, and vocabularies, including therapeutic area frameworks, diagnosis/procedure groupings
  • Develop business rules, validation routines, and clinical logic to support reliable analytics and product use
  • Lead data integration and modeling efforts, applying healthcare data standards for consistent, interoperable data assets
  • Troubleshoot complex data issues, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and adherence to regulatory requirements (HIPAA)
  • Produce clear documentation (ERDs, flowcharts, sequence diagrams) to communicate processes and data solutions effectively
  • Translate complex clinical and payer data concepts into actionable insights for cross-functional teams and leadership
  • Mentor and guide junior team members to strengthen overall team capabilities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Biomedical Informatics, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Public Health, or related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with healthcare data systems, clinical vocabularies, coding systems, and payer data
  • Deep expertise in drug classification and coding systems (NDC, RxNorm, ATC)
  • Advanced knowledge of diagnostic and procedural code sets (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS)
  • Experience with payer data, including commercial and government payers, and a history of acting as a subject matter expert
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, transformation, and aggregation on large healthcare datasets
  • Proven ability to design, maintain, and govern complex hierarchical structures (taxonomies, ontologies, clinical groupers)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve technical challenges in healthcare data systems
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to translate complex data concepts for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare system structures, data standards, and payer mix concepts

Nice to Have

  • Experience with terminology or ontology management tools (e.g., Apelon, SNOMED CT browsers, OHDSI/OMOP)
  • Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica) and FAIR data principles
  • Background in pharmacy, clinical informatics, or health economics/market access analytics
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, R, SAS) or other ETL/data manipulation tools

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $80,000 - $115,000

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. Location: Philippines (Remote)

Who We Are

Brolly Labs dba CatalyzeX is a business process outsourcing specialist that combines process expertise with top offshore talent, delivering the best value outcomes for its clients.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Paralegal with a Case Manager background to support our law firm clients with medical records retrieval. You've managed cases before, so you understand how medical records drive a case forward, what complete really looks like, and why every missing page matters.

To be clear about the role: this position is focused on medical records retrieval. Most of your day will be spent requesting, chasing, and organizing records, not handling full case management. We're looking for case managers because you bring the judgment, ownership, and follow-through this work needs.

You're bold, assertive, and relentless in getting results. You know how to push through delays and deal with unresponsive facilities confidently. If you're organized, comfortable on the phone, and detail-oriented, we want to hear from you.

Who You Are

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Case Manager, ideally in personal injury or another legal setting.
  • Hands-on experience requesting and following up on medical records as part of your case work.
  • Proven ability to handle pushback from facilities and keep following up until documents are received.
  • Strong communication skills: assertive, confident, and effective on the phone.
  • Excellent organizational and administrative abilities. You can juggle multiple requests, prioritize follow-ups, and stay detail-oriented.
  • Familiarity with ROI (Release of Information) portals such as ChartSwap, MRO, Sharecare, CIOX, or similar.
  • Proficient in case management tools, spreadsheets, document tracking systems, and general productivity software.
  • Solid understanding of HIPAA compliance and best practices for handling PHI (Protected Health Information).

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Prepare and submit records requests on behalf of law firms, making sure the required documentation is included and complete.
  • Send faxes or upload documents to facilities, or submit through ROI portals, depending on each facility's process.
  • Call medical facilities and hospitals to follow up on requests, clarify missing information, and handle delays persistently.
  • Push back when needed, ask the right questions, and escalate unresponsive or difficult cases to keep them moving.
  • Track and update all request statuses in internal systems, with thorough and accurate documentation.
  • Keep law firm clients informed by providing updates, acknowledging new requests, and responding to inquiries quickly and professionally.
  • Review and organize received records to make sure they're complete, correct, and ready for legal teams.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of all information, strictly following HIPAA and internal privacy policies.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required, with a minimum of 20 Mbps or a fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

  • Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and BitLocker / Windows Device Encryption turned on
  • Mac: Apple MacBook / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported macOS version with FileVault enabled
  • Not permitted: Chromebooks (ChromeOS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)
Noise-canceling headset
Power and internet backup required

Rates and Expectations

  • Work Setup: Remote
  • Location: Philippines
  • Full-Time Role
  • Rate: 50,000 PHP - 51,000 PHP Monthly
  • Timezone: Eastern or Pacific

Benefits

  • Government-mandated benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG
  • Night differential pay
  • 13th month pay
  • Paid time off

Dedication

  • We need someone dedicated to working for this client only. If you have other full-time commitments that may conflict with business hours, please do not apply.
  • Subcontracting work to other virtual assistants is not allowed because of HIPAA compliance requirements.

If you're ready to take on this opportunity, please submit your application through our Careers Page. Only applications submitted through the career page form will be considered. Thank you.

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal macOS Systems & Security Engineer to join an international cybersecurity project focused on identity assurance, authentication, and enterprise endpoint security.

This is not a traditional macOS application development role.

You'll work much closer to the operating system, designing and evolving security-sensitive components that integrate deeply with macOS. The role involves systems programming, privileged processes, authentication, secure communication between components, cryptography, and enterprise endpoint deployment.

We're looking for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep knowledge of macOS internals and native security frameworks, and who is comfortable solving complex problems where reliability and security are critical.

As a Principal Engineer, you'll operate as a senior individual contributor, influencing architecture and technical direction while collaborating with Engineering, Security, Product, and other technical stakeholders.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and evolve low-level software components running on macOS.
  • Develop security-sensitive functionality related to authentication, identity, and endpoint protection.
  • Work with native macOS technologies including XPC, Launch Agents, Launch Daemons, Keychain, Authorization Services, and System Extensions.
  • Build and maintain privileged services and secure communication between application and system-level components.
  • Contribute to integrations with the Apple Endpoint Security Framework and other native security mechanisms.
  • Design software using Swift, Objective-C, C, and C++, depending on the component and technical requirements.
  • Develop and maintain authentication and credential-related capabilities.
  • Work with technologies and concepts such as FIDO2, WebAuthn, Passkeys, PAM, CryptoTokenKit, and certificate management.
  • Apply secure coding principles and cryptographic concepts when implementing authentication and identity workflows.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues using logs, diagnostics, debugging tools, and system-level analysis.
  • Design software capable of operating reliably across large enterprise endpoint environments.
  • Handle challenges related to installers, code signing, entitlements, permissions, upgrades, and enterprise software distribution.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical standards for macOS platform components.
  • Research new Apple APIs, operating system changes, and security mechanisms.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on complex platform-level problems.
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams on secure communication through REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, and network protocols.

What You Bring

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, ideally 10+ years, with significant hands-on work on macOS or similar systems-level environments.
  • Deep understanding of macOS internals, operating system behavior, processes, permissions, and security architecture.
  • Strong programming experience with Swift and/or Objective-C, combined with solid knowledge of C/C++.
  • Hands-on experience developing software beyond the traditional application layer.
  • Experience with macOS technologies such as:
    • XPC
    • Launch Agents
    • Launch Daemons
    • Keychain Services
    • Authorization Services
    • System Extensions
  • Strong knowledge of inter-process communication and privileged operations.
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting complex system-level software.
  • Understanding of authentication, identity, and secure credential management.
  • Solid knowledge of networking concepts including REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, and TCP communication.
  • Understanding of applied cryptography and common cryptographic primitives.
  • Experience building reliable software distributed across enterprise environments.
  • Strong ownership, autonomy, and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the Apple Endpoint Security Framework.
  • Experience with CryptoTokenKit or PAM modules.
  • Knowledge of FIDO2, WebAuthn, or Passkeys.
  • Experience with passwordless authentication or Identity Security products.
  • Experience building endpoint security, EDR, IAM, device management, or enterprise security products.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic algorithms and concepts such as RSA, Elliptic Curve cryptography, Diffie-Hellman, and AES.
  • Experience with certificate management.
  • Experience with enterprise macOS deployment and device management environments.
  • Knowledge of installers, package distribution, code signing, entitlements, and macOS application lifecycle management.

Crypto-Fiat Digital Banking Venture

Our client is a private investment group led by experienced technology entrepreneurs with a track record of launching and scaling international businesses.

The group is now preparing to launch a new crypto-fiat digital banking venture, designed to make digital assets easier to use alongside everyday financial services. The planned offering brings together crypto-to-fiat conversion, digital wallets, payment cards and bank payment solutions for B2B and B2C customers.

The business has investment backing, an existing technological foundation and experienced technical leadership. What it needs now is a product leader who can define what the business should build, why customers will choose it and how to bring it to market.

We are looking for a hands-on Chief Product Officer (CPO) with direct experience in crypto banking, crypto-fiat products or digital banking solutions involving digital assets, and a proven record of taking products from an early concept to successful launch and growth.

The Role

This is a business-building product role, not a position focused on maintaining an established roadmap.

You will take ownership of product vision, customer value proposition and roadmap, translating market insight and commercial priorities into an intuitive, competitive financial product. You will work closely with the CEO and the existing technology leadership, while building the product function needed for launch and scale.

We are interested in product leaders who can move from customer discovery to clear decisions and real outcomes, work effectively in a lean team and take personal responsibility for delivery and product performance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the product vision, positioning and roadmap for a new crypto-fiat digital banking business.
  • Identify customer needs, high-value use cases and product opportunities across B2B and B2C segments.
  • Prioritise the MVP and subsequent releases, balancing customer value, commercial potential, operational readiness and regulatory considerations.
  • Own product discovery, validation, user journeys and product requirements from concept through launch.
  • Shape experiences around digital wallets, crypto-fiat conversion, cards and payment services, with a strong focus on trust, simplicity and usability.
  • Set meaningful product metrics covering activation, conversion, engagement, retention and product-led revenue contribution.
  • Build and lead a focused product team and establish practical product-management processes.
  • Work in close partnership with commercial, operations and technology leaders to bring the product to market and improve it based on data and user feedback.
What We're Looking For
  • Proven senior product leadership experience in crypto banking, crypto-fiat financial products or digital banking products with meaningful digital-asset exposure.
  • A successful track record of launching a financial product from an early stage and improving adoption, retention or commercial performance.
  • Deep understanding of digital wallets, customer onboarding, crypto-fiat conversion, card products or payment experiences.
  • Strong product discovery, prioritisation, roadmap ownership and data-informed decision-making skills.
  • Commercial awareness, including the ability to connect product choices with customer acquisition, unit economics and business outcomes.
  • Experience recruiting, developing and leading high-performing product teams.
  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial approach: comfortable with ambiguity, quick decisions and accountability without a large corporate structure.

Above all, we are looking for a product leader who thinks like a founder: curious about customers, decisive about priorities and motivated to build something with real market impact.

What's on Offer
  • A product to build from the ground up:Define the proposition, customer experience and roadmap of a new international financial product.
  • Experienced investment backing: Work with established entrepreneurs and an existing technological foundation.
  • Meaningful autonomy: Shape product decisions, build your team and influence the direction of the business.
  • Flexible and competitive compensation:Our client is open to discussing an attractive, individually tailored package for candidates with an exceptional track record.
  • Participation in outcomes:Performance-based incentives, profit participation or equity arrangements will be discussed as part of an individually tailored compensation package.
  • International flexibility: Remote-first working arrangements, with Europe preferred and business travel as required.

Location: Remote (Europe preferred) | International travel as required

Salary: Negotiable / Flexible, depending on experience and profile

Interested?

If you have built and grown crypto-fiat or digital banking products and are excited by the opportunity to shape a new business from day one, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

Reach out to our Associate Partner at or via Telegram @tmalinouskaya to discuss more.

The Select Sales team is responsible for revenue growth in new and existing customers that represent the largest prospective accounts for Samsara by total addressable opportunity.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and requires living in the TOLA region.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales processes in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role with Enterprise customers
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting

An ideal candidate also has:

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

$350,000—$350,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

The IT Analyst — Business Analysis is responsible for analyzing business needs, evaluating technology requirements, and supporting the development and implementation of IT solutions that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements Gathering

  • Functional & Technical Requirements

  • Systems Analysis

  • Process Mapping

  • Use Cases & User Stories
