Requirements

ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.

Training. Left of Launch.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Member, Board of Advisors

Strategic advisor to a defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, an AI/ML-driven decision-rehearsal platform for UAS and counter-UAS preparedness.

Position Summary

The Board of Advisors provides Elessar’s leadership with practical guidance, market access, customer credibility, and domain insight as the company converts Q2 Holodeck™ pilots into recurring subscriptions. Advisors are selected for their ability to sharpen strategy, open relevant doors, test assumptions, strengthen customer confidence, and help the company navigate defense, homeland security, critical infrastructure, operational training, acquisition, and international markets.

This is an advisory role, not a seat on the Board of Directors. Advisors do not exercise corporate governance authority, supervise employees, bind the company, or assume fiduciary duties solely by serving on the Board of Advisors. Management retains decision-making responsibility and execution accountability.

About Elessar

Elessar is a newly formed defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training platform. The platform helps security, force-protection, and first-responder personnel identify a drone, select a lawful and effective response, and report the incident before a real event occurs. Elessar’s immediate commercial priority is to create a repeatable flow of clearly bounded pilots that demonstrate measurable value and convert into annual subscriptions, additional seats, scenarios, organizations, or enterprise deployments.

Purpose of the Board of Advisors

  • Provide focused, candid advice to the CEO and leadership team on strategy, positioning, market entry, partnerships, and risk.
  • Increase customer and partner confidence through credible, relevant experience and independent perspective.
  • Create targeted access to buyers, influencers, acquisition pathways, operational users, investors, and strategic partners.
  • Help Elessar distinguish urgent customer requirements from lower-priority product requests and organizational expansion.
  • Support the company’s first-revenue objective without adding a large fixed-cost structure.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Counsel (20%). Advise on market-entry sequence, business model, pricing and packaging, partnerships, capital strategy, and the path from early pilots to recurring revenue.
  • Market Access and Introductions (25%). Make selective, well-qualified introductions to decision-makers, operational leaders, acquisition officials, channel partners, prime contractors, investors, and other stakeholders relevant to agreed priorities.
  • Customer and Revenue Support (20%). Help leadership refine value propositions, prepare for executive meetings, validate pilot offers, interpret buyer needs, and convert successful engagements into repeatable sales and renewal pathways.
  • Domain and Product Insight (15%). Provide real-world insight into counter-UAS, force protection, critical infrastructure, readiness, training, test and evaluation, government acquisition, or international market requirements. Distinguish fielded capability from future roadmap concepts.
  • Partnership and Reputation Support (10%). Identify high-value partners, strengthen market credibility, and represent Elessar appropriately at selected industry, customer, or policy engagements when requested and agreed.
  • Risk, Ethics, and Compliance Perspective (10%). Surface strategic, reputational, security, export-control, government-sales, conflict-of-interest, and execution risks. Protect confidential information and avoid commitments on behalf of Elessar without written authority.

Advisory Profiles Sought

ADVISORY PROFILE & VALUE TO ELESSAR

Counter-UAS and Homeland Security Advisor

A respected former DHS, NORTHCOM, FAA, CBP, military, or law-enforcement leader who understands authorities, readiness, operational adoption, and customer priorities.

Critical Infrastructure Advisor

A senior airport, port, utility, energy, public-safety, corrections, or protective-security executive who can guide use cases, pilot design, and buyer access.

Training and Readiness Advisor

An expert in operational exercises, learning systems, military readiness, scenario-based training, after-action review, or measurable training effectiveness.

Government Growth and Acquisition Advisor

A relationship-rich leader who understands access and acquisition across DHS, DoD, DOE/NNSA, State/DSCA, and relevant state and local buyers.

International Growth Advisor

A leader with trusted relationships and practical experience supporting defense, security, or government technology sales in priority international markets.

Expected Contributions and Success Measures

OBJECTIVES & HOW SUCCESS IS EVALUATED

Priority access

Introductions are relevant, prepared, and tied to named accounts, funded entry points, or strategic partnerships.

Commercial progress

Advice and access help move prospects from engagement to demonstration, pilot, documented outcomes, and subscription or expansion decisions.

Strategic quality

Management receives candid, actionable guidance that improves positioning, prioritization, partnership choices, and risk management.

Credibility

Advisor participation measurably strengthens confidence among customers, partners, investors, or other stakeholders.

Engagement discipline

Advisor participates consistently, prepares for meetings, follows through on agreed actions, and promptly identifies conflicts or constraints.

Qualifications

Required

  • Senior leadership experience in a field directly relevant to Elessar’s customers, markets, technology, acquisition pathways, training mission, or capital strategy.
  • Demonstrated judgment, credibility, and reputation for ethical conduct.
  • A relevant network and willingness to make selective introductions where there is a clear fit.
  • Ability to provide direct, independent advice while respecting management accountability and Board of Directors authority.
  • Ability to protect confidential, proprietary, customer, security-sensitive, and export-controlled information.
  • No unresolved conflict of interest that would impair objective advice or Elessar’s customer relationships.

Preferred

  • Experience with UAS, counter-UAS, air defense, force protection, homeland security, critical infrastructure, operational readiness, simulation, or SaaS.
  • Experience selling to, buying for, or delivering within U.S. federal, defense, public-safety, critical-infrastructure, or allied-government markets.
  • Familiarity with government acquisition, contracting pathways, technology adoption, operational pilots, or non-dilutive funding.
  • Experience helping an early-stage company secure first revenue, build a repeatable pipeline, raise capital, or scale recurring revenue.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strategic judgment. Separates immediate revenue and mission priorities from attractive but premature expansion.
  • Commercial orientation. Understands that the near-term test is whether pilots convert into annual subscriptions and expansion.
  • Executive communication. Communicates clearly with customers, operators, technical teams, investors, and government stakeholders.
  • Technical and operational literacy. Can assess customer relevance without overstating fielded functionality or making unsupported commitments.
  • Relationship stewardship. Uses networks carefully, prepare both sides for introductions, and protect trust.
  • Independence. Challenges assumptions constructively and provides candid advice even when it is not the easiest answer.

Operating Expectations

  • Meeting cadence. Participate in quarterly advisory meetings and targeted working sessions as agreed.
  • Preparation. Review concise briefing materials in advance and come prepared with specific advice, introductions, or decisions for management consideration.
  • Introductions. Coordinate external outreach with the CEO or designated executive. Advisors may not represent that they can bind Elessar.
  • Confidentiality and IP. Execute appropriate confidentiality and invention/IP documents and safeguard all nonpublic information.
  • Conflicts. Disclose actual or potential conflicts promptly and recuse when appropriate.
  • Public statements. Do not speak publicly for Elessar, use its name or marks, or announce the advisory relationship without authorization.

Compensation

Compensation may be structured as equity, a retainer, success-based compensation, or a combination, depending on the advisor’s expected contribution and applicable legal, ethics, procurement, and conflict-of-interest requirements. Any compensation, vesting, expense reimbursement, performance conditions, and post-service obligations will be documented in a separate written advisory agreement approved by Elessar.

Relationship to Corporate Governance

The Board of Advisors is separate from Elessar’s Board of Directors. Its recommendations are non-binding. Advisors do not vote on corporate matters, approve budgets, appoint or supervise officers, direct employees, or exercise fiduciary authority unless separately appointed to the Board of Directors or another formal role through appropriate corporate action.

Equal Opportunity and Professional Conduct

Elessar expects every advisor to uphold high standards of integrity, respect, confidentiality, nondiscrimination, and lawful conduct in all company-related activities. Reasonable accommodations are available where applicable.

ELESSAR · TRAINING. LEFT OF LAUNCH.

This position description summarizes the advisory role. It is not an employment agreement, a director appointment, or an exhaustive statement of responsibilities.

About Magic

Backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, Magic has spent 10+ years connecting fast-growing businesses with top remote talent.

Role Overview

This is a full-time, in-house, permanent role with full benefits. You'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on the company's behalf, not a VA placed with a client. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need remote workers to deliver real ROI, and they need a strategic partner to make that happen. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn happy clients into loud advocates. The pace is live and constant: client calls, escalations, and account health across a real portfolio, every single day, with no handoffs and no delays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Guard your book of business: own a portfolio of accounts sorted by size, health, and growth potential, and hold 90%+ gross revenue retention (GRR) and 110%+ net revenue retention (NRR). Those are the numbers you're graded on.
  • Spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word. Start renewals 60–90 days out, and get save plans moving early.
  • Launch every new client fast: kickoff call within 24–48 hours of signing, then Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework, with a success plan tied to their business goals and an intro to their remote worker.
  • Host quarterly business reviews (QBRs) clients actually look forward to: data-driven, strategic, action-oriented. Become the trusted advisor to founders and C-suite, and multi-thread across each client so one champion leaving doesn't sink the account.
  • Hunt expansion opportunities and make the business case before anyone asks.
  • Surface the story in the data: track churn risk and expansion signals, keep HubSpot clean, send a monthly portfolio health report (retention, NRR, CSAT, NPS, QBR completion), and own every escalation from intake to resolution.

Qualifications Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of B2B customer success or account management experience, juggling a portfolio of accounts at the same time
  • Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal
  • Background in SaaS/tech, outsourcing/staffing, professional services/BPO, or marketplace platforms
  • HubSpot experience used daily for pipeline and account health (intermediate-to-expert Salesforce or a similar CRM also works)
  • Intermediate-to-advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis
  • Real US market experience: you know US business culture, SMB challenges, and how executives like to communicate
  • Strong written and spoken English, good enough for daily conversations with US-based C-level and Director clients
  • A professional home office: high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet space

Why You'll Be a Great Fit

You treat customer success as a revenue function, not a help desk. You own the outcome, so you don't wait to be told an account is wobbling; you've already spotted it, and your save plan is moving. You're comfortable in a room with a founder or a C-suite exec, and you can plow through a messy escalation without losing the relationship. You read the data, find the story, and walk into every QBR with a point of view. You pitch expansion because the numbers back it up, not because a quota told you to. When something breaks, you adapt, get the right people in the room, and keep going.

Application + pre-qualifying questions → HR interview (45 min) → 24-hour reflection period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → interview with CS Director → Final Interview with the Head of Sales CS → Job Offer

Compensation Benefits

₱60,000–₱80,000 gross per month, permanent and full-time, fully remote (Philippines). HMO coverage after regularization, 12 vacation days and 10 sick days a year, 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and PAG-IBIG. We offer paid training and promote from within: top CSMs move into Senior CSM, Team Lead / CS Manager, and CS Director roles.

Why Magic?

We're an ambitious, driven team that plows through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. There's no hierarchy and no politics: you can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything. We respect each other's time, and we actually like working together. jobs.title: Major and Planned Giving Officer
jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about climate change and environmental justice?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about climate change and environmental justice?

Join Earthworks’ 6-person philanthropy team in raising $8M+ annually from foundations and individual donors to support Earthworks’ mission.

We are looking for someone who has high quality standards and pays strong attention to every detail of your work. You should have a successful track record with helping donors to fulfill their passions through giving to nonprofit organizations. If you are a self-motivated strong communicator and great listener who understands the importance of teamwork while being able to collaborate effectively with other staff across the organization, this may be the role for you.

The Major and Planned Giving Officer (“MPGO”) supports the Philanthropy Director, staff and board members to build strong donor relationships and secure the resources that advance Earthworks’ mission. The MPGO provides opportunities for donors to fulfill their philanthropic interests and passions, encourages them to give, and makes sure that as many as possible are retained and upgraded in their giving and involvement over time.

This position plays a central role in:

  • Major Gifts

    • Qualify caseload of donors from larger group of Earthworks donors and manage a portfolio 75-100 people, with a goal of raising $700-1M+ annually

    • Create individual goals for each donor on the caseload based on the donor’s giving history and Earthworks’ knowledge of that donor’s potential

    • Create a cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plan for each donor that takes into account the individual donor’s passions, interests, motivations, giving patterns and ask preferences so that individuals are retained and upgraded over time

    • Secure from program and communications staff appropriate project information, including budgets, and create offers, proposals, and asks that will be used with donors on the caseload to secure gifts and report back on how their giving is making a difference

    • Perform other major donor activities as needed, including reporting on caseload activity and performance

  • Planned Giving

    • Develop a comprehensive planned giving program, strategy, revenue goals, and supporting collateral

    • Build a strong planned giving prospect pipeline from Earthworks’ supporter base

    • Manage a portfolio of prospects, including creating and implementing a plan for each person on the caseload driven by the donor’s passions and interests while addressing their estate and financial planning needs

    • Develop creative prospect engagement strategies, including a legacy society structure

    • Implement a stewardship strategy for donors who have pledged to leave a legacy

    • Build expert knowledge of the range of planned giving vehicles and secure partnerships to manage complex financial instruments

    • Prepare gift proposals, sample bequest language, gift agreements, and maintain relevant compliance documentation

    • Secure planned gifts that lead to revenue growth and Earthworks’ long term financial sustainability

  • Culture of philanthropy

    • Identify opportunities to grow staff and board members’ philanthropic networks and bring new high value prospects to the organization

    • Coach board and staff members to build their skills to develop strong donor relationships throughout the gift cycle

    • Develop donor engagement and stewardship opportunities such as webinars and events that deepen connection to the mission

    • Make periodic presentations and conduct trainings on topics related to major and planned giving

    • Participate in strategic planning related to fundraising and support the philanthropy team as needed to meet overall revenue goals

The Major and Planned Giving Offer (MPGO) reports directly to the Philanthropy Director.

About Earthworks

Earthworks is a nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting communities and the environment from the adverse impacts of mineral and energy development while promoting sustainable solutions. Earthworks stands for clean air, water, and land, healthy communities, and corporate accountability. We work for solutions that protect both the Earth’s resources and our communities. Earthworks has a primarily-remote staff of approximately 50 employees in over 20 states and DC.

Earthworks is committed to challenging and dismantling systemic oppression. Earthworks’ board and staff understand that promoting diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) both within and beyond Earthworks is critical to carrying out our mission to protect communities and the environment from the adverse impacts of resource extraction. We understand that our commitment to DEI means a dedication to constant learning and improvement.

Earthworks welcomes applications from diverse candidates and is an equal-opportunity employer. Earthworks evaluates employees and applicants for employment on merit, competence, and qualifications and does not tolerate discrimination.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Earthworks we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 10 years+ experience in major gifts and planned giving

  • A strong track record of relationship building through the whole cycle of donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship

  • Expertise in the area of charitable gift planning, including some knowledge of gift structures and financial planning concepts

  • Excellent writing and editing skills that show an attention to detail, an ability to tell a story, and facility with synthesizing complex information into clear and engaging materials for donor audiences

  • Strong verbal skills and emotional intelligence, with an ability to ask questions, listen, empathize and give and receive constructive feedback

  • Organized and able to handle multiple simultaneous deadlines

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently, including in a virtual office environment

  • Sound judgement and discretion in handling confidential donor information and a commitment to maintaining high ethical standards

  • Able to anticipate and solve problems, with a learning orientation that aims for continuous improvement

  • Able to work effectively both independently and in collaboration with others

  • Experience with CRMs in donor management, preferably Salesforce, and familiarity with prospect research tools such as iwave/Kindsight

  • Comfort and competency in an Apple computing environment using Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, and Trello (or other project management software)

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Masters preferred

  • Experience qualifying donor leads and developing donor pipelines

  • Experience fundraising for 501(c)4s

  • Strong knowledge of financial and legal requirements of planned giving

  • Demonstrated experience working with mature populations

  • Proven track record of implementation of strategies and plans to substantially increase revenue through planned giving vehicles

  • Strong public speaking skills

  • Demonstrated success in forging strong working relationships and building trust with donors and colleagues.

  • Ability to travel to visit donors (4-6 trips within the US annually), for in-person staff meetings as needed, and occasional evening or weekend work

Location and Travel

Location for this position is remote in the United States, and applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Some travel may be required for certain positions. Employees who are unable to travel/attend in-person meetings for health or disability reasons may request accommodations.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $100,000-115,000 annually, depending on experience. This is the true hiring range, thoughtfully created in consideration of budget and pay equity, and it’s not negotiable. Earthworks provides full-time staff with a competitive package of benefits, including employer-paid medical, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance. Additionally, Earthworks offers unlimited paid leave, paid parental leave, and a 403(b) retirement plan (with a 5% match after one year of employment). After five years of employment, staff are eligible for a 12 week, fully paid sabbatical.

Bargaining Unit Status

Earthworks is a union workplace; our employees are represented by Earthworkers Unite/ Industrial Workers of the World (IWW). This position is included in the bargaining unit.

How to Apply

We strongly encourage and seek applications from people of color, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, people with disabilities, and bilingual individuals. Reasonable accommodations will be made so that applicants with disabilities may participate in the application and interview process. Please advise in writing of special needs at the time of application.

Apply online at , including a cover letter, resume, and relevant writing sample. No emails or phone calls please. Applications will be accepted until Sunday, November 15th.

Qualified applicants can expect to complete three interview stages: an initial phone interview, a virtual panel interview, and a virtual final interview. After the second stage of the interview process, we’ll request a list of three professional references, and ask candidates to complete a relevant work exercise.

jobs.description:
IT Helpdesk Engineer - Level 1

Managed IT Services Division

POSITION OVERVIEW

Ocean Tide is seeking L1 IT Helpdesk Engineers to provide first-line remote technical support for US-based enterprise customers. You will be the first point of contact for end users, handling tickets via our NinjaOne platform, resolving common issues, and escalating complex problems to L2. This is a remote helpdesk role supporting Microsoft 365 environments with a focus on fast resolution and excellent customer communication.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as first point of contact for all incoming IT support tickets and requests
  • Provide remote troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals
  • Manage and administer Microsoft 365 user accounts (password resets, license assignments, mailbox permissions, Teams/SharePoint access)
  • Perform basic Active Directory tasks (account unlocks, group membership changes, password resets)
  • Triage and categorize incoming tickets by priority and type
  • Resolve L1 issues within SLA targets (password resets, software installs, connectivity issues, email configuration)
  • Provide basic troubleshooting for customer business applications (ERP, CRM, industry-specific software, web-based platforms)
  • Assist with software installation, configuration, updates, and license management for standard and customer-specific applications
  • Escalate unresolved issues to L2 with clear documentation of troubleshooting steps taken
  • Document all interactions and resolutions in NinjaOne ticketing system
  • Assist with new hire onboarding (account creation, email setup, software provisioning)
  • Assist with employee offboarding (account disabling, license recovery, access removal)
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks for common issue resolution
  • Monitor RMM alerts and respond to automated notifications from NinjaOne
  • Maintain knowledge base articles for recurring issues
  • Log and track all work in ticketing/PSA systems (NinjaOne Ticketing, HaloPSA, or similar)

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 1 year experience in IT remote helpdesk or technical support role
  • Hands-on experience managing Microsoft 365 environments (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID)
  • Basic understanding of Active Directory (user accounts, groups, OUs, GPO basics)
  • Experience with remote desktop tools and remote troubleshooting
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows 10/11 operating systems
  • Ability to learn and troubleshoot new software applications quickly (business apps, web platforms, industry-specific tools)
  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN connectivity)
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) - supporting US-based end users
  • Customer-first attitude with patience and professionalism
  • Ability to work independently in a remote or co-located team environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with NinjaOne RMM platform (administration, ticketing, remote access)
  • Experience with ticketing/ITSM/PSA systems (NinjaOne Ticketing, HaloPSA, Freshdesk, Zendesk, ConnectWise, Autotask, or similar)
  • Familiarity with endpoint security tools (antivirus, EDR/XDR concepts)
  • Experience supporting Mac OS in addition to Windows
  • Basic Linux familiarity (navigation, file management, service restarts)
  • Prior BPO or offshore IT support experience serving US clients
  • Experience with VoIP/phone system support

CERTIFICATIONS

  • Required: None (but entry-level IT certifications strongly preferred)
  • Preferred: CompTIA A+, CompTIA IT Fundamentals (ITF+), Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals (MS-900), ITIL Foundation

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

  • Primary Platform: NinjaOne RMM (endpoint management, ticketing, remote access, patch management)
  • PSA/Ticketing: NinjaOne Ticketing, HaloPSA (or equivalent PSA platform)
  • Core Environment: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID)
  • OS Support: Windows 10/11 (primary), Mac OS (secondary), Linux (basic awareness)
  • Security: Endpoint security / XDR / EDR platforms (awareness level)
  • Networking: Basic DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN connectivity troubleshooting
  • Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, email-based ticket communication

jobs.excerpt: About NscaleNscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI.
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centers, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Controls & Networks team sets the standards that keep every facility in our fleet monitored, controlled, and reliable, from the device layer to the operator's screen. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

As Controls Director, you will be the functional authority for controls engineering across Nscale's data center fleet. You'll own the standards for BMS/BAS and EPMS, steward our SCADA and HMI platforms, set the rules for alarm and telemetry consistency, lead commissioning discipline, and drive our Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DMfA) program.

Our controls strategy rests on one principle: structured diversity at the device layer, and uncompromising consistency at the HMI, SCADA, alarm, and telemetry layers. Your job is to turn that principle into enforceable standards and acceptance criteria, and to build the specialist team that verifies them on every site.

This is a standards-and-governance leadership role. Regional Project Directors deliver projects; you decide what good looks like and develop the people who check it. You'll report to the VP, Controls & Networks, and lead a directorate that brings together SCADA and controls SMEs, MEP specialists, Commissioning Managers, and engineering staff. The role covers the Americas, with travel across regions as required.

Your directorate works alongside, not over, Nscale's Design teams, who hold architectural, mechanical, and base-build design authority; your SMEs are embedded with them as standing reviewers. DC Operations handles day-to-day maintenance of operating controls, and Systems Engineering owns tools and data once data leaves the site.

What You'll be Doing

Standards and Platform Authority

  • Own the controls standards library: control narratives and sequences, alarm management (ISA-18.2), high-performance HMI (ISA-101), master points lists, and telemetry and MQTT/Sparkplug B conventions.
  • Own the Skid-to-Master Interface Specification and make it a mandatory exhibit on packaged-equipment purchase orders.
  • Steward the SCADA platform portfolio, including Ignition as our delivery basis, and lead platform evolution through a gated qualification program while incumbent platforms remain supported.
  • Rule on controls standards deviations through a formal review process, ensuring no deviation reaches field execution without a decision or escalation.

Change Management and Operations Support

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAtrium is a YouTube channel focused on bringing history to life through immersive visual storytelling, from exploring Hitler’s final hours to recreating the conditions of Auschwitz.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Atrium is a YouTube channel focused on bringing history to life through immersive visual storytelling, from exploring Hitler’s final hours to recreating the conditions of Auschwitz.

We’re looking for a full-time 3D Layout Artist to help shape the visual direction of our content through cinematic scene composition, camera operation, and storytelling.

This is a highly creative role for someone who thinks visually and understands how camera work can transform a script into an engaging viewing experience. You’ll work closely with the Channel Director to translate scripts into compelling 3D layouts and animatics, defining camera movement, scene composition, pacing, and the overall visual tone of each video.

Your work will serve as the blueprint for the animation team, ensuring every scene is thoughtfully composed, visually clear, and intentional before moving into full production.

What You’ll Be Obsessed About

Making every scene work visually.

You understand that great storytelling isn't just about what happens on screen, but how the audience experiences it. You think about camera angles, movement, composition, pacing, character posing, and transitions, always looking for ways to make each moment clearer, more cinematic, and more engaging.

You’re always thinking:

“How can I make this scene more compelling through composition, camera work, and staging?”

And then you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

  • Interpret scripts and translate them into clear, compelling 3D layouts and animatics.
  • Operate virtual cameras to establish framing, camera movement, shot composition, and transitions.
  • Define the visual flow of each scene, including timing, pacing, spatial relationships, and continuity.
  • Handle animation blocking and character posing to establish clear actions, staging, and storytelling beats.
  • Collaborate closely with the Channel Director to develop and refine the visual storytelling approach.
  • Build scenes and layouts in Unreal Engine, preparing environments and assets for review and production.
  • Explore creative camera techniques and visual solutions to communicate complex historical events, environments, and concepts.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized layouts and animatics that give animators a strong foundation for production.
  • Prepare and organize scenes, assets, and project files within a hands-on production pipeline that requires careful manual setup and coordination.
  • Review outputs, incorporate feedback, and refine layouts to meet the creative vision.
  • Maintain consistency and continuity across scenes while keeping project files and assets accessible to the team.

About You

  • Several years of experience in 3D layout, animation, camera work, or a related role in YouTube, film, or television production.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine, ideally version 5.6.1.
  • Strong understanding of cinematic language, including composition, framing, camera movement, timing, and transitions.
  • Experience with animation blocking and character posing, with an understanding of how staging and body language support storytelling.
  • A good eye for visual storytelling and the ability to translate scripts into clear, engaging sequences.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage assets, scenes, and project files independently in a hands-on production environment.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and able to communicate clearly in a fast-moving production environment.
  • Comfortable working independently, solving visual challenges, and incorporating feedback without losing sight of the overall creative vision.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of Blender for 3D scene preparation or related tasks.
  • Experience managing or contributing to 3D animation pipelines.
  • Understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, and viewer engagement.
  • Interest in storytelling psychology and audience behavior.
  • Experience working on documentaries, historical content, or educational entertainment.
  • Willingness to contribute across different stages of production when needed.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You think in shots and sequences, naturally translating ideas into visual compositions.
  • You understand how camera movement, framing, and character posing can create tension, establish scale, and guide the viewer's attention.
  • You balance cinematic ambition with practical production needs.
  • You care about pacing, rhythm, continuity, and the purpose behind every shot.
  • You actively study great visual storytelling across films, documentaries, and digital content.
  • You bring creative ideas and visual solutions, not just execution.
  • You know when a scene needs a complex camera move and when a simple, well-composed shot tells the story better.
  • You take ownership of your work and keep assets, scenes, and files organized without needing constant supervision.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a growing YouTube channel, working on stories that bring history and complex subjects to life through immersive 3D environments and cinematic storytelling.

Your work will directly influence how each story is experienced, from the first camera setup to the final animation, helping establish the visual foundation for every video we produce.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Commercial & Financial Acumen

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

jobs.description:
Be the person who handles it, so nobody has to think about it again.

HIP is looking for a Partner Support Specialist: someone who takes a problem, owns it, fixes it end to end, and tells everyone it's done before they have to ask. If you know HighLevel inside and out and you write a clean, professional email, we want to talk to you.

This is not a ticket-processing role.

HIP automates a large and growing share of routine work. The remaining work takes judgment: closing exceptions automation can't, checking automated output before it reaches a practice, keeping partners informed, and knowing the platform well enough to diagnose a broken workflow without waiting on someone else. The best fit has supported HighLevel for real customers, ideally in an agency or SaaS environment. Exposure to orthodontic or dental practices is a strong plus.

As a Partner Support Specialist, you'll own the support experience for a book of about 550 orthodontic and dental practices. You'll work alongside the Practice Growth Advisors who own each relationship, taking the operational and platform work off their plate so they can focus on growth.

If teammates hand things to you because they know you will get it done, this role was built for you.

What you’ll do

  • Own requests from intake to verified resolution: diagnose, decide, execute, confirm the outcome, and post a written close-out.
  • Handle transactional partner work, so Practice Growth Advisors don't have to, including user and team member changes, phone and call-connect issues, lead notification routing, and access changes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot PracticeBeacon, our HighLevel-based CRM platform: workflows, triggers, forms, pipelines, phone setup, and 10DLC/A2P registration.
  • Diagnose broken automations and integrations, including call tracking, Google, Meta, and reporting connections.
  • Review and approve automated output before it reaches partners, such as review responses, patient lists, and report errors, and confirm scheduled automation actually ran.
  • Deliver reactivation, review, and reputation campaigns, QR codes, and campaign landing page requests on the committed date, and own whether they worked.
  • Triage web and design requests from the partner help inbox: submit them complete, track them through the web and design teams, QA the result, and confirm completion.
  • Communicate directly with partners on support and platform questions, keeping the Practice Growth Advisor copied throughout.
  • Share status before anyone asks: what is happening, what is blocked, who owns it, and when it will be resolved.
  • Keep partner data flowing correctly between PracticeBeacon, AgencyAnalytics, and internal dashboards, and fix discrepancies at the source.
  • Surface recurring failures to the Product team and propose what should be automated next.
  • Document every new fix or setup path as a reusable SOP.

Who we're looking for

  • You close the loop and report the outcome without being asked twice.
  • You can decide what to do when a situation doesn't match the playbook, and explain your call afterward.
  • You write partner-ready emails that are correct, complete, professional, and clear to a practice owner.
  • You read documentation and reason from symptom to root cause, even in a system you haven't seen before.
  • You escalate with a diagnosis and a recommendation, not just a problem.
  • You work independently against SLAs and set your own priorities.
  • You're comfortable being measured and having your work reviewed.
  • You use AI tools to remove your own repetitive work.
  • You're responsive and treat internal teammates with the same level of service as partners.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.

What you need to have

  • 2+ years supporting a CRM, marketing platform, or SaaS product in an agency or customer-facing role.
  • Hands-on HighLevel/GoHighLevel experience (workflows, automations, forms, triggers, pipelines, phone and messaging registration). This is required.
  • Working knowledge of ClickUp, AgencyAnalytics, Google and Meta business platforms, and call tracking. Integration and API literacy preferred.
  • Excellent written communication, with strong attention to detail and organization.
  • Proven ability to manage a queue against service levels with prompt, consistent responses.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésLa mission porte sur le pilotage et la mise en œuvre d’un programme de gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM) dans le cadre de NIS2.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

La mission porte sur le pilotage et la mise en œuvre d’un programme de gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM) dans le cadre de NIS2. Vous intervenez sur la gouvernance, les analyses de risques fournisseurs et l’intégration du dispositif dans les processus de l’organisation.

1. Finalisation du cadrage et de la gouvernance

  • Poursuivre la définition du modèle de gouvernance TPRM et accompagner l’adoption des rôles et responsabilités associés.
  • Contribuer à la formalisation de la politique, de la procédure et du framework de gestion des risques liés aux tiers.
  • Évaluer le niveau de conformité aux exigences applicables de NIS2 et de CyFun® et contribuer à la priorisation des actions de mise en conformité.
  • Définir et structurer les outils nécessaires au dispositif : inventaire des fournisseurs, critères de criticité, questionnaires d’impact et de maturité, registre des risques, plans d’action et supports de reporting.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement et le reporting auprès du CISO et des instances de gouvernance.

2. Préparation et mise en œuvre du dispositif

  • Contribuer à l’inventaire des fournisseurs critiques ainsi qu’à l’évaluation de leur criticité et de leurs dépendances métier et IT.
  • Mener ou accompagner les analyses de risques fournisseurs, formaliser les risques et suivre les plans de traitement et de remédiation.
  • Définir une approche proportionnée pour l’évaluation et le monitoring des tiers, en fonction de leur niveau de criticité et de risque.
  • Contribuer à la définition et à l’intégration des exigences de sécurité dans les processus d’achats, de projets et de contractualisation.
  • Accompagner le déploiement du dispositif sur des périmètres pilotes, notamment au moyen d’analyses de risques, de comités fournisseurs, de collectes d’évidences et, le cas échéant, d’audits ciblés.
  • Tirer les enseignements des pilotes afin d’améliorer le modèle de gouvernance, les méthodes et l’outillage.

3. Passage à l’échelle et coordination transverse

  • Préparer l’extension progressive du dispositif aux autres fournisseurs critiques, puis aux fournisseurs sensibles et aux nouveaux marchés, selon le périmètre retenu pour le dispositif.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, Protection des données, Projets, Processus et CISO afin d’ancrer le TPRM dans les processus existants et les nouveaux marchés.
  • Animer les ateliers, les entretiens et les comités avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs.
  • Préparer des synthèses claires sur l’avancement, les décisions attendues, les risques, les plans d’action et les points ouverts.
  • Contribuer à la formation et à la sensibilisation des parties prenantes afin de pérenniser le dispositif.

📝 Votre profil

  • Maîtrise de NIS2 et du référentiel CyFun® ou de NIST CSF.
  • Expérience des pratiques de gestion des risques liés aux tiers sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie fournisseur.
  • Expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie ou des infrastructures critiques.
  • Expérience de la coordination avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, métiers et IT/Sécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable dans l’analyse, notamment dans l’analyse des risques de sécurité de l’information.
  • Expérience démontrable en conseil ou en gestion GRC en cybersécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable en pilotage de programmes ou de projets de sécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable en tant que consultant en sécurité.
  • Expérience dans le suivi des plans de traitement et de remédiation des risques.
  • Expérience en évaluation de maturité ou de conformité sur la base d’un référentiel de contrôles.
  • Français niveau C2.
  • Expérience dans l’animation d’ateliers et de comités ainsi que dans le reporting auprès d’instances de pilotage.
  • Expérience avec la méthodologie EBIOS.
  • Expérience démontrable des techniques ou cadres de gestion de la sécurité, tels que les séries ISO 27000, COBIT for Security, NIST, OWASP ou CIS Critical Security Controls for Effective Cyber Defense.
  • Expérience dans la définition ou l’utilisation d’outils GRC, notamment pour l’inventaire des fournisseurs et le suivi des risques.
  • Anglais niveau B2.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. ​

  • Your CV

jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

We are expanding our Snowflake capability within the Data and AI practice, and we are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical side of it.

You will be in front of customers from the start, qualifying opportunities, running technical discovery with customer architects and data leaders, designing target platforms, and owning the technical win. Most of the work in front of us is focused on platform build-out and migration, helping enterprises consolidate onto Snowflake from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, and other established estates. This is where we need the strongest expertise.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over what we build and sell. It is ideal for someone who wants to shape a capability rather than operate within one that is already established.

Role Description

Own the Technical Side of Snowflake Pursuits

  • Lead qualification, discovery, target architecture design, effort and risk sizing, and development of technical content for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

  • Build and maintain technical relationships with customer architects and technical stakeholders.

  • Provide accurate assessments of migration effort, complexity, and risk, helping customers understand the true scope of their transformation initiatives.

Provide Architectural Oversight Through Delivery

  • Review architecture decisions throughout delivery.

  • Ensure the delivered solution aligns with what was originally scoped and proposed.

  • Identify and address risks or issues early in the project lifecycle.

  • Remain engaged in delivery to maintain accountability for the technical solution and outcomes.

Shape Snowflake Service Offerings

  • Define the technical content of Snowflake-focused service offerings.

  • Establish service scope, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.

  • Determine what evidence demonstrates successful delivery.

  • Create repeatable frameworks and standards that delivery teams can execute consistently.

Partner with Snowflake

  • Collaborate directly with Snowflake field teams and specialist architects on joint customer engagements.

  • Build productive relationships with vendor teams while representing the organization’s technical perspective.

  • Effectively navigate technical challenges, feedback, and differing viewpoints from Snowflake architects and specialists

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Willingness to Learn: Can apply new learning to daily work, encourage and facilitate learning in others, and actively make changes to work based on feedback.

  • Self-Development: Can demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and adaptability to new ideas and methods.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can use advanced analytical techniques to solve complex problems, draw insights, and communicate the solutions effectively.

  • Prioritization: Can take ownership of complex task management, collaborate with others to align priorities, and drive team efficiency.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.

  • Organization: Can oversee complex projects with multiple moving parts, ensure team alignment with organizational systems, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, influence others, and support others in developing their interpersonal skills in major situations.

Skill Level Requirements

Platform and Architecture

  • Account and environment design

  • Warehouse and compute architecture

  • Open table format strategy

  • Connectivity and data residency design

  • Cost architecture decisions that impact long-term scalability and affordability

The ability to design platforms that remain operationally and financially sustainable at scale is critical.

Migration and Consolidation

  • Migrating enterprises from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, appliance platforms, and increasingly other cloud data warehouses

  • Assessments and migration planning

  • Wave planning and execution

  • Schema and workload conversion

  • Reconciliation and parity validation

  • Cutover planning and execution

Experience extracting data from tightly licensed ERP environments is highly valuable, including understanding:

  • Inherited semantic layers

  • Data extraction challenges

  • Commercial licensing considerations

This represents the largest body of work anticipated for the practice and requires genuine expertise rather than general familiarity.

Data Engineering and Pipelines

  • Data ingestion

  • Data transformation

  • Pipeline orchestration

  • Testing frameworks

  • Data quality instrumentation

  • Building reliable, production-ready engineering processes rather than proof-of-concept implementations

Semantic and Context Layer

Experience designing and implementing:

  • Consistent business definitions that can be used across the organization

  • Shared semantic layers consumable by people, BI tools, and AI agents

  • Enterprise data models that ensure consistency across downstream consumers

This is an area of increasing investment within Snowflake and an area where many customers require significant guidance.

Governance at the Perimeter

Experience with:

  • Data classification

  • Access policies

  • Data masking

  • Lineage management

Candidates should understand how Snowflake governance integrates with enterprise governance frameworks and be able to address governance challenges that cross platform boundaries.

Consumption Economics

Strong understanding of:

  • Credit consumption management

  • Warehouse sizing

  • Workload placement strategies

  • Cost optimization and monitoring

Candidates must be able to speak confidently with customers about platform costs and provide practical guidance on maintaining cost efficiency.

Technical Depth Expectations

Candidates do not need to be equally strong across all six areas; however, they must possess:

  • Deep expertise in platform architecture

  • Deep expertise in migration and consolidation

  • Deep expertise in data engineering

  • Sufficient proficiency across the remaining areas to identify when specialist support is needed

Other Requirements

Snowflake Expertise

  • Substantial hands-on Snowflake experience gained through:

    • A Snowflake partner organization

    • Snowflake directly

    • Managing a significant Snowflake environment internally

  • This role requires Snowflake-specific expertise rather than general data platform leadership experience.

Enterprise Migration Experience

  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale migration and consolidation initiatives.

  • Ability to discuss at least one major migration engagement in detail, including lessons learned and outcomes.

  • Experience moving data from SAP and Oracle environments is particularly valuable.

Principal-Level Technical Leadership

  • Demonstrated success operating at Principal Architect level or equivalent.

  • Recognized as the senior technical authority in customer engagements.

  • Trusted to commit organizations to technical approaches, architectures, and delivery scopes.

Presales Experience

  • Delivery leadership experience with demonstrated ability to:

    • Lead customer discussions

Vendor Collaboration

  • Comfortable collaborating with and being challenged by vendor architects and technical specialists.

Certifications

※後半に日本語の説明があります

C# software engineering position in a highly-growing startup, developing a document IDE for non-engineers.

About BoostDraft

BoostDraft is a software engineering company that develops IDE for documents. It was founded by MIT and Stanford grad students, developing an assisted document editor for documents. It is a new document editor that employs error checking, reference checking and auto-completion using both rule-based approach and NLP, like what coding editors/IDE (e.g. VSCode, Pycharm) do.

Please find more information here:

Background & Traction

We are currently focusing on Lawyers who draft relatively standardized but long documents, such as contracts. With only four years after our product launch, we already have more than 10,000 active paid users. We have several long-term, large-scale contracts with famed enterprises and law firms. As a result, we achieved significant success, including profitability and exponential growth, all without relying on external funding for nearly four years.

BoostDraft was accepted by prestigious accelerator program, MassChallenge (Top 30 US accelerator), StartX (Stanford Accelerator, 7% acceptance rate), MIT Sandbox (Accelerator of Massachusetts Institute of Technology)

Join our Engineering-First Team

At BoostDraft, we prioritize quality over quantity. As an engineering-first company. Around 50-60% of our team members are software engineers with extensive experiences from companies such as Microsoft, IBM, HTC, Yahoo!, and R&D in NTT.

Technical Challenges We Solve

  • Performance improvement using both partial analysis and full analysis
  • Synchronization between user input and on-memory text
  • Cache efficiency to increase highlight performance t during/after user input
  • Security preserving Natural Language Processing, such as Federated Learning

What’s your challenge

As a C# Software Engineer at BoostDraft, you will be tackling challenging technical problems, including:

  • Design and implement classes and methods for IDE for documents
  • Refactor existing code for better extensibility
  • Interview with our users to understand their daily work and pain points
  • Propose both innovative ideas and feasible ideas to achieve unprecedented features

【Languages】 C#,（partially）Rust, Python

【FW】.NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【DB】 SQLite, Amazon RDS

【Log Analysis】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

Ensuring a Fair and Secure Recruitment Process:

In recent years, there has been a growing number of applications submitted with fake or AI-generated profiles, including fabricated work history or impersonated identities. At BoostDraft, we are committed to providing a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates and have implemented the following measures:

  • During online interviews, the use of both camera and microphone is mandatory. If we detect suspicious behavior, we may ask you to disable video filters or perform a simple on-screen action. If you are unable or unwilling to comply, the interview may be terminated on the spot.
  • By applying for a position or participating in an interview, you are deemed to have agreed to these measures and to cooperate if such requests are reasonably made.

These measures are applied equally to all candidates to ensure a trustworthy and fair hiring environment. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

If you have any concerns or questions regarding these measures, please feel free to contact our recruiting team.

事業内容

弊社はVS CodeやIntelli J等のIDEのコンセプトを法務文書領域に適用した、支援機能付きドキュメントエディタの開発を行っております。

ソフトウェア開発者がIDEのさまざまな支援機能によって本質的なコーディングに集中できている事実に着想を得て、法律文書に特化した同様の支援機能をMicrosoft Wordのアドインとして実装することで、ユーザが法務文書作成時の本質的な作業に注力できるようにするものです。顧客の大半は弁護士事務所および企業法務部で、大規模・中規模弁護士事務所はほぼすべて、多数の大企業に導入していただいております。そして、創業からすぐに高い収益を上げたことから、約四年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

権威のあるアクセラレータープログラムである、MassChallenge (米国トップ30アクセラレータ)、StartX (スタンフォードアクセラレータ、採択率7%)、MIT Sandbox (マサチューセッツ工科大学アクセラレータ)に受け入れられてきた実績があります。

会社紹介資料:

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • プロダクト開発を中心とした組織作り
    • CEOのSeanをはじめとし、社員の約5割がエンジニア職で構成されており、各メンバーはMicrosoft, IBM, HTC, LINEヤフー, NTT研究所などの有力企業で経験を積んでいます。
  • 研究開発への投資
    • IDEの概念を応用し、バージョン管理・比較、パッケージ管理、プラグイン等、他のソフトウェアとの連携・拡張を実現する予定です。
  • 事業の成長性
    • 創業一年目から継続して黒字経営を行っているなど、日系スタートアップの中では稀な成長の軌跡を達成しています。すでに米国や韓国をはじめとした国外でも事業を展開しています。

私たちが解決する技術的課題:

  • 部分的解析と全体解析の両方を活用したパフォーマンスの向上
  • ユーザーの入力とオンメモリのテキスト間の同期
  • ユーザー入力中や入力後のハイライトのパフォーマンスを向上させるためのキャッシュ効率化
  • 連合学習（フェデレーテッド・ラーニング）など、セキュリティを保護しながら行う自然言語処理

業務内容:

C# ソフトウェアエンジニアとして、以下の技術的課題を解決いただきます：

・C＃を活用したクラス・インターフェース設計および実装

・拡張性を高めるための既存コードの再設計

・ユニットテスト記述
・効果的なアルゴリズムの開発
・チームメンバーが開発したコードのレビュー
・全体アーキテクチャ設計・技術選定
・顧客インタビューを通じた機能の詳細化
・新たな機能を実装するための革新的かつ実現可能なアイディアの提案

・心理的安全性の高い環境の構築

スキル・志向に応じて

・機能の優先順位付け

・エンジニアの採用

【言語】 C#,（一部）Rust, Python

【FW】 .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【ログ分析】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

参考ブログ:

  • 【4時間かかった作業を「3秒」に！ 法律家を作業から解放　渡邊弘弁護士の挑戦】
  • 【GCP EIRから世界へ──BoostDraft藤井CEOが語る、海外展開のリアル】

採用プロセスにおける本人確認と不正防止の取り組みについて:

近年、AI技術を活用した偽装プロフィール（架空の経歴や人物）による応募が国内外で増加しています。BoostDraftでは、すべての候補者に公平で安全な採用プロセスを提供するため、以下の対策を講じています。

これらの取り組みは、すべての候補者の方にとって安心・公正な選考環境を保つためのものであり、一律に適用されます。ご理解とご協力をお願いいたします。

本件についてご不安・ご懸念がある場合は、遠慮なく採用担当までご連絡ください。

Requirements
