jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Digital Asset Management

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, and digital asset management (DAM) is how customers store, find, reuse, and distribute the approved assets behind every campaign. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow Veeva's DAM capabilities, making our customers' brand, marketing operations, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.
In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for DAM capabilities, such as asset ingestion and metadata, search and discovery, rights and usage management, content reuse, and multichannel distribution. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

What You'll Do

    • Product Strategy & AI: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for DAM, including where AI capabilities such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and generative variations fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
    • Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, creative and agency, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, organize, find, reuse, and distribute assets, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
    • Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, such as asset reuse rates, time to find and publish an approved asset, metadata completeness, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
    • Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
    • Governance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the asset lifecycle, such as automated metadata extraction, rendition and format management, rights and expiration tracking, and approved-asset distribution to downstream channels, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
    • Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault, including PromoMats MLR review and claims, to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

Requirements

    • 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
    • 2+ years of hands-on focus on digital asset management (DAM), content management, or creative production platforms
    • Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of how DAM systems are built, including metadata models and taxonomies, rendition and transcoding, APIs and integrations, and the application of AI/ML, such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and Generative AI, to asset workflows
    • Architectural Knowledge: Understanding of content and asset architecture, including storage and delivery, versioning, permissions and rights management, and integration with content management, work management, and distribution channels
    • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Creative, Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
    • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows
    • Marketing Acumen: Experience in Marketing or Marketing Operations, or building products for marketing teams, with a working understanding of how brand strategy, campaign planning, and content production come together
    • Marketing Process Fluency: Familiarity with the methodologies brand teams run on, creative and campaign briefs, agency and studio workflows, brand guidelines and governance, modular content and content supply chain models, omnichannel distribution, and launch readiness

Nice to Have

    • Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or a leading DAM platform (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Aprimo, Bynder)
    • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
    • Rich Media & Creative Workflows: Experience with image, video, and other creative file formats, proofing and review tools, and agency or studio handoffs
    • Brand & Launch Experience: Hands-on involvement in brand strategy, brand or product launch planning, or global campaign rollout, including the content, claims, and approval cycles that support a launch
    • Marketing Technology: Working knowledge of the martech stack brand teams use alongside DAM, including content and experience platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Sitecore), marketing work management (e.g., Adobe Workfront, Asana, Monday), marketing automation and CRM (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Veeva CRM, Vault CRM), and campaign analytics tools

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.excerpt: Cronos is an innovative global cannabinoid company committed to building disruptive intellectual property by advancing cannabis research, technology, and product development.
jobs.description:
Cronos is an innovative global cannabinoid company committed to building disruptive intellectual property by advancing cannabis research, technology, and product development. With a passion to responsibly elevate the consumer experience, Cronos is building an iconic brand portfolio. Cronos’ diverse international brand portfolio includes Spinach®, PEACE NATURALS® and Lord Jones®. For more information about Cronos and its brands, please visit: .

At Cronos Group, we hire talented people who thrive on solving difficult problems and give them the opportunity to hone new skills and approaches. If you want to play a part in shaping an innovative industry and help build a historically significant company, we want to meet you.

This role will be responsible for obtaining and maintaining the regulatory authorizations that will permit Cronos Group’s Canadian-manufactured medical cannabis products to be imported, released, and supplied in European markets, and for supporting commercial growth in those markets. Core activities include EU-GMP inspection readiness and certification maintenance for third-country manufacturing sites, narcotics import and export permitting, national product registrations and, where applicable, marketing authorization applications, and regulatory intelligence across target markets.

The role operates across three regimes that must be managed together: European pharmaceutical law (Directive 2001/83/EC and EudraLex Volume 4), the international controlled-substances framework (Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961), and divergent national cannabis frameworks that are not harmonized at EU level.

This involves strategizing, planning, managing, writing, and/or reviewing the activities and documents for the regulatory applications. Professional links need to be established with all internal departments involved e.g., Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Research & Development, Product Development, Legal, Sales, and Marketing, and specifically all external partners to ensure applications, registrations, and permits are prepared, compiled, and maintained in compliance with the regulations and are submitted and approved in an efficient and timely manner.

This is a remote position, but the ability to travel across North America and Europe is as required based on business needs.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide timely and appropriate reports to the Head of Global Regulatory Affairs.

  • Monitor and keep abreast of legislation, regulations, and guidance, document changes and maintain a regulatory register across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Provide strategic regulatory insight and advise commercial teams on market entry feasibility and on product regulatory requirements during development and throughout life cycle management.

  • Advise on the content and format requirements for regulatory documents for all products and site licenses and registrations.

  • Prepare and manage high quality national product registrations, notifications, and where applicable, marketing authorization applications (MAAs) (i.e., registration, amendments, and renewals or similar) for direct submission and/or for indirect submission to the competent authorities via external partners for the relevant markets within scheduled timeframes.

  • Maintain regulatory compliance for the site and product registrations once approvals have been obtained.

  • Provide support for regulatory inspections including pre-inspection readiness, hosting competent authority inspectors, deficiency responses, and maintaining GMP certification.

  • Review and approve all relevant Product Development, Marketing, and Quality Management Documents (e.g., product labels, promotional and advertising materials, study protocols and reports, change controls, deviations, complaints, etc.) to support compliance and product launches.

  • Interact with other departments for the timely launch of products, especially with respect to regulatory issues and to ensure the appropriate information is obtained for submissions.

  • Manage, maintain and update trackers for various subject matters for the department.

  • Plan, conduct, and manage the activities to ensure compliance with internal and external standards and requirements.

  • Establish and maintain professional standards of communication with colleagues within and outside the organization.

  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

You’ll need to have:

  • Degree in pharmacy, life sciences, chemistry, or a related discipline. Post-graduate regulatory affairs qualification is an asset.

  • 6 - 10 years’ experience in the pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and/or cannabis regulatory role, with a meaningful portion in-house or at a consultancy serving European markets.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting EU-GMP certification and inspections of manufacturing sites, ideally including third country (non-Europe) sites supplying into Europe, not general familiarity. Familiarity with German Bundesland-level competent authorities and the AMG and MedCanG framework is a strong plus.

  • Direct experience preparing or managing marketing authorization applications (MAAs) and/or national product registrations in European markets, including the knowledge of the distinction between medicinal product pathways, pharmacy-compounded/magistral routes, and API/raw material regimes.

  • Comfort operating without harmonized precedent, constructing defensible and sound regulatory interpretation in line with the applicable laws, regulations and guidance documents, including the discipline of citing primary sources rather than secondary summaries – especially in positions where guidance is silent or divergent.

  • Practical understanding of mutual recognition agreements between the European countries and non-EU third country (e.g., Canada), and where cannabis falls outside their scope. Includes practical understanding of narcotics import and export permitting under the UN Single Convention as implemented in European markets.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey regulatory assessments and translate regulatory constraints into commercially usable advice clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and presentation abilities to share information with diverse groups.

  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing corporate focuses and industry dynamics, being flexible and efficient in the fast-paced industry environment.

  • Well-versed in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and familiarity with IT systems (e.g., electronic submission portals, data and document management systems).

  • Excellent at working with internal and external stakeholders, driving decision-making and collaboration.

  • Exceptional attention to detail with excellent time management skills.

  • Professional written and spoken English. Additional working languages relevant to target markets are an asset.

About Virtualitics

Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.

Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.

Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.

Position Overview

Virtualitics is seeking a Senior Sales Director to lead the FSI and Defense Industrial Base territory. This frontline leadership role owns the territory strategy, team quota, pipeline creation, forecast accuracy, and execution across named strategic integrators and defense companies.

The Senior Sales Director will build and scale three complementary growth motions: sell-to opportunities for an FSI or DIB customer's internal use; sell-through opportunities in which Virtualitics supports a customer program led by an integrator or prime; and embedded or OEM opportunities in which Virtualitics becomes part of a partner's repeatable solution, offering, or contract vehicle.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can translate mission priorities into funded AI use cases, build executive relationships across corporate and program leadership, and coach Account Executives through complex, multi-party federal sales cycles.

Territory Scope

  • Own the assigned portfolio of named FSIs, defense primes, and strategic DIB accounts, including account segmentation, coverage, whitespace analysis, and prioritization.

  • Develop account strategies that connect corporate priorities, program portfolios, recompetes, contract vehicles, IRAD investments, and government mission demand to Virtualitics use cases.

  • Create clear rules of engagement across direct government, FSI, partner, and DIB teams to protect account ownership, avoid channel conflict, and maximize total revenue.

  • Establish repeatable sell-to, sell-through, and embedded/OEM plays that can scale across programs, business units, and customer portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

    Revenue, Pipeline & Forecast Leadership

  • Own and exceed the FSI/DIB team quota and assigned bookings, ARR, and pipeline targets.

  • Build sufficient qualified pipeline coverage through disciplined territory planning, executive engagement, partner-led demand creation, and targeted capture activity.

  • Run weekly forecast, pipeline, and deal-inspection cadences; ensure CRM accuracy, clear next steps, validated close dates, and evidence-based stage progression.

  • Personally engage in high-value and late-stage pursuits to remove blockers, align executives, shape commercial strategy, and drive opportunities to closure.

  • Maintain a balanced portfolio of near-term transactions, strategic expansions, and longer-term programmatic opportunities.

    • FSI & DIB Market Execution

  • Build senior relationships with corporate executives, business-unit leaders, program executives, capture leaders, solution architects, innovation teams, and contracts and procurement stakeholders.

  • Position Virtualitics against mission and business outcomes, including readiness, logistics, sustainment, maintenance, supply chain, workforce, and operational planning use cases.

  • Identify where Virtualitics can strengthen active programs, upcoming recompetes, proposals, IDIQ task orders, pilots, and internally funded innovation efforts.

  • Develop joint account plans, solution narratives, value propositions, and pursuit plans with strategic integrators and primes.

  • Navigate teaming agreements, subcontracts, reseller structures, OEM arrangements, procurement pathways, security requirements, data rights, and federal acquisition timelines.

  • Create durable relationships that generate repeatable access to government customers and programs rather than one-off partner transactions.

    • Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and retain a high-performing team of quota-carrying Account Executives aligned to named FSI/DIB accounts.

  • Set measurable expectations for prospecting, executive engagement, account planning, pipeline creation, qualification, forecast accuracy, and revenue delivery.

  • Conduct structured one-on-ones, account reviews, deal reviews, and performance inspections; address gaps early with clear coaching and accountability.

  • Develop sellers who can operate across commercial, technical, mission, capture, and contracting stakeholders in complex partner-led sales motions.

    • Cross-Functional GTM Leadership

  • Lead the operating cadence across Account Executives, Business Development, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Programs, Government Affairs, advisors, and executive sponsors.

  • Partner with Product and Solution Engineering to translate customer and program requirements into differentiated, scalable solution packages and demonstrations.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to drive adoption, measurable outcomes, references, renewals, and expansion within strategic accounts and programs.

  • Provide leadership with actionable market intelligence on partner priorities, funded programs, acquisition paths, competitors, and emerging demand signals.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of federal, defense, enterprise software, data, analytics, or AI sales experience, with at least 5 years leading quota-carrying teams.

  • Demonstrated success building and executing FSI and/or DIB territory strategies and exceeding significant team quotas.

  • Proven experience with sell-to, sell-through, co-sell, subcontract, reseller, or embedded/OEM motions involving major integrators or defense primes.

  • Strong understanding of federal program lifecycles, capture and proposal processes, government acquisition, contract vehicles, funding, security, and compliance considerations.

  • Track record selling complex AI, analytics, data platforms, SaaS, or enterprise software through long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles.

  • Executive presence and credibility with senior customer, partner, program, technical, contracts, and procurement leaders.

  • Ability to travel as required to customer, partner, and company locations.

  • Existing relationships across priority FSIs and defense primes are strongly preferred.

  • DoW Secret clearance preferred

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The FSI/DIB team consistently achieves or exceeds quota with a credible, inspection-ready forecast.

  • Each priority account has an actionable strategy, executive relationship map, qualified opportunity portfolio, and measurable pipeline-creation plan.

  • Virtualitics is incorporated into funded customer programs, partner solutions, proposals, recompetes, and repeatable offerings.

  • The territory produces a balanced mix of sell-to, sell-through, and embedded revenue with clear ownership and limited channel conflict.

  • Account Executives improve in performance, judgment, pipeline generation, deal execution, and leadership readiness.

  • Cross-functional teams operate against aligned priorities, roles, timelines, and customer outcomes.

What we offer you

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

We offer highly competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Our benefits also include unlimited PTO and flexible work arrangements, with remote flexibility and hybrid options for team members based in the Los Angeles or Washington, DC areas.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.excerpt: About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue.
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is seeking a driven and detail-oriented Customer Success Associate (CSA) to join our dynamic post-sale team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital marketing while working with top eCommerce brands.

You'll sit on our post-sale team and see both sides of Customer Success at once. On our largest enterprise accounts, you'll work alongside an Associate Director on high-touch, strategic programs. On our scaled portfolio, you'll help service a high volume of smaller clients where speed, consistency, and precision decide the outcome. You'll gain the exposure to know which side of that coin you want to build your career on.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll be trained in depth on our proprietary platform, you'll work on real client data every day, and you'll be trusted with the details that keep campaigns accurate at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis & Insights: Pull and analyze performance data to identify trends and opportunities. Develop custom reports based on client needs.
  • Campaign Execution: Set up and optimize marketing campaigns, including SMS, email, and onsite strategies in the back-end of the Wunderkind platform.
  • Project Management: Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Design, Engineering, Professional Services) to ensure timely and accurate execution.
  • Presentation & Strategy Support: Assist in creating data-driven presentations and reports to optimize client strategies.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to support initiatives, troubleshoot campaign issues, and drive outcomes.
  • Product Feedback & Testing: Participate in testing new features and supporting special projects or pilot programs.

Responsibilities and Level of Effort (LOE)

Project Management & Campaign Execution (40%)

  • Run the day-to-day project management of client campaigns from concept to launch — timelines, dependencies, and the follow-ups that keep them on schedule.
  • Set up and optimize email, SMS, and onsite campaigns in the Wunderkind platform.
  • Coordinate with Design, Engineering, Professional Services, and Analytics to move work forward, and set clear expectations with each of them on what's possible by when.
  • Spot roadblocks early and raise them early. We would rather hear about a slipping timeline on Monday than a missed deadline on Friday.
  • QA your own work and other people's. At scale, a small miss becomes a real problem fast.

Data, Insights & Client Storytelling (25%)

  • Pull performance data from our internal reporting tools (Wunderkind Analytics, Looker, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) and turn it into a point of view — not just a chart.
  • Build reports and presentations that answer the client's actual question and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Validate what you report. Numbers that go to a client are yours to stand behind.
  • Contribute data-backed recommendations that shape what we do next on the account.

Scaled Portfolio Support (25%)

  • Support a high volume of smaller accounts through our scaled service model, where great time management and prioritization are the key components of the job.
  • Handle client requests end to end: triage, execute, follow up, close the loop.
  • Monitor platform performance and client KPIs across the book, and flag risks and opportunities before anyone has to ask.
  • Keep documentation, trackers, and client records accurate. Other people make decisions based off of your work.

Operational Improvement & Special Projects (10%)

  • Test new features, participate in pilots, and give the Product team honest feedback from the front line.
  • Tell us what's broken. If a process wastes an hour a week across the team, we want you to say so and help fix it — regardless of how long you've been here.

What We're Looking For

  • Detail-obsessed. You catch the thing everyone else scrolled past, and you build habits that make accuracy repeatable.
  • Strong self-manager. You juggle strategic and scaled work in the same week without dropping either, and you know what to do first.
  • Data-fluent, not just data-capable. You can pull the report, and you can explain what it means, where it's misleading, and what to do about it.
  • A smart, honest user of AI. We give our team modern AI tooling and expect you to use it to move faster on reporting, drafting, summarizing, and analysis. We also expect you to read every output, sanity-check it against the source, and own the result. AI raises your floor here; it never signs your name.
  • High-energy and vocal. You ask good questions, push back when something looks wrong, and speak up about inefficiencies instead of quietly working around them.
  • A strong communicator. You write clearly, set expectations directly with internal teams and clients, and never let someone find out late.
  • Curious about the trade-offs. You want to understand why a project is prioritized, what it costs, and how the decision got made.

Required Qualifications:

  • 0–1 year of experience or a previous internship in Marketing, Client Services, or a related field.
  • Experience with eCommerce, email/SMS marketing, or website analytics (Google Analytics, Looker) is preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with marketing or analytics platforms is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.

Why This Role

You'll get exposure that usually takes years to assemble: enterprise strategy, scaled operations, marketing technology, performance data, and senior mentorship, all in the same year. It's the strongest foundation we know of for a career in customer success, technical account management, or digital marketing — and it's a well-traveled path onto our CSM team.

On the fence? Apply anyway! We know that imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and don’t want it to get in the way of meeting you!

The base salary range for this role is $55,000-$65,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

We are looking for a sharp, curious analyst who can go beyond dashboards and reporting to genuinely investigate how our offline and direct mail channels perform digging into attribution methodology, data layers, and vendor models rather than just consuming their output. This role sits at the intersection of business analytics and data science: you'll be trusted to build models, stress-test vendor and attribution assumptions, and proactively surface answers to business questions before anyone has to ask.

We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.
We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.

Role Summary

The Financial Services Onboarding Specialist is responsible for guiding providers, Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), and employer groups through accurate, timely, and compliant onboarding onto Nomi Health's payment and financial services platforms. This role owns the end-to-end collection, validation, and processing of banking, tax, and compliance documentation across all entity types, ensuring onboarding activity meets regulatory requirements and internal controls. The role partners closely with Compliance, Finance, and Product/Technology teams to maintain a smooth, low-risk onboarding experience for new and existing partners.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Manage end-to-end onboarding of new providers, TPAs, and employer groups onto payment and financial services platforms, ensuring completeness and accuracy of banking, EFT, and tax identification (TIN) information

    • Perform due diligence checks appropriate to entity type, including NPI registry verification and OIG/SAM exclusion screening for providers, and negative news and entity verification review for TPAs and employer groups
    • Ensure all onboarding activity adheres to regulatory and internal compliance guidelines, including BSA/AML, KYC, NACHA rules, and company-specific controls
    • Coordinate account and banking structure setup for TPAs and employer groups, including funding arrangements, EFT/ACH configuration, and plan-level account mapping
    • Triage and resolve onboarding exceptions, discrepancies, and documentation gaps in coordination with providers, TPAs, employer groups, and internal stakeholders
    • Maintain accurate, audit-ready onboarding records and status tracking across CRM/Salesforce and internal systems
    • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Compliance, Engineering, Product) to resolve escalated onboarding issues and reduce time-to-activation
    • Prepare onboarding status reports, pipeline metrics, and exception trends for internal stakeholders
    • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to identify onboarding platform defects, define requirements, and validate enhancements that improve reliability and efficiency
    • Maintain and follow standard operating procedures for onboarding workflows; recommend process improvements where appropriate
    • Assist with audit support by providing documentation and transaction/onboarding-level detail as needed

    • Working knowledge of BSA/AML, KYC, and NACHA compliance concepts as applied to onboarding and account setup
    • Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to validate financial, banking, and compliance documentation accurately
    • Ability to translate onboarding pain points into clear requirements for Product and Technology teams, and to validate that delivered solutions meet operational needs
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present onboarding status and issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
    • Demonstrated ability to investigate documentation discrepancies, ask incisive questions, and resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders
    • Track record of building effective working relationships across departments including Finance, Compliance, Product, and Engineering
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data validation
    • Proven ability to manage a high-volume onboarding pipeline and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and accountability
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward process improvement and operational efficiency

jobs.title: Sr. Transition GL Accountant
jobs.excerpt: My Financial Partner delivers high quality, fast-paced fractional Controller, AP, and GL services to 70+ network companies across the Teamshares portfolio.
jobs.description:
My Financial Partner delivers high quality, fast-paced fractional Controller, AP, and GL services to 70+ network companies across the Teamshares portfolio. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Teamshares, Inc. — a publicly traded company built to keep great small businesses thriving, one acquisition at a time.

The Role

    You're a member of the accounting SWAT team. When Teamshares acquires a new network company (NC) — or an existing one needs tidying up — you parachute in, get everything GAAP-clean, and hand off accounting processes that are ready to run smoothly. You sit at the center of it all: My Financial Partner (MFP), Teamshares' Financial Performance Team, and the Teamshares’ Acquisitions Team, turning messy legacy books into a sparkly system that just works.

Focus Areas

  • Clean up payroll/benefits liabilities and expenses, accruals, deferred revenue, AP, ST/LT liabilities, prepaids, inventory, customer deposits, and chart-of-accounts mapping before handing off to the on-going MFP teammates.
  • Report findings straight to the Sr. Transition Controller and flag the big stuff fast.
  • Assist with GL/ERP migrations, system integrations, and testing.
  • Reconcile everything on the balance sheet — cash, credit cards, fixed assets, tax liabilities, payroll liabilities, etc.
  • Turn paper-and-spreadsheet processes into clean, automated ones.

What Success Looks Like

  • Close the books in 8–10 business days, every cycle, without cutting corners on accuracy and quality.
  • Get most of a new acquisition transitioned within 30–90 days, so the on-going MFP Controller, GL Accountant, and AP Specialist can take the wheel.
  • Help refine the Transition Team playbook to make every future onboarding faster than the last.

What You'll Actually Do

    Core G/L Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Serve as the primary G/L accountant for multiple NCs in transition.
  • Determine and implement snazzy accounting entries such as accruals, reserves, reclasses, and intercompany entries.
  • Coach onsite finance leads on AR standard practices — payment application, collections hygiene.
  • Modernize and streamline AP tools (e.g. bill.com and Charted), tighten credit-card transaction syncing and coding/approval processes, and coordinate payment releases with the NC President.
  • Sync and reconcile cash, credit cards, and payroll to the right GL accounts.

    • Systems, ERP & Inventory Transition

  • Map legacy charts of accounts (COA) onto Teamshares' standardized COA.
  • Configure the GL — account structure, segments, dimensions, reporting hierarchy — so reporting is useful yet efficient.
  • Spot ERP-driven and accrual/estimation process improvements, especially anything that shortens the month-end close.
  • Review inventory processes and COGS recognition for alignment with how the business recognizes revenue.

    • Financial Reporting, Analysis & Advisory

  • Turn complicated transactions into insights the NC leadership can actually use.
  • Clean up inherited reporting and accrual calculations that don't hold together and build a reliable baseline.
  • Keep the books audit-ready throughout the transition — not just at handoff.

    • Internal Controls, Audit & Process Improvement

  • Support audit, tax, and due-diligence requests with airtight documentation and digital audit trails.
  • Identify control and process gaps before they become audit findings.
  • Automate the manual, siloed, and disconnected — every fix should scale to the next NC.

    • Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with MFP Controllers, GL Accountants, and Teamshares to keep systems and data in sync.
  • Show up to meetings ready to speak up and flag risks and inefficiencies early.
  • Translate accounting impact into plain business terms.

    • Team Training & Transition Planning

  • Train onsite NC staff on new workflows and close responsibilities.
  • Document SOPs and training materials in MFP's Google Drive — build it once, use it until we find a better way.
  • Join recurring knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Hand off month-end close cleanly to the on-going MFP team.
  • Help refine the onboarding playbook and KPIs with the MFP Transitions Team.

This Job is for You if You

  • Get hives at the thought of procrastination, disorganization, lack of documentation, and filing paper documents.
  • Desire a new accounting puzzle to solve as soon the current puzzle is at 90%.
  • Love janitorial accounting (a good clean up and facelift of the books) and you’re not afraid to use a different kind of mop, broom, or vacuum - with or without the instruction manual.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Don't need a roadmap for every new system. You like assembling furniture without the manual yet you use the manual as a reference when needed.
  • Meet NC staff and teammates where they are at and help them get over the finish line. If they trip, you help them cross the finish line.
  • Wear the hat of an accounting professor and explain accounting to NC staff and teammates in chewable bites.
  • Like small-business scrappiness backed by big-company rigor and internal control standards.
  • Have a high frustration tolerance. You know you’ll figure out the puzzle soon.
  • Constant technological and process changes don’t phase you. You don’t skip a beat. You hardly blink.
  • Live our values, "Trust comes first, take initiative, make things better, act thoughtfully and be dependable."

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA/HSA
  • 100% paid for employee (and dependents on most plans)
  • 15 days of vacation time to keep you balanced, rested and recharged and paid time off for 19 holidays, 5 sick days, and one floating holiday of your choice
  • Ongoing support and advice from Teamshares accounting, finance, and small business experts

jobs.title: Director of Product - Network
jobs.excerpt: We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it.
jobs.description:
We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.
We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.

What You'll Do:

    • Market solution design. Partner with network, go-to-market, and sales teams to define and scope what Nomi can realistically deliver in each new market before it's sold, including provider coverage, TPA capability, and integration sequencing.
    • Partner and TPA data exchange. Write the integration requirements between Nomi and every partner in the claim lifecycle — inbound claims, priced output, remittance, eligibility, file cadence, SLAs, and reconciliation — specific enough that an engineer on either side can build to it.
    • Network configuration and pricing. Own the path from a signed rate sheet to a correctly priced claim: ingestion, normalization, versioning, effective dating, validation, and audit. Set the testing and release bar for anything that touches pricing.
    • Provider data, adequacy, and directory. Own the provider data model and hierarchy — sponsor, tax ID, billing NPI, service location — and make network adequacy and directory accuracy measurable rather than asserted.
    • New segments and group types. Evaluate new group types and segments as they come up, be willing to recommend against ones that don't fit, and defend that recommendation to sales.
    • The payments interface. Recognize when a network change has payment-side consequences and get ahead of it with the financial services and payments teams before it ships.

What We're Looking For:

    • Reimbursement fluency. You understand the difference between billed, allowed, and paid, and you've worked hands-on with real fee schedules and rate methodologies, percent-of-Medicare, per diem, case rate, DRG, percent-of-charge.
    • Domain background. You've built this expertise at a health plan, a TPA, a repricing or payment-integrity vendor, a reference-based-pricing administrator, a provider revenue-cycle organization, or a network contracting organization.
    • Data exchange experience. You're comfortable with 837, 835, and eligibility file exchange, and you've written integration requirements that another team was able to build from successfully.
    • Commercial confidence. You're comfortable representing Nomi directly in front of a broker, a TPA executive, or a health system, and making commitments you can stand behind.
    • A self-directed approach. You're comfortable defining your own priorities and figuring out what matters most, rather than working off a pre-built roadmap.
    • Enough technical fluency to be credible. You can read a data model, write SQL against it, and give an engineer clear enough direction that they're not left guessing. You won't be writing production code yourself.
    • Strong written communication. Requirements documents are a core part of this role, so your writing should be clear, specific, and easy for others to build from.

Preferred Experiences:

    • Experience in self-funded employer health: TPA administration, direct contracting, reference-based pricing, or captives.
    • You've run a platform migration or a vendor claims-system implementation and lived through the reporting gap that follows.
    • Founder or early-operator background, or a track record of using automation and AI to replace manual operational work.
Nomi Health delivers disruptive healthcare solutions, in partnership with like-minded employers, public sector organizations, advisors (brokers/consultants), and payers/TPAs. We’re a team of 300+ people who show up every day with the same mindset: don’t settle for “that’s just how it is.” Real change happens when you challenge the system, cut through the excuses, and build something better together.

jobs.excerpt: About UsOpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems.
jobs.description:
About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions.

The team’s execution has been exceptional and we are scaling at a remarkable pace. Our early team brings experience from J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium and others, and we are backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NFX and other top-tier investors.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Operations for Latin America to own how new currencies and corridors actually get to market across the region. Every currency we launch unlocks new corridors for our institutional clients and drives trading volume and revenue directly. Your mandate is to make that expansion happen on the ground: sourcing and onboarding liquidity providers, standing up settlement rails with banking partners, clearing jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements, and holding every launch to the reliability bar our clients expect.

You will run the regional launch pipeline with real independence. You will own pricing inputs, sequencing and the go-live decision. You report to the Product Leader of Global Payments & Currencies, who sets strategic prioritisation for which currencies matter most based on payout corridor relevance. You own the how and the when.

If you have shipped cross-border payment products, worked with banking or card network infrastructure, or built API-driven financial products across jurisdictions, this role will feel familiar. The difference is that you will be doing it at the frontier of stablecoin-settled FX infrastructure, where the rails are new and the playbook is yours to write.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own corridor launch, end to end. You own every currency in your regional pipeline from Alpha through General Availability. You track liquidity partner onboarding, settlement rail readiness, regulatory clearance, operational setup and pricing. You run readiness reviews, maintain the launch checklist, and make the go/no-go call.
  • Operationalise our licences. Holding a licence and being able to use it are two different things. You work with Product Management, Legal and Regulatory, Compliance, Finance and Engineering to turn each licence, registration and partner permission into permitted product scope, documented operating procedures and live client flows. You keep what we are authorised to do and what we actually run in market in step, and you make sure new capability reaches clients as soon as the licence allows rather than months later.
  • Work directly with LPs and banking partners. You are the product voice in liquidity provider onboarding and banking partner discussions. You understand what it takes to stand up a new currency pair technically, what banking partners need in order to enable settlement, and how to translate partner constraints into product decisions.
  • Navigate multi-market regulatory complexity. Every currency carries jurisdiction-specific requirements. You work with Legal and Regulatory to establish what is needed, translate it into product and engineering decisions, and ensure no currency launches without clearance.
  • Prioritise engineering effort. You work with engineers to deliver against the roadmap. You write specs, set sprint priorities, and partner with your EM so capacity lands on the highest-impact currencies.
  • Drive post-launch adoption. A currency is not done at launch. You track whether clients are actually trading new corridors, partner with GTM to drive activation, find the friction, and feed what you learn back into prioritisation.
  • Build the regional launch playbook. You turn each launch into a repeatable, documented process covering every dependency, gate criterion and handoff, so the tenth currency is faster than the first.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in product management, product operations or programme management. You have owned a complex, multi-dependency delivery process in a B2B or infrastructure product.
  • Cross-border payments or financial infrastructure context. You have worked on payments, FX, card networks or digital asset products.
  • Multi-market experience. You have shipped products across multiple countries or regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Comfort operating between product, legal and compliance. You can read a regulatory requirement, work out what it means for a product flow, and drive it to a decision without waiting to be told.
  • Operational rigour. You maintain systems that track complex, multi-dependency work. You build the checklist, follow up on the open item, and catch the gap before it becomes a blocker.
  • Based in Brazil, in São Paulo or remote, and fluent in Portuguese and English.

What helps you stand out

  • LatAm corridor knowledge. Experience with Brazilian and wider LatAm payment rails, regulatory environments or banking partner ecosystems. Spanish is a plus alongside Portuguese.
  • Licensing and regulatory delivery. You have helped operationalise a licence, registration or scheme membership, not just tracked one.
  • Card network or payment scheme background. Time at a card network, payment scheme or large-scale processor with multi-market product launches.
  • Stablecoin or digital asset rails. Familiarity with stablecoin settlement, on and off-ramp infrastructure, or crypto payment products.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company
  • The chance to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation
  • Real impact on global financial infrastructure
  • A collaborative culture with genuine emphasis on personal and professional growth

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

Remote, Latam, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +2 years of experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. With a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere with a single integration.

Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Banks, acquirers, PSPs, and wallets use Yuno to modernize their infrastructure without replacing core systems and to prepare for the next generation of commerce, including agentic payments.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help us unlock new opportunities for our Financial Services vertical by bringing Yuno's payment infrastructure to banks, acquirers, PSP’s, wallets and other financial institutions. This is a front-line commercial role with real strategic weight — you're not just filling a pipeline, you're opening doors into markets that are central to Yuno's growth in the world.

You will identify, engage, and qualify prospects across a diverse and fast-moving landscape, which means you'll need to move quickly, understand local business contexts, and tailor your approach to each market. The ambition here isn't to hit a quota and stop — it's to build relationships that turn into long-term partnerships, and to keep raising the bar on what great prospecting looks like at Yuno.

This role demands someone who treats every conversation as a chance to learn. You'll stay sharp on industry trends, competitor moves, and market shifts across the region — not because you're asked to, but because that curiosity is what keeps your outreach relevant and your pipeline strong. At Yuno, we're always looking for better ways to reach the right people with the right message, and we expect you to bring that same drive to how you work every day.

If you're hungry to grow in sales, energized by the pace of a high-growth fintech, and ready to represent a product that's genuinely changing how companies handle global payments — this role is for you.

Your Contribution Will Be

  • Identify and research potential clients globally, through outbound prospecting, networking, industry events, and digital channels

jobs.excerpt: Company Introduction:Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered.
jobs.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Own the Agent Network Across Your Regions

You own the agent partner relationship across two of Airspace’s four U.S. regions. That includes onboarding new agent partners, running ongoing performance conversations, maintaining the scorecard, and partnering with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps when a partner isn’t meeting standard. The Regional Network Managers in your two
regions own their region’s overall health and weigh in on judgment calls that affect regional strategy, things like whether agent capacity in a market is adequate, or whether a new agent partnership changes how a region is covered. The day-to-day agent relationship is yours to run.

Onboarding runs through you and Procurement directly. You handle the operational side, credentialing, documentation, system setup, and setting initial performance expectations, while Procurement manages the contract. The scorecard itself is built and maintained by the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations: you apply it on a regular review cadence across both of your regions, use it to decide which partners need a closer look, and send field-level context back so it stays accurate over time. Contract rates are not part of this role.

In practice, this means you’re the one who notices a partner’s numbers slipping before it becomes a service problem, has the conversation about what needs to change, and follows up to see whether it does. When it doesn’t, you partner with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps, and let the relevant RNM know once it’s resolved.

What You’ll Do

Agent Performance

  • Build and maintain relationships with agent partners across your two regions, staying close enough to the day to day that you know how each partner is actually performing
  • Own agent scorecard management for every courier and agent partner across your two regions — quality, reliability, and coverage — applying and maintaining a scorecard built on the data and methodology the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations provides
  • Track Partner Portal adoption for every agent partner in your two regions as a standing indicator of partnership health, not just a line item on the scorecard — low or no usage is often the earliest sign of a partner who isn’t fully invested, and worth a direct conversation before it shows up as a performance problem elsewhere
  • Monitor performance on an ongoing basis, identifying partners whose performance is falling out of alignment with Airspace’s expectations before it becomes a bigger problem
  • Own and lead performance review conversations with agent partners, using scorecard data and case history to make the case clearly and set expectations for improvement
  • Partner with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps when an agent partner is not meeting standard after a fair review, keeping the relevant Regional NM informed given their accountability for the region’s overall health

Onboarding and Case Management

  • Own agent onboarding in partnership with Procurement — you handle the operational onboarding, Procurement handles the contract
  • Manage the agent case queue in Salesforce for your two regions, triaging and routing escalations and maintaining accurate documentation

Partner Across the Network Organization

  • Work closely with the two Regional Network Managers in your area — keeping them informed on agent performance and deactivation outcomes in their geography, and partnering with them on judgment calls that affect regional strategy
  • Work closely with the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations as your primary data partner on the agent scorecard — receiving analysis and methodology, and providing ground-truth field context back
  • Partner with Procurement, and with the Director, Network Operations, on the commercial, contractual, and next-step decisions for a performance issue or deactivation — this is a situational partnership tied to service quality, not a standing rate-setting responsibility. Onboarding, by contrast, is a standing partnership with Procurement, not a one-off
  • Coordinate with the Director, Network Operations, and with the other Agent Lead, on agent trends or systemic issues that show up across more than one region

  • Comfortable holding two concurrent regional relationships with enough depth to go beyond surface-level oversight — this role trades breadth for depth compared to a fully centralized model

  • Clear, direct communicator; comfortable owning a performance conversation end to end, and partnering with the Director and Procurement on deactivation decisions, while keeping Regional NMs appropriately informed

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Role Overview

The Director of Product Marketing exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning while building and leading the team that scales that work. In this high-impact role, you will own the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models, direct the team that equips our global sales organization to win, and set the standard for how JumpCloud translates complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives. You will lead a group of product marketers, developing their craft and their careers while directing cross-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go-to-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership, scaling our market reach, and growing a high-performing product marketing function.

Employee Value Proposition (EVP)

  • Purpose: You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud's open directory platform, and you will build the team that carries that mission forward, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.

  • Growth: You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, build and scale a product marketing team, expand your influence across executive-level steering committees, and establish yourself and your people as premier industry voices.

  • Motivators: Lead at a high-velocity, tech-forward company where you set direction, hire and develop talent, and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to build processes and sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.

Major Performance Objectives

    Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

  • 6-Month Team Integration and Asset Delivery: Within the first 6 months, integrate fully into the marketing and product organizations, establish operating rhythms for your team, and deliver at least 3 high-value assets while embedding JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.

  • Team Building and Performance: Within 9 months, assess team structure and capability, close priority skill or headcount gaps, and put in place clear goals, coaching cadences, and performance expectations that raise the output and consistency of the product marketing function.

  • Pricing and Packaging Strategy: Within 9 months, direct the analysis, optimization, and rollout of an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).

  • Sales Enablement and Competitive Differentiation: By month 12, lead your team to equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.

  • Platform Evangelism and Thought Leadership: Establish yourself and at least one team member as external speakers for JumpCloud within 12 months, delivering a combined minimum of 4 public demos or presentations across multiple platform feature sets.

  • AI-Driven Process Optimization: Within 12 months, build and scale at least 2 AI-leveraged processes or tools to support the team's execution, while collaborating with the AI steering committee to deploy sales-driven assets that accelerate deal velocity.

Critical Subtasks:

    Supporting activities to achieve objectives:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear goals, running regular one-on-ones, and managing performance to a high standard.

  • Collaborate with product management, sales, and executive leadership to audit and refine current pricing and packaging models.

  • Direct competitive intelligence research across the team to identify clear market differentiators and map the competitive landscape.

  • Oversee the creation of high-impact enablement assets such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts for the global sales team, ensuring quality and consistency across the function.

  • Partner with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.

  • Maintain deep command of the JumpCloud platform and enable your team to deliver comprehensive, multi-feature technical demos to customers, partners, and industry analysts.

  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across sales, product, and go-to-market (GTM) motions to ensure unified messaging.

  • Represent JumpCloud, and position your team members, as speakers and thought leaders at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.

Required Skills and Experience:

    Must-have functional skills:

  • People management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing product marketers or comparable marketing talent

  • Product Marketing and Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy execution

  • Strategic pricing and packaging design for SaaS or platform technologies

  • Advanced sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and positioning asset creation

    • Preferred domain knowledge:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, or Cloud Security

  • SaaS business models and developer/IT buyer personas

    • Tools or systems knowledge:

  • Modern AI productivity tools and workflow automation platforms

  • Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM and marketing automation systems

    • Behavioral or power skills:

  • Proven team leadership, with the ability to set direction, delegate, and grow people

  • Exceptional public speaking, storytelling, and evangelism capabilities

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building across sales, product, and GTM teams

  • High degree of strategic thinking, process-building capability, and sound judgment under autonomy

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual compensation range for this role, depending on individual candidate level and experience, is $150,000 - $225,000, including base salary and any related bonuses or commissions.

In the US, JumpCloud® provides a comprehensive benefits package, with several medical plans to choose from including a high deductible HSA plan with employer contribution, two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), employee assistance program (EAP), short- and long-term disability, life insurance and a 401k savings plan with match. We have a flexible paid time off policy.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
All roles posted in United States locations do require that you be located within one of the 50 U.S. States. Our Headquarters is in the Denver/Boulder, CO area but as a remote company, you are able to work remotely anywhere in the U.S. If you would like to spend time in our offices in the Denver/Boulder area, you are welcome to do that as well.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"
