jobs.excerpt: Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities.
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope:

We are hiring a Product Manager, Strategic Technology Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Strategic Technology Applications team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, the Strategic Technology Applications team functions as the internal “product organization” for the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of strategic technology applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)
  • Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments
  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration
  • Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

  • Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories
  • Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features
  • Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira
  • Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support
  • Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment
  • Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection
  • Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly
  • Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

  • Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users
  • Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities
  • Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns
  • Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)
  • Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)
  • Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements
  • Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates
  • Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred
  • Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems
  • Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms
  • Background in product delivery or change management methodology

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170,000–$194,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $149,000–$185,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Habitat Health is at-will. This means that either the employee or the employer may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job posting or any other company document is intended to create a contract of employment, express or implied, or to alter the at-will nature of employment.

Any written or oral statements to the contrary are not authorized unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Because this is a remote position, employment will be governed by the laws applicable to the employee's work location, and applicable legal requirements will be followed.

Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. For COVID-19 and influenza, team members who are working in a participant care setting are required to provide either proof of vaccination or a signed declination form and comply with applicable masking requirements while in a care setting to the extent permitted by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

Habitat Health will consider requests for reasonable accommodation based on an applicant's disability, medical condition, or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance in accordance with applicable law.

As a condition of employment, team members are expected to comply with all applicable infection control protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and vaccination requirements associated with their role and work location, and to the extent required by law and as permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion. Employment decisions at Habitat Health are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Habitat Health is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Consistent with applicable law, we provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to individuals with religious beliefs, practices, or observances that require accommodation.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform the essential functions of a position, or receive other employment benefits and privileges, please contact us at .

We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

E-Verify Participation Notice

If E-Verify cannot confirm your authorization to work, Habitat Health will provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and/or the Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any adverse employment action is taken, including termination of employment.

E-Verify is used only after an applicant has accepted an offer of employment and completed the Form I-9 and to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Habitat Health complies with all federal and state employment eligibility verification requirements.

Beware of Scams and Fraud

Habitat Health is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment scams. Please ensure that you submit applications only through Habitat Health's official careers website or authorized job boards.

Official communications from Habitat Health recruiters and team members will come from email addresses ending in @habitathealth.com. Habitat Health will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment, or provide sensitive financial information as part of the recruiting or hiring process.

If you receive suspicious communications claiming to represent Habitat Health, we encourage you to exercise caution and independently verify the communication before responding.

Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.
About the Role:

As a Clinical Care Navigator on the Organizational Services Team, you’ll be doing meaningful, high-impact work supporting companies and their employees through moments of challenge, change, and crisis. You’ll be the first clinical point of contact for HR, ER, and Benefits teams reaching out for expert guidance, and you’ll coordinate thoughtful, timely support for employees navigating behavioral health concerns. You won’t be providing ongoing therapy, you’ll use your clinical skills to offer expert consultation, coordinate critical incident responses, and proactively reach out to employees in crisis. Your work will help ensure safety and connection to high-quality care.
This role may be for you if you’re an excellent communicator, confident in your clinical judgment, and passionate about making behavioral health more accessible in the workplace. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can shift seamlessly between support calls and consultation, and have a strong sense of professional presence when working with VIPs and organizational leaders. If you’re someone who finds purpose in showing up for people at pivotal moments and helping them get to the right care at the right time, this role could be a great fit.

Tuesday - Saturday 1:00 PM - 9:30 PM PST / 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM MST: / 3:00 PM - 11:30 PM CST: / 4:00 PM - 12:30 AM EST

  • Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD) Coordination: Coordinate and facilitate responses to critical incidents, including identifying appropriate responders, organizing logistics, and conducting follow-up care outreach.
  • Leadership level support: Deliver discreet, high-touch clinical support to executives and VIP employees, ensuring timely and sensitive handling of complex concerns
  • Inbound Organizational Support: Respond to calls and emails from company representatives (HR, ER, benefits leaders) with clinical expertise and Lyra resource guidance
  • Proactive Outreach: Reach out to employees identified as high-risk or in crisis, offering in the moment support, risk assessment, safety planning, and care navigation to ensure connection to care

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential records of all interactions in compliance with HIPAA and Lyra protocols

jobs.excerpt: About UsHighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth.
jobs.description:
About UsHighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our PeopleWith over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our ImpactAs of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design (M4) to lead a high-performing team of product designers focused on AI-powered workflows that span our Product and Revenue product lines — the tools our customers rely on to communicate with their customers. This spans conversations, messaging, automation and intelligence surfaces that sit at the center of how agencies and SMBs run their businesses on HighLevel. You have spent 9+ years designing and leading complex products, including 3+ years managing designers, and are ready to guide a distributed team through ambitious, AI-driven product work.

This role will report to the Senior Director, Product Design and manage approximately 8–12 product designers across the United States and India. You will lead design execution across AI workflow surfaces that cut across our Product and Revenue pillars, helping teams turn customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear, useful product experiences for the conversations and communications that power our customers' businesses.

This is a craft-driven management role for someone who stays close to the work. You will not be the primary production designer, but you should have the taste, product judgment and design fluency to improve direction, sharpen decisions and coach designers — with particular fluency in designing for AI-assisted and AI-generated experiences.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, strong systems thinking and the ability to grow designers through clear expectations, critique, direct feedback and practical coaching. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale — especially where AI is shaping how customers communicate with their own customers.

Experience leading B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, marketing technology, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected, as is experience designing AI-native product experiences (e.g., conversational AI, automation, agentic workflows, or generative communication tools).

What You'll Do

  • Manage, coach and develop 8–12 product designers across US- and India-based teams.
  • Lead design execution for AI-powered workflows spanning Product and Revenue lines — the communication, messaging and automation experiences customers use to reach and engage their own customers.
  • Connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and product strategy across these cross-cutting AI workflow surfaces.
  • Set expectations for quality, accountability, collaboration, communication and delivery.
  • Keep designers focused on the highest-priority work, help them manage ambiguity and clarify what is expected, blocked or ready for decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, design leadership and the Senior Director, Product Design to shape roadmaps, clarify tradeoffs and improve outcomes across Product and Revenue AI initiatives.
  • Lead critiques, coaching conversations, quality reviews and launch-readiness discussions that improve usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency, design-system alignment and the quality of AI-assisted experiences.
  • Maintain workstream visibility through useful rituals, crisp updates and timely risk escalation.
  • Hire excellent talent, onboard designers and create clear development plans.
  • Use AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, synthesis, documentation and production collaboration without lowering the quality bar.

What We Are Looking For

  • 9+ years of relevant product design, UX or product experience work, including 3+ years managing product designers.
  • Proven experience managing designers in complex B2B SaaS, platform, workflow-heavy or multi-product environments.
  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact — ideally including AI-powered or AI-assisted product experiences.
  • Exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, with the ability to raise the quality of work across a team.
  • Strong management skills with individual contributors, including keeping designers focused, unblocked, accountable and connected to the broader goals of the work.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to maintain visibility across workstreams and give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, tradeoffs and decisions.
  • Experience leading critique, coaching designers, giving direct feedback and helping teams make stronger product design decisions.
  • Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
  • Strong product judgement and comfort balancing customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints and speed of execution — particularly across cross-functional Product and Revenue initiatives.
  • Comfort designing for AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, automation, agentic workflows or generative communication tools.
  • Proven ability to hire strong designers, develop existing talent, support career growth and performance manage team members who need additional support.
  • Experience managing distributed teams and working across time zones; experience working closely with India-based teams is highly valuable.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted production tools and enthusiasm for using them thoughtfully to improve design quality, communication and velocity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication, product quality and team execution.
  • You stay close enough to the work to improve decisions, not only track progress.
  • You teach designers how to recognize, critique and ship stronger product design, including for AI-powered experiences.
  • You keep work visible, focused and moving without turning management into bureaucracy.
  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability, direct feedback and respect for your teammates as people.
  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.
  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.
  • You think across product boundaries — connecting Product and Revenue workflows around a shared goal: helping our customers communicate better with their customers.

About TSS Advisors

Founded in 1986, TSS has grown to become the largest professional advisory firm headquartered in New Hampshire. With over 90 employees dedicated to the broad range of clients and mix of services seldom seen in a local firm, we have experience and expertise to assist our clients in meeting their goals, whether individuals or business entities, regardless of their size or industry.

At TSS, we recognize that professionals today need to be business consultants, advisors, planners and strategists. We need to be knowledgeable not only in accounting and tax law, but also in business analysis and valuation, estate planning, employee benefit administration and much more.

Over the last few years, we have acknowledged and embraced the fact that the accounting profession and industry is evolving. With this, we are taking our commitment to excellence to a new level by partnering with Ascend. This will accelerate our strategic growth model by providing access to new resources and additional partnership opportunities.

About Ascend

At Ascend, we understand the struggles that accounting & finance professionals face in traditional public accounting firms - from rigid hierarchies, overwhelming workloads, and the elusive work-life balance. It’s time for a transformative change. We believe your ambition should not be constrained by outdated practices or opaque career paths. Here, you're not just a number; you’re a valued member of a community that supports & celebrates your professional & personal fulfillment. Our mission is to transform the public accounting experience into one where work-life harmony is a reality, and where your career advancement is supported by a nurturing network and comprehensive resources.

Ascend empowers entrepreneurial CPAs to reach their goals with an innovative growth model that brings our partner firms into the new age. Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a modern platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while having access to resources of a large firm. These resources include growth capital, robust talent acquisition, best-of-breed technology, a catalytic leadership system, shared back-office services, and modernized equity incentives.

This is a hands-on supervisory role. You will own a portfolio of client relationships, review the work of the accountants supporting them, and act as the escalation point when something does not tie out.   • Integrity within a professional environment

  • Experience with payroll platforms and multi-state sales tax compliance

jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Fleetio is writing a new chapter. We are moving from a well-loved product in a category we helped define to a brand that fleet operators, technicians, and executives recognize at first sight and trust on instinct. We put our name on a NASCAR race. We have a car on track with 23XI Racing. We are rebuilding the company narrative around where fleet operations are actually going — not where it has been.

What we need now is the person who makes it all feel like one thing.

As Senior Director of Brand, you own how Fleetio looks, sounds, and shows up — everywhere. Our visual identity. Our editorial voice. Our social presence and video work. Our earned media. The creative expression of the company story across every surface a customer, a candidate, or an analyst will ever touch. You will lead a talented in-house team and a set of agency partners, and report directly to the CMO on a marketing leadership team being rebuilt for the next stage of growth.

This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. The narrative foundation is being set now. You get to define the expression of it.

Fleetio has a product customers love and a story the market has not yet fully heard. Closing that gap is the single highest-leverage thing marketing can do for this company right now. This seat is where that work lives.

What You’ll Own

  • Brand system and creative. Visual identity, creative direction, and design standards across web, campaign, product surfaces, events, and sponsorship — the system that makes Fleetio recognizable in a category where most brands look interchangeable.
  • Content and thought leadership. Editorial strategy and the content engine — thought leadership, long-form, owned research, and the always-on content that builds authority with fleet leaders and feeds organic and AI-driven search.
  • Social and multimedia. Organic social and video as a real channel, not an afterthought — the presence that keeps Fleetio in the conversation between sales cycles.
  • Communications and PR. Earned media strategy in partnership with our PR agency, executive visibility programs, awards, and the messaging discipline that holds across every external moment.
  • Brand activation. Turning our 23XI Racing partnership and our field presence into a year-round content and storytelling engine — not a logo on a car.
  • Team and partners. Hiring, developing, and leading the brand and content team; owning agency relationships, creative operations, and the intake and prioritization system that lets a small team punch far above its weight.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The new Fleetio narrative is live and consistent everywhere — from the homepage to the trade show booth to the sales deck — and it looks and sounds unmistakably like us.
  • Awareness and share of voice move measurably in our favor in the fleet management category.
  • The content engine runs at a cadence demand generation, and sales can actually build on, anchored by at least one owned research franchise, the industry cites.
  • The NASCAR partnership produces story, not just impressions — with a content calendar behind every race weekend.
  • The brand and content team is stronger, clearer on standards, and doing the best work of their careers.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in brand leadership, including 4+ years leading and developing teams.
  • You have taken a B2B brand — ideally SaaS, ideally at meaningful scale — through a narrative or identity evolution, and shipped it into market. Not just designed it. Shipped it.
  • You have real taste, editorial and visual, and the judgment to know when good enough ships and when it does not.
  • You are comfortable being measured. Awareness, share of voice, engagement, content-influenced pipeline — you can hold a number and defend it in front of a CEO.
  • You are a genuine partner to product marketing, demand generation, events, and customer marketing. Brand does not work in a room by itself.
  • You have managed agencies well — gotten more out of them than the retainer suggested.
  • You like real-world industries. Our buyers are fleet managers, technicians, and operations leaders. They are not marketers, and they can smell marketing from a mile away.

Nice to Have

  • Sponsorship, partnership, or experiential activation experience — sports, motorsport, or large-scale events.
  • Experience building or running an in-house creative studio.
  • Challenger-brand or category-creation experience against a larger, better-funded incumbent.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SPHINX

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sphinx is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team building the next generation of mission planning and command and control software for space communications programs. This team is tasked with creating modern, resilient services and capabilities to support the U.S. Government.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and front-end experiences for Sphinx’s space vehicle mission planning platform, while also working across backend services, APIs, databases, and system integrations. You’ll own well-defined features from development through deployment, collaborate closely with other engineers and cross-functional partners, and help deliver reliable software that meets user and mission needs.

What you will be focusing on:

  • Building intuitive, responsive, and maintainable user experiences using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, and/or Vue
  • Translating design mockups, user feedback, and defined system requirements into functional and intuitive user interfaces
  • Developing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while following established engineering practices and standards
  • Owning small-to-medium features from development through testing and deployment, identifying edge cases and raising risks or dependencies along the way
  • Building and improving APIs and backend services that support front-end applications and system capabilities
  • Developing and maintaining backend functionality using technologies such as Python, SQL, RESTful APIs, and containerized architectures
  • Collaborating with QA and other engineering disciplines to understand acceptance criteria, troubleshoot defects, validate functionality, and meet functional and technical requirements
  • Writing and maintaining automated unit, integration, and functional tests to validate software functionality
  • Participating in code reviews, incorporating feedback, and providing constructive feedback to teammates
  • Making sound engineering tradeoffs within your area of ownership and seeking additional context or guidance when appropriate
  • Communicating assumptions, dependencies, and technical considerations early to minimize rework and support successful delivery
  • Contributing to improvements in product usability, quality, security, performance, and maintainability

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • 2–5 years of professional web or software development experience using modern development approaches
  • Strong front-end development fundamentals, including an understanding of modern UI development principles, component-based architecture, responsive design, performance, and usability
  • Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, and/or Vue
  • Experience translating designs, user needs, and defined requirements into production-quality user experiences
  • Full-stack development experience with exposure to backend systems, including Python, API development and integration, application architecture, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL, including querying and integrating data into web applications
  • Experience developing, consuming, and integrating APIs between front-end applications and backend services
  • Familiarity with modern containerized and microservices architectures using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience collaborating with QA throughout the software development lifecycle, including working with acceptance criteria, troubleshooting defects, and validating functionality
  • Experience writing automated tests and developing software against defined user, functional, and technical requirements
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, security, performance, and maintainability
  • Ability to independently own well-defined features, prioritize work, identify edge cases, and communicate risks or dependencies
  • Ability to make sound engineering decisions within familiar problem areas and recognize when additional guidance or clarification is needed
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with engineers, end users, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience developing, testing, or deploying software within air-gapped or highly secure government network environments
  • Ability to hold and maintain a U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance

Bonus points if you have the following:

  • Experience designing and developing intuitive user interfaces featuring real-time, 2D/3D geospatial visualizations
  • Experience building software for mission-critical, defense, aerospace, or other highly secure environments
  • Actively hold a U.S. Government Secret clearance

LOCATION

While this role is remote, the potential for travel may occur such as client visits, company gatherings, and other project related travel as needed may be required.

COMPENSATION

This role is between $130,000 and $157,000 base salary.

BENEFITS

Compensation includes competitive salary, meaningful equity ownership, profit sharing, employer 401(k) contribution, and 100% employer covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents.

ELIGIBILITY

Must be a US Citizen and be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance and be eligible to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance .

EEO STATEMENT

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Sr. Data Engineer with strong data platform experience to help evolve our modern data stack and contribute to the foundation of our emerging AI and ML platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture and machine learning enablement and will bring high-quality, scalable, and ethical AI into real-world use. You will partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and product managers to ensure our platform supports reliable data pipelines, scalable analytics, in addition to defining new architecture, best practices, and patterns for fellow engineers to inherit. The ideal candidate is both a systems thinker and a hands-on builder who thrives in evolving environments and is passionate about creating reliable data infrastructure that enables peers and partner teams to move faster with data. You will have the opportunity to learn and contribute to a machine learning enablement and will bring high-quality, scalable, and ethical AI into real-world use.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable systems for ingestion, transformation, and storage of data, with a focus on testing and observability.
  • Implement frameworks, tooling, and automation to safely increase development velocity.
  • Develop foundational end-to-end AI/ML workflows from (1) source ingestion and preparation, (2) training and tuning, (3) experimentation and productionisation, and (4) downstream systems integration (EHR modules, micro-services, dashboards).
  • Support iterative model development and production operations and observability (accuracy, drift, bias, fairness, reproducibility).
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge-sharing and mentoring of peer engineers.
  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making.

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python with strong familiarity towards modern data engineering frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling
  • Proficiency with data ops best practices, monitoring, pipeline automation, and CI/CD
  • Experience with GCP or AWS data engineering tools, big data frameworks
  • Experience with data modeling and medallion architecture
  • A collaborative mindset, dependable execution, drive to reflect and improve, and humility to ask questions and learn.
  • Comfort using AI tools in day-to-day workflows, with a willingness to continuously rethink and improve how work gets done
  • Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new tools and approaches; prior experience with AI tools is a plus
  • Nice to have:
    • Experience with foundational end-to-end AI/ML workflows from (1) source ingestion and preparation, (2) training and tuning, (3) experimentation and productionization, and (4) downstream systems integration (EHR modules, micro-services, dashboards).
    • Some knowledge of modern compute and ML frameworks/libraries (i.e., Spark, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
    • Some experience with building production APIs and services, inclusive of MCP servers that expose internal data/services to LLMs.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or ML engineering.
  • Experience working with major cloud data platforms and tools:
  • Preferred experience:
    • Healthcare, behavioral health, EHR systems, and/or regulated industries.
    • Specific expertise with: AWS/GCP, dbt, AirflowAirbyte, Redshift/BigQuery.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
  • No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
  • Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
  • Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
  • Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
  • There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
  • Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
  • Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation, Equity & Incentives:

Base Salary Range Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location/ zone. Final pay within the posted range will be decided based on a combination of job-related factors, including education, training, experience, and market demands.

  • Geo 1 (All other states & D.C.): $142,600 - $153,100
  • Geo 2 (CO, HI, MD, RI): $156,900 - $168,400
  • Geo 3 (AK, CA, CT, MA, NJ, NY, WA): $164,000 - $176,000

Variable Compensation & Equity

  • Performance Bonus: This role is not currently eligible for bonus incentives.
  • Equity Awards: This role is eligible to participate in Octave’s equity program via Stock Options, subject to the terms of the applicable Equity Incentive Plan.
  • Remote Work Stipend: New full-time employees receive a $300 equipment reimbursement to support a home office setup.
  • Internet & Phone Reimbursement: Full-time employees are eligible for a monthly reimbursement of up to $75 for internet and cell phone related expenses.

Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Octave will not discharge or in any other manner coerce, intimidate, threaten, discriminate or retaliate against employees or applicants because they have: (i) inquired about, discussed, compared, or disclosed their own wages, benefits, or other compensation, or the wages, benefits, or other compensation of another employee or applicant; (ii) asked Octave to provide a reason for the employee's wages or lack of opportunity for advancement; or (iii) aided or encouraged others in exercising their rights to discuss wages, compensation, or benefits, or to seek pay equity.

However, except as otherwise provided by law, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) in compliance with the company's legal duty to furnish information under applicable law .

Comprehensive Benefits:

At Octave, we believe in supporting the "human being first". Here’s a snapshot of the benefits available to eligible employees:

  • Health & Wellness: Choose what works best for you with one High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) and two PPO medical plan options, plus comprehensive Dental and Vision coverage.
  • Medical Support: Enjoy access to a company-sponsored membership with One Medical for convenient, modern care.
  • Retirement: Plan for your future with a 401(k) that offers both traditional and Roth options.
  • Paid Time Off: Time to recharge matters. Take advantage of a generous time off policy, up to 15 paid company holidays, and accrued sick time.
  • Financial Protection: We’ve got you covered with company-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance, plus optional extras like Pet, Legal, and Worksite plans (Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Accident).
  • Parental Leave (Bonding Time): Growing your family? Full-time employees can take paid bonding leave after 6 months, whether it’s a new baby, adoption, or foster placement. Time off increases with tenure.
  • Growth: Keep learning and leveling up with professional development reimbursement for role-related growth opportunities.

How We Use Technology in Hiring:

As part of our hiring process, we may use technology tools, including AI-supported systems, to assist with reviewing applications or documenting interviews. These tools are designed to support our team, not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are always made by our team.

jobs.description:
Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service. Founded in 2013 and trusted by leading brands and service providers, we power seamless, reliable service experiences through a modern platform built for scale. Our platform gives businesses the visibility, communication, and control they need to manage every step of the service journey, from job acceptance through completion. With the acquisition of Youreka in 2023, Dispatch expanded its capabilities to include a leading Salesforce-native Smart Forms application that equips mobile workers with guided workflows, improves field execution and customer service, and scales to support complex enterprise operations.

As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We’re investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth.

We're now investing in a dedicated marketing function to match the strength of our product and customer base, and we're hiring our first Director of Demand Generation to build it.

THE ROLE:

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Demand Generation will own demand generation for Dispatch and Youreka, reshaping what marketing means for the company and our products. This role also owns our Business Development Representative team's strategy and targets, working primarily through our existing BDR team lead. This is a hands-on, builder role: you'll set strategy and run campaigns yourself in the early days, then pursue growth within the marketing team as the function proves out.

AS THE DIRECTOR OF DEMAND GENERATION, YOU WILL:

  • Demand generation & growth - assess Dispatch's situation from first principles to determine where marketing should focus (paid acquisition, lifecycle/email, organic, and other channels); own the marketing automation and CRM stack; generate and manage a healthy, measurable pipeline in close partnership with sales. Building this out is the top priority for this role.
  • Product-market fit & positioning — identify, through testing and analysis, which segments, use cases, and messages actually convert; use that to sharpen demand-gen targeting and messaging, and share findings with our Product Marketing team to inform their formal positioning work.
  • Content — build a content engine (website copy, case studies, thought leadership) that supports demand generation and conversion.
  • Team leadership - own strategy and targets for our BDR team, working closely with the existing Lead BDR and aligning team output with the broader demand generation strategy. You will also manage an existing marketing team resource and help define future role additions over time.
  • Diagnose marketing channel mix for Dispatch’s products - prioritizing investment accordingly.
  • Establish the processes, reporting, and KPIs the function will run on.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 5–10 years of marketing experience including specific focus on demand generation and program definition.
  • A startup-tested operator - comfortable being hands-on and building programs with limited resources, not just directing an existing team.
  • A proven track record of owning a marketing function or team from an early stage.
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing a demand-generation/marketing function is required. Experience managing a team on a sales-style comp plan - such as a BDR, SDR, or inside-sales function - is a plus.
  • An analytical, first-principles thinker who can diagnose which channels and tactics actually drive results for a given business, rather than defaulting to a standard playbook - we're counting on you to help define our ideal marketing mix, not just execute one.
  • A strong written communicator who can turn technical or operational product value into compelling brand and content narratives.
  • B2B SaaS experience preferred; experience in field service, home services, or enterprise software is a plus.

WITHIN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:

  • Build a functioning marketing engine - team, tools, and process, revamped from a lean starting point and working closely with our Senior Marketing Manager.
  • Define a clear, data-backed point of view on where Dispatch should focus its marketing investment, measurable pipeline/revenue contribution from marketing, and BDR-driven programs.
  • Develop sharper product positioning and messaging along with marketing support delivered for major product launches and market expansions.
  • Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch’s growth functions.

SALARY:

The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.

LOCATION:

Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use.

WE HAVE:

  • An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day
  • Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program
  • A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths
  • A generous medical, dental, and vision package with 90% covered by us
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability
  • Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule

STILL WITH US?

We’re ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers.

Not a fit? Keep an eye on our Careers Page for other positions!

Job Summary:

As our Project Manager of Incident Response, you will be primarily dedicated to external, client-facing projects within our Incident Response team. Project Management

  • Diagnostic tools; review event logs, Syslogs, monitoring data, and memory dumps to troubleshoot issues.
  • Security-enhancing solutions for systems and applications (including MFA and endpoint protection).

Metrics Measuring Success

  • Maintains billable utilization targets
  • Ensures all mandatory reports are generated and updated daily
  • Meets or exceeds deadlines for all assigned projects
  • Keeps projects profitable while not skimping on quality
  • Leverages cost variance and schedule variance formulas to measure project success
  • Contributes to the team’s attainment of high customer satisfaction scores on project delivery
  • Records complete change details, time worked entries, and work notes in ServiceNow in real-time
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvement

Following Process

  • Follows Abacus’s project process to execute project deliverables: configure, test, implement, refine, document, monitor, and transition to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Follows Abacus’s Change Management Process to perform approved changes in client environments
  • Communicates internally and (as directed) externally to provide timely information regarding project status, promised follow-ups, and requested feedback on a detailed and professional basis.

Skills and Experience:

Regardless of method, you have obtained and exposed yourself to knowledge centers that have qualified you to master technical project delivery and the systems engineering required to successfully recover, deploy, and enhance infrastructures. You ideally have a four-year degree in a relevant field and are working towards or have already obtained your PMP certification.
  • You’ve managed projects as the assigned “PM” instead of only having delivered them as an engineer. You enjoy the dynamic of wearing multiple hats and taking the lead on client-facing communication, expectations, and timelines.
  • You’ve owned client-facing projects and have established a consultative rapport resulting in high client satisfaction levels upon project closure.
  • You have at least 5 years of experience delivering IT waterfall projects working with systems and virtualization with exposure to enterprise infrastructures.
  • You keep us true to our word. You have a tried-and-true organizational system to keep yourself (and others) on task while ensuring exceptional quality.
  • You possess a winning combination of superb writing skills and highly refined verbal communication skills. You convey energy, confidence, and genuine interest over a call just as easily as you convey competence, professionalism, and trustworthiness in person. You translate to a C-Suite audience as seamlessly as you “talk tech” with engineers. Your emails are professionally worded, grammatically pristine, with the right pinch of personality. In any medium, you pride yourself in clear, effective, and persuasive communication.
  • You have an approach to working hours that is more adaptable than the traditional "9-to-5". As this team responds to business-critical remediation projects, we are looking for an individual who is career-driven and won’t shrink back when work requirements extend into evenings, weekends, and holidays. While travel is minimal, you’re also open to getting on a plane when needed to be present at client sites when a project requires it. On the flip side, your hard work is rewarded with a generous comp plan that grows with the efforts you contribute, a flexible PTO policy, and an equally inspiring team that climbs mountains together.
  • You are ready to be an effective remote worker and have a dedicated, private space for a home office with a private internet connection with at least 50MBPS bandwidth. Public WiFi and shared common spaces do not meet these standards.

Desired Personality Traits:

  • A Mythical Character. You aren’t alarmed when someone expects you to be a hero; in fact, you pride yourself on frequently delivering big just when all hope seems lost. Your persistence is notable, and you are a determined soul who insists on turning “We can’t” into “We can” If you meet a roadblock, you’ll try to scale it, dodge it, or blast through it before ever admitting defeat.
  • The Devil is in the Details. You have an angelic ability to sort through chaos and make order. Your eye and attention for details helps you uncover hidden gems, while your thorough documentation and status updates capture and convey every facet of each stone.
  • Corporate Usain Bolt. You’re capable of moving rapidly from task to task without getting rattled. Your desk is clear, your email inbox is empty, your kitchen counters aren’t cluttered, and you never spend 15 minutes tearing around the house in a desperate hunt for your car keys or train pass. You are a lean, mean, well-oiled machine.
  • A Combo Meal. Your style is winningly ambidextrous. While you are known to be a loyal teammate and never falter on your commitment to seeing others thrive, you are not a push-over. You will fight back and advocate for the best marriage of client desires and superb delivery-pushing us along the path towards perfection. If Samwise Gamgee and Monica Geller had a child, it would be you.
  • Emotionally Mature. Through your years of experience, you’ve learned that occasional hiccups are inevitable and now know enough to just keep moving towards the end goal. You’re calm under pressure, encourage respectful dialog, and understand that communication is the balm that can soothe the sting of conflict.

The benefits package consists of:

• Gym discount

• Comprehensive travel insurance for you and your family in line with scheme rules
• Confidential well-being and counselling support
• Competitive Compensation

• Private Medical and Dental Insurance

jobs.description:
AI Visibility Strategist

Full-time · Remote-first (Canada) · Reports to the Head of Advisory

About podium iq

AI models now decide who gets recommended, considered and chosen. We measure how enterprise brands show up inside those answers, score them against the competitors that actually appear, and turn the finding into a content plan. Then we ship the content. Most of this category stops at the dashboard - we don’t, which is why our clients are financial institutions, global consumer technology brands, national regulating bodies, and major consulting firms.


What the work looks like

It starts with a conversation rather than a query. A client arrives with something they want to understand, usually phrased more vaguely than they realize, and your first job is to turn it into a question worth measuring. Get that wrong and the run is a beautifully rendered answer to nothing, which is the most expensive mistake available to us.

Then the results come back and you interrogate them. The platform surfaces the pattern and ranks the recommendation. You bring the market context, the competitive read and the client knowledge that turns a strong recommendation into the right one for that business, this quarter.

The third part is making sure the fix can be found. Answer engine optimization is yours: structure, schema, internal linking, architecture, and the retrieval signals that decide whether a page gets cited or sits there unread. You will brief the content, review it, and hold the quality line before anything reaches a client.

You do all of this beside our founder and our head of advisory to begin with, on live enterprise accounts, learning the method on real work rather than in a deck. Then you take accounts of your own, and we would like that to happen quickly.

Interested? Keep reading.

What we’re looking for

  • Six or more years in SEO, content strategy or digital strategy, spent owning the thinking rather than executing someone else's.

  • Real AEO and SEO range, technical and editorial. Schema and structured data, site and content architecture, crawl and indexation, on-page, internal linking, and comfort inside analytics and visibility platforms.

  • Analytical rigour with writing to match. You can take something large and noisy and come back with one page that is right.

  • A point of view you offer before anyone asks for it, and the research to back it up.

  • A nose for the missing question. The platform is strong and the models change weekly, so what we value most is your sense of what the analysis has not been asked.

  • We build with AI across our stack and you will too. Underneath it we want your own hypothesis and the curiosity to find out whether it held.

  • The habit of raising a hand. We are distributed, and the people who enjoy it here flag capacity early and pull threads nobody handed them.

What you’ll build toward: Within your first 6 months you will have command of a methodology you cannot learn anywhere else, genuine depth in a category that is only about two years old, and the presence to carry a room full of enterprise stakeholders, built by watching, then supporting, then leading.

The practical details

Remote-first and open to candidates within Canada. You will work with strategists, copywriters, creative and product across several time zones, asynchronously by default. We are still building the culture rather than inheriting one, and that is meant as an invitation.

If this sounds like you, then here's how to apply

Send us your resume and two other things:

  1. A piece of analysis you are proud of, with a short note on what you concluded that the data did not obviously hand you and what changed because of it.

  2. A question about AI search you have not been able to answer yet.

Short listed candidates will be invited to run an asynchronous analysis inside podium iq, which is the closest thing to a real day with podium iq and the part where we learn the most about how you think.

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Director, North America Compliance will serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with particular focus on Market Access. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, Americas, this role will provide strategic, practical, and risk-based compliance guidance that enables business objectives while supporting an effective North America Compliance Program.

The Senior Director will partner closely with senior leaders and teams across Market Access, Sales, Marketing, Patient Services, Trade and Distribution, Legal, and other functions. The role will advise on complex U.S. healthcare compliance matters across payer and customer engagement, pricing and contracting activities, patient support and access programs, field execution, promotional activities, and other evolving commercial models.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, business-minded healthcare compliance leader who understands the U.S. pharmaceutical commercial and market access environment, can anticipate risk, and is comfortable making sound decisions in areas where the path may not be straightforward. This individual will be expected to build trusted relationships, influence at senior levels, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic guardrails that support responsible innovation and sustainable growth.

Essential Functions of the Job:

U.S. Commercial & Market Access Compliance Leadership:

  • Serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with primary responsibility for supporting Market Access and related access, reimbursement, and customer-facing activities.
  • Provide strategic, timely, and practical compliance advice to senior Commercial and Market Access leaders on business strategies, product launches, customer engagement models, and new or evolving initiatives.
  • Advise on compliance considerations involving payers, pharmacy benefit managers, group purchasing organizations, health systems, specialty pharmacies, distributors, wholesalers, integrated delivery networks, government accounts, and other market access stakeholders.
  • Provide compliance guidance on pricing and contracting activities, discounts and rebates, formulary and access discussions, value-based or innovative arrangements, patient support and affordability programs, reimbursement activities, and other market access initiatives in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Support U.S. Sales and Marketing teams on key commercial compliance matters, including promotional practices, healthcare professional and customer interactions, speaker programs, advisory boards, sponsorships, field activities, and other external engagements.
  • Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and operating models in order to identify risk early, propose pragmatic solutions, and embed appropriate controls into business processes.

Strategic Risk Management & Compliance Program Execution:

  • Partner with the Head of Compliance, Americas to execute North America compliance strategy and priorities and to continuously enhance a modern, risk-based compliance program.
  • Identify and assess emerging compliance risks arising from changes in the U.S. healthcare, enforcement, reimbursement, and commercial landscape and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Lead or support compliance risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, investigations, and remediation activities relating to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Use monitoring results, business data, industry developments, and other risk indicators to identify trends and recommend enhancements to controls, training, policies, and business processes.
  • Support compliance governance and senior leadership reporting, including clear communication of significant risks, trends, decisions, and mitigation plans.

Policies, Training & Business Guidance:

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, field guidance, training, and other compliance resources relevant to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Design and deliver engaging, risk-based compliance training for Commercial and Market Access teams, including leadership and field-based personnel.
  • Translate complex laws, regulations, enforcement developments, and industry standards into clear, actionable guidance for business partners.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, thoughtful risk-taking, and speak-up across the U.S. organization.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Leadership:

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Commercial, Market Access, Legal, Corporate Affairs, HR, and other functions.
  • Work closely with the Global Compliance Program Office and other regional and global Compliance colleagues to promote consistency, share best practices, and support enterprise initiatives.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional projects, launch readiness activities, governance forums, and strategic initiatives to ensure compliance considerations are incorporated early in planning and execution.
  • • Serve as a visible Compliance leader who demonstrates sound judgment, constructive challenge, executive presence, and a solutions-oriented approach to complex business issues.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

  • Provides direct leadership, management, coaching, and development to assigned Compliance team members.
  • Sets priorities and expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports the professional development and performance of direct reports.
  • Provides functional leadership and mentorship across the North America Compliance team and helps foster a collaborative, high-performing, and business-focused Compliance organization.
  • May lead or oversee the work of contractors, consultants, or other resources supporting Compliance initiatives.

Education Required:

  • BA/BS Degree is required.
  • Advanced degree (JD, PharmD, MBA, MPH, or similar) preferred.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree with 12 + years of relevant experience in healthcare compliance, legal, regulatory, audit, or related functions within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, including significant experience supporting U.S. commercial activities.
  • Demonstrated experience advising Market Access organizations and strong understanding of the U.S. payer, reimbursement, patient access, trade/distribution, and contracting environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical compliance requirements and industry standards, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, federal and state transparency requirements, FDA promotional requirements, PhRMA Code, and OIG/DOJ compliance expectations.
  • Experience providing compliance guidance on market access topics such as payer and customer engagements, discounts and rebates, contracting, formulary discussions, patient support programs, reimbursement support, specialty pharmacy, and other access-related activities.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting or supporting risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, training, policy development, and remediation.
  • Experience supporting product launches and working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and evolving commercial environment strongly preferred.

Computer Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Teams.
  • Experience with compliance, expense, CRM, analytics, or reporting platforms such as Concur, Salesforce, Power BI, or similar tools preferred.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional judgment and ability to assess complex or ambiguous issues, balance risk and business objectives, and provide clear recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand commercial strategy, market access models, customer dynamics, and operational processes.
  • Ability to translate complex compliance concepts into practical, business-focused guidance and workable solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on positional authority.
  • Strong executive presence and excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to challenge constructively and navigate competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise discretion, and manage multiple high-priority matters in a dynamic environment.
  • Commitment to integrity, continuous learning, and fostering a strong speak-up and compliance culture.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Is viewed by U.S. Commercial and Market Access leaders as a trusted, strategic advisor who enables responsible business execution.
  • Anticipates emerging risks and provides clear, pragmatic guardrails before issues arise.
  • Strengthens compliance oversight of Market Access and other U.S. Commercial activities through effective guidance, training, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
  • Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and helps teams make thoughtful, well-informed decisions in complex areas.
  • Contributes to a practical, business-focused, and integrity-driven compliance culture aligned with BeOne values.

Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically approximately 25%

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $231,800.00 - $301,800.00 annually

BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, and any other applicable federal, state or local laws, applicants who require reasonable accommodation in the job application process may contact .
