jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology.
jobs.description:
Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology. As the leading AI platform for accounting firms, Suralink serves more than 50% of the top 100 enterprise accounting firms in the United States and has over 800,000 users globally.


Our mission is to empower the people we serve to redefine the meaning of efficiency in the accounting technology industry. Our award-winning SaaS platform was built for CPA firms, providing a simple, secure way to manage audit, tax, and advisory engagements.


Recognized for growth, innovation, and culture, we foster a highly collaborative, remote-first environment where exceptional, motivated professionals can make a meaningful impact. If you're passionate about building relationships and driving growth at a fast-growing SaaS company, we'd love to talk with you


Who we are looking for:

Suralink pioneered client-engagement software for accounting and advisory firms, helping 1,200+ practices worldwide close the client-readiness gap and safeguard trust. With the launch of our next-generation platform and AI-powered audit capabilities, we're hiring a Solutions Consultant to uplevel how we solve problems for leading firms through our GTM motion.

Reporting to the CRO and partnering closely with sales leadership, product, and product marketing, you'll be the practitioner voice in the sales cycle - a former CPA or auditor who has walked in our customers' shoes and now helps them envision a better way of working. You'll design and lead high-impact demos and pilots, build the foundational demo and workshop playbooks, and drive strong win rates on new products and strategic expansions.

We need a workflow-obsessed, commercially minded Solutions Consultant who blends deep audit/accounting experience with proven demo chops and a strong bias toward ownership and action

Key Responsibilities:


Drive Wins on New Products & Strategic Deals

- Partner with AEs to design and deliver compelling demos and pilots for enterprise and strategic firms, with a focus on new products and AI-enabled audit workflows.

- Serve as a subject matter expert in workshops and demos, where your practitioner experience helps uncover pain points and position our solutions.


Own Demo Strategy and Environments

- Redesign and standardize demo flows across Suralink's product suite, tailored by persona (Partners, Managers, Directors, IT/innovation) and segment.

- Maintain high-fidelity demo environments that mirror real financial statement tie-outs, audit testing, tax procedures, and AI-assisted workflows.

- Train AEs and CSMs to confidently run core demos end-to-end.


Architect and Run High-Conversion Pilots

- Design structured pilots/POCs with clear entry criteria, timelines, and success metrics tied to real firm workflows.

- Translate the specific success criteria and nuance of firm methodology and business process into guidance on how to use the product

- Drive 60%+ win rates on pilots where you are engaged, ensuring they function as decision engines - not open-ended experiments.


Partner with Product and Product Marketing

- Capture and synthesize market feedback, recurring use cases, and friction points from demos and pilots into clear insights that inform our roadmap.

- Translate real audit, tax, and advisory workflows into messaging, enablement, and content.

- Serve as a key thought partner in value engineering initiatives that tie our product directly to the impact on our customers.


Experience and Professional Qualifications:


- CPA or equivalent audit/accounting background with approximately 3–7 years in public accounting, including hands-on experience with:

- Audit procedures, methodology, documentation, and review

- Financial statement tie-outs and supporting workpapers

- Testing, sampling, and evidence management

- 2–5 years as a Solutions Consultant in B2B SaaS, ideally within accounting, audit, finance, or close-management technology, in a high-growth environment selling into firms or corporate finance/audit teams.

- Demonstrated success supporting enterprise or strategic deals, including multi-stakeholder sales cycles (Partners, Audit/IA leaders, IT, Security, Operations).

- Experience participating in or leading an Emerging Technology / Innovation / Digital Transformation committee or similar body responsible for evaluating and piloting new tools.

- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to shape demos, pilots, and customer rollouts.


Additional Preferred Qualifications:


- Experience at companies such as (or similar to): DataSnipper, Trullion, Caseware, AuditBoard, FloQast, or BlackLine.

- Prior focus on enterprise or strategic accounts with upsell/cross-sell responsibility across multiple modules or product lines.

- Familiarity with AI-powered tools for audit analytics, testing, or documentation support.

- Experience designing and rolling out sales enablement programs for AEs and CSMs (demo certifications, discovery frameworks, objection handling, etc.).

- Comfort speaking at customer webinars, training sessions, or industry events as a subject-matter expert in audit, tax, or accounting technology.


At Suralink, our values guide everything we do:

  • Customer Obsessed: We seek to understand those we serve deeply and are committed to serving them better than anyone else.

  • Passionately Motivated: We care about what we do, which drives us to work hard, show grit, and go above and beyond to achieve great outcomes.

  • Constantly Improving: We are eager to learn and grow. Challenges are opportunities to innovate and enhance our solutions.

  • Team Focused: We know that our success is built together. We support one another and celebrate team achievements.

  • Highly Reliable: We demonstrate good judgment, honor our commitments, and are accountable for our results.

Why Suralink?

There’s a lot to love about working at Suralink! Here are a few of the benefits you can expect:

  • Remote-friendly policy

  • Medical/vision/dental insurance

  • Flexible PTO policy and ten paid holidays

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development allowance

  • Community involvement

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Regional Product Manager for United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium and The Netherlands (UKIB) is a pivotal role focused on executing our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) business strategy, with an emphasis on expanding our Spine portfolio and boosting growth in capital and robotics sales. You'll be essential in aligning and implementing marketing strategies locally while collaborating closely with regional sales and business teams.

This Product Manager role is a remote role, covering United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium and The Netherlands. Location is flexible, travel is required (up to 60%). The role is a new role, supporting a new regional alignment.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Lead the growth of our CST portfolio and spearhead the introduction of enabling technologies, ensuring market leadership and expansion. Drive business development initiatives to enhance portfolio value and maximise market impact
  • Develop and implement strategies to maximise the performance of current offerings, while leading the planning and execution of comprehensive launch plans for next-generation technologies
  • Oversee the sales funnel, leveraging Sales Force Dot Com to track and optimize sales opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting, pipeline health, and sales team performance
  • Deliver training programs that equip both customers and sales teams with a deep understanding of the clinical benefits and technical advancements of our technologies, enhancing product adoption
  • Develop and execute reimbursement strategies to secure market access and drive sustainable growth for both existing and future technologies, with a focus on robotics
  • Build a business intelligence system that provides competitive insights and objection-handling strategies to empower local sales teams and identify business development opportunities
  • Establish and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and healthcare professionals, ensuring our strategies align with market needs and drive deeper engagement

Required Knowledge and Experience:

  • Experience in Spinal, Orthopaedics, or Neuromodulation therapies within sales or marketing roles
  • Experience in capital sales or marketing
  • Proven ability to operate in a complex business environment and work effectively with sales & regional marketing management
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

‌

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.


If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at .

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create.We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist (UAE) - (Remote - Part-time)
jobs.excerpt: About our ClientOur client is a Dubai-based, fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) beauty company dedicated to empowering women in the GCC and Middle East with premium, confidence-boosting hair solutions.
jobs.description:
About our Client

Our client is a Dubai-based, fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) beauty company dedicated to empowering women in the GCC and Middle East with premium, confidence-boosting hair solutions. They specialize in high-quality, natural hair products through their flagship brand—the region's pioneering Arabic online store for 100% Remy human hair extensions, wigs, clip-ins, tape-ins, aftercare, and professional salon training.

Born from a UK-Middle East collaboration between two ambitious friends, started with direct salon partnerships, overcame pandemic challenges by launching a robust e-commerce platform, and now serves customers across Saudi Arabia, the broader MENA region, and worldwide with exceptional quality, color-matching expertise, 24/7 consultations, and free fast shipping.

Job Summary

As Paid Media Specialist, you'll lead strategy and execution, establish a world-class creative testing system alongside our in-house editors and designers, and create repeatable playbooks that fuel future brand launches. This is a rare chance to shape multiple brands in a fast-moving, high-potential beauty space with strong internal creative support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead full strategy, setup, and daily execution across Meta and Snapchat, including campaign architecture, audience targeting, bidding, and creative deployment tailored to GCC consumers.
  • Develop and execute weekly/monthly scaling plans, balancing horizontal (new audiences/markets) and vertical (budget increases on winners) approaches.
  • Proactively manage ad fatigue through rotation, refresh, and performance monitoring to maintain stable, long-term results.
  • Optimize blended channel metrics (CAC, MER) while ensuring healthy contribution margins at scale.
  • Design and implement a structured creative testing framework covering angles, hooks, formats (video, static, carousel), UGC vs. produced, and rapid iterations.
  • Analyze performance data to deliver precise, actionable creative briefs and instructions to our in-house video editor (e.g., hook structure, pacing, proof elements, CTA placement).
  • Maintain a live content pipeline, testing calendar, iteration backlog, and documentation of key learnings to inform weekly optimizations.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate idea generation, concept variations, and quick mockups for faster testing cycles.
  • Build and own a comprehensive 60-day launch roadmap, including phased budget ramps, KPI milestones (e.g., early CPA targets, winner identification thresholds), and scaling triggers.
  • Ensure full tracking readiness (pixel/events, attribution setup) and account hygiene before go-live.
  • Lead rapid early testing to identify high-performing creatives and audiences, then transition to aggressive profitable scaling.
  • Document the entire process into a repeatable launch playbook for future brand expansions.

Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in media buying on both Meta Ads Manager and Snapchat Ads (mandatory; GCC/MENA experience strongly preferred).
  • Proven track record scaling DTC beauty, cosmetics, hair, or fashion brands with high AOV.
  • Deep unit economics mindset: fluency in CAC, MER, LTV:CAC ratios, contribution margin, and payback period for informed scaling decisions.
  • Strong creative leadership: ability to translate data into specific creative direction, run structured testing, and document/iterate learnings systematically.
  • Organized operator with excellent planning, prioritization, KPI tracking, and weekly reporting skills.
  • Proficiency using AI for creative ideation/concepts (e.g., Midjourney, ChatGPT for hooks/angles).
  • Results-oriented, calm under pressure (seasonal volatility), collaborative with creative teams, data-driven decision-maker.

Educational & Professional Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with at least 3 years focused on Meta + Snapchat in DTC/e-commerce.
  • Demonstrated success scaling DTC beauty/cosmetics/hair brands.
  • Strong preference for GCC/Middle East market experience due to cultural nuances, language (Arabic/English), and seasonal peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday/Black Friday).
  • No formal certifications required, but proven results in high-stakes scaling environments essential.

Apply now and join a team where creativity meets performance.

Additional Information

  • Fully remote (GCC time zone alignment required for meetings and live optimizations).
  • Part-time (with potential to become full-time)
  • Opportunity to shape multiple brands in a fast-moving beauty space with strong in-house creative support.
  • Only Egypt-based candidates can apply.

Job Overview

We're looking for a creative, data-driven, and highly motivated Digital Marketing Expert to join our growing team. If you're passionate about SEO, content creation, social media growth, and digital campaigns — this role is for you.You'll play a key role in strengthening our online presence, increasing engagement, and driving measurable marketing results across multiple channels.

  • Conduct keyword research and implement effective SEO strategies to improve rankings and organic traffic
  • Manage and grow social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and more
  • Build and execute engaging content calendars and digital marketing campaigns
  • Monitor website performance, SEO rankings, and social media analytics
  • Create compelling captions, marketing copy, and creative content ideas
  • Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations
  • Collaborate closely with designers and content creators to enhance brand visibility and engagement
  • Support or manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok platforms

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Digital Marketing
  • Strong understanding of SEO strategies, keyword research, and content optimization
  • Proven experience in content creation and social media management
  • Strong copywriting and communication skills
  • Experience using tools such as:

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
  • Experience with Media Buying and paid advertising campaigns
  • Basic knowledge of WordPress or website management
  • Understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation, and conversion strategies

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on diverse and exciting projects

  • Career growth and development opportunities

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Analyst - FCS
jobs.excerpt: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare.
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

McKesson's Oncology & Specialty Technology team is seeking a Clinical Systems Analyst - FCS to support and optimize critical healthcare technology platforms used across oncology practices. This role serves as a subject matter expert for clinical applications, healthcare workflows, system integrations, and technology modernization initiatives. The position partners closely with clinicians, operational leaders, vendors, and technical teams to improve patient care delivery, operational efficiency, and user adoption through technology-enabled solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for clinical and operational healthcare applications.

  • Analyze clinical workflows, gather business requirements, and translate needs into scalable technology solutions.

  • Lead application implementation, upgrade, optimization, and enhancement initiatives.

jobs.description:
About Dynatron

Dynatron is championing a new standard of Fixed Ops excellence for automotive dealerships. We cut through the Fixed Ops data fog and deliver unique insights and actions that help you drive revenue growth, expand margins, and uplift retention—all through a unique AI-powered Fixed Ops Data Intelligence Platform, proven methodology, and expert coaching.
As a remote-first software company, we combine deep automotive expertise with technology, data, and structured client partnership to help dealerships achieve measurable, sustainable results.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Automotive SaaS Client Success professional to join Dynatron as a Client Performance Coach.
This role sits at the intersection of Client Success, automotive expertise, software adoption, and performance consulting. You'll manage a portfolio of dealership clients, helping them translate Dynatron's technology and data into measurable business outcomes while building the trusted relationships that drive adoption, retention, and long-term growth.
This is not a traditional dealership Fixed Operations role. While understanding the dealership environment is important, we're looking for someone who knows how to succeed as a Client Success professional within a SaaS organization - managing customer relationships, driving technology adoption, demonstrating ROI, identifying risk, coordinating across internal teams, and creating value throughout the customer lifecycle.
Success means your clients don't simply use Dynatron. They understand its value, incorporate it into how they operate, achieve measurable results, and view Dynatron as a strategic partner.

Role Reality

This is a highly structured, fully virtual Client Success role. Most of your day will be spent managing customer relationships through scheduled meetings, account preparation, performance analysis, documentation, follow-up, and internal collaboration.
You should expect:
  • Approximately 45-50 hours per week
  • No weekends
  • Approximately six hours per day of scheduled, camera-on virtual meetings
  • A portfolio of dealership customers requiring proactive relationship and performance management
  • Significant use of CRM, software dashboards, performance data, and structured documentation
  • Clear expectations around client engagement, adoption, retention, and performance
  • Software-company compensation rather than traditional dealership compensation
The strongest performers combine the urgency and customer awareness required in automotive with the structure, discipline, and scalability required in SaaS.

What You'll Do

Own the Client Relationship

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of dealership clients, building trusted relationships with General Managers, Fixed Operations Directors, Service Managers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and measures of success.
  • Establish regular engagement cadences and maintain clear success plans for assigned accounts.
  • Navigate challenging conversations and escalations while maintaining credibility and strengthening the client relationship.
  • Build relationships across multiple stakeholders to create durable partnerships that extend beyond a single customer champion.

Drive Software Adoption & Client Value

  • Guide clients through adoption of Dynatron's platform, workflows, and performance methodology.
  • Help dealership teams incorporate Dynatron into their day-to-day operating processes rather than treating the platform as a standalone tool.
  • Monitor product utilization and engagement to identify adoption gaps, risks, and opportunities.
  • Reinforce effective platform usage through ongoing training, coaching, and consultation.
  • Translate software capabilities into practical business value for dealership leaders.

Demonstrate Performance & ROI

  • Analyze dashboards, utilization metrics, historical performance, and dealership data to evaluate account performance.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for dealership stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate the business impact and ROI of Dynatron's solutions through regular performance conversations and executive-level presentations.
  • Coach clients on pricing and performance strategies, including ELR, Hours/RO, parts matrixing, Variable Labor Pricing strategies, and Warranty Filings.
  • Identify trends and opportunities that help clients improve profitability and operational performance.

Manage Client Health, Retention & Growth

  • Proactively assess account health using engagement, utilization, performance, relationship, and other relevant indicators.
  • Identify potential churn risks early and develop clear action plans in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Support renewal strategy by continuously demonstrating measurable value throughout the client lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities where additional Dynatron solutions could create value for the customer and partner with Sales on appropriate expansion conversations.
  • Maintain accurate visibility into account status, risks, opportunities, and next steps.

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Support, Implementation, and other Client Success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.
  • Communicate client feedback, product needs, and emerging trends to internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues and ensure appropriate follow-through.
  • Support successful customer transitions from implementation into ongoing Client Success.
  • Share insights and best practices that improve the broader customer experience.

Maintain Client Success Discipline

  • Maintain accurate account records, meeting notes, health indicators, action plans, and follow-up activities within SugarCRM.
  • Prepare thoroughly for client meetings using product, performance, and historical account data.
  • Manage a calendar-driven customer portfolio with consistent follow-through and clear prioritization.
  • Participate in ongoing training, coaching calibration, and professional development.
  • Operate with accountability for both customer outcomes and the quality of the client experience.

What You Bring

Automotive SaaS Client Success Experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in B2B Client/Customer Success, SaaS account management, or a comparable customer-facing role within the automotive technology ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated experience managing ongoing customer relationships beyond implementation or initial product sale.
  • Experience driving software adoption, customer engagement, retention, and measurable value within a recurring-revenue business.
  • Experience partnering with automotive dealerships and credibility with dealership leaders and operators.
  • Understanding of dealership operations and the ability to connect software capabilities to dealership business outcomes.
Direct dealership employment is not required. We are particularly interested in candidates who have successfully partnered with dealerships as customers while working within an automotive SaaS or technology organization.

Client Success & Commercial Acumen

  • Strong understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, value realization, retention, renewal, and expansion.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify customer risk and take proactive action before issues escalate.
  • Experience using business outcomes and ROI to reinforce customer value.
  • Ability to recognize expansion opportunities while maintaining a consultative, client-first approach.
  • Comfortable being accountable for customer health, retention, and long-term relationship quality.

Data & Analytical Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate software dashboards, analyze utilization and performance metrics, and translate data into actionable client recommendations.
  • Comfortable using quantitative information to tell a clear business story.
  • Ability to identify patterns, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across a portfolio of customers.
  • Strong preparation and analytical habits before client conversations.

Technology & Systems

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience using SugarCRM, Salesforce, or another enterprise CRM to manage customer relationships, document engagement, track account health, and maintain customer records.
  • High proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 for documentation, analysis, and executive presentations.
  • Comfortable conducting client relationships through virtual collaboration platforms such as Zoom or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Comfortable learning and becoming proficient in complex SaaS products and internal technology platforms.

Communication & Executive Presence

  • Strong virtual presentation, facilitation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from daily platform users to General Managers and senior dealership leadership.
  • Confidence presenting performance results and ROI to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to simplify complex information without losing the underlying business meaning.
  • Comfortable navigating difficult customer conversations with professionalism and composure.

Ownership & Execution

  • Highly organized and effective in a remote, calendar-driven environment.
  • Strong follow-through and attention to detail across a portfolio of accounts.
  • Proactive rather than reactive approach to customer management.
  • Coachable, adaptable, and comfortable operating against defined processes and measurable expectations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while partnering effectively across teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build trusted, strategic relationships with dealership customers.
  • Drive consistent adoption and effective utilization of Dynatron's software.
  • Connect platform usage to measurable dealership business outcomes.
  • Demonstrate value and ROI throughout the customer lifecycle - not just at renewal.
  • Identify customer risk early and act proactively to protect the relationship.
  • Create strong customer advocates while contributing to retention and expansion.
  • Maintain accurate, actionable customer information within the CRM.
  • Partner effectively across Dynatron to solve problems and improve the client experience.
  • Manage their portfolio with the discipline, consistency, and accountability expected of a high-performing SaaS Client Success organization.

Why Dynatron

  • Combine automotive expertise with a career in high-growth B2B SaaS.
  • Help dealerships turn technology and data into measurable business results.
  • Own meaningful, long-term customer relationships rather than transactional interactions.
  • Work closely with Product, Sales, Support, Implementation, and Client Success teams.
  • Remote-first environment offering flexibility, autonomy, and accountability.
  • Clear expectations, measurable outcomes, and opportunities for continued professional growth.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $96,500
Performance Incentives: Based on client outcomes, adoption, retention, and performance
Total Compensation Potential: Up to $149,999

Benefits Include

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Equity participation through Dynatron's Equity Incentive Plan
  • Employer-paid disability and life insurance
  • 401(k) with competitive company match
  • Flexible vacation policy and 11 paid company holidays
  • Home office setup support
  • Remote-first working environment
  • Ongoing professional development
If you're an Automotive SaaS Client Success professional who knows how to turn technology, data, and trusted customer relationships into measurable dealership results, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Launch Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Entreprenista: Entreprenista is a leading media company and home to the Entreprenista League, our vibrant membership community designed to support and empower women founders and leaders.
jobs.description:
About Entreprenista:

Entreprenista is a leading media company and home to the Entreprenista League, our vibrant membership community designed to support and empower women founders and leaders. From strategic partnerships with best-in-class business solutions to thoughtfully curated networking and educational events that spark meaningful business connections, Entreprenista is the go-to resource for women looking to grow and scale their businesses with purpose.

Role Description:

The Launch Manager is the operational hub of the marketing department, and the person who connects every team that touches a launch or a campaign. Big-picture brand strategy stays with leadership. This person owns the email marketing operations and lifecycle engine end to end, including the strategy behind it: the ideas and testing that push open rates, compliance, click-through rates, and conversion rates up, and the calls on what to build, what to test, and what to fix.

They keep the marketing calendar, run every marketing launch project to completion, build and manage email campaigns and automations, load and launch funnels and promotions, maintain reporting, ensure proper T&Cs, and keep the tech stack clean and connected. When the leadership team commits to something, this person turns it into a finished, tested, on-time deliverable and reports back on how it performed.

Success is simple to describe: marketing runs on time, the numbers are accurate and current, revenue grows against clear KPIs, and leadership no longer has to chase status or step in to keep things moving.

Core Responsibilities

1. Project and Calendar Management

  • Own and maintain the master email marketing calendar, tracking funnels, segmentation and email project management for products and launches.
  • Run email marketing project management end-to-end in ClickUp: create projects, assign tasks and owners, set deadlines, and track status to completion.
  • Own the launches we run each year and the evergreen campaigns that go out twice a month, and be the connector who keeps every team aligned around them.
  • Hold the whole department accountable to timelines. Flag risks early and keep work moving without being asked.
  • Lead or coordinate regular check-ins so everyone knows what's happening, what's due, and what's blocked.

2. Email Marketing and Automation

  • Build, schedule, test, and send email campaigns and promotions in Klaviyo.
  • Build and maintain marketing automations and flows: onboarding, nurture, re-engagement, renewal, promotional sequences, and any logic the team relies on.
  • Build and send member education and cross-sell campaigns that surface our other offers to existing members.
  • Build call-booking and show-rate campaigns, including reminder sequences, and A/B test the reminder cadence to increase show rates.
  • Manage list segmentation, tagging, and list hygiene so the right people get the right messages.
  • QA every send before it goes live: links, rendering, personalization, segments, and timing.
  • Ensure that emails are sent on time and to appropriate segments.

3. Funnels, Pages, and Campaign Builds

  • Build and load landing pages, sales pages, opt-ins, and lead magnets in Leadpages and our checkout tools (SamCart).
  • Wire up and test the full path: page, form, automation, checkout, and confirmation, so every funnel works before it goes live.
  • Coordinate creative and copy inputs from contractors, then assemble and launch the finished campaign.
  • Support new product launches as we build them out.

4. Analytics and Reporting

  • Improve and maintain marketing dashboards and KPI reporting in Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Supabase, and Claude.
  • Pull, organize, and interpret marketing data on a regular cadence. Keep reporting accurate and current at all times.
  • Track core metrics (list growth, open and click rates, conversion rates, campaign revenue, funnel performance, engagement) and surface what's working and what isn't.
  • Deliver clear, timely reporting to leadership with a point of view and practical recommendations.

5. Systems, Tools, and Integrations

  • Own the email marketing tech stack day to day. Keep platforms connected, clean, and working.
  • Audit the current stack and lead the effort to simplify it, consolidating tools and cutting cost and complexity wherever it makes sense.
  • Build and maintain integrations and automations across tools using Zapier.
  • Identify tooling gaps, broken connections, or data that isn't flowing correctly, and fix them or escalate with a recommendation.

6. Contractor and Agency Coordination

  • Coordinate the advertising specialist, contract copywriters, agencies, and outside vendors: timelines, deliverables, handoffs, and follow-through.
  • Be the central point of contact that keeps outside partners aligned with the internal calendar.
  • Make sure nothing falls through the cracks between internal needs and outside resources.

7. Documentation and Process

  • Document how things are done. Build and maintain SOPs for recurring marketing workflows.
  • Turn repeatable work into clean, repeatable processes the whole team can follow.
  • Keep documentation current as tools and workflows change.

Rhythm of the Role

Daily: Check project status and the calendar, move work forward, unblock what's stuck, QA and load anything going out, monitor active campaigns and automations.

Weekly: Build and send scheduled emails and promotions, update reporting, run or contribute to a marketing status check-in, coordinate with contractors and agencies on the week's deliverables.

Monthly: Full reporting pulled together for leadership with analysis and recommendations, review of upcoming calendar and campaigns, audit of automations and systems, documentation cleanup.

Ongoing: Spot bottlenecks before they become delays, improve processes, keep the stack clean, and ensure every initiative launches on time.


Requirements:
  • A track record of owning marketing operations or project management in a fast-moving environment. You can point to projects you kept on the rails and tell us exactly how.
  • You love execution more than brainstorming. The satisfaction of getting things done is what drives you.
  • You're extremely detail-oriented and organized to the point that details don't slip past you, and you're proactive about staying ahead of them.
  • You're technical and systems-minded. You learn new tools fast, and you like figuring out how they connect.
  • You're data-obsessed. Metrics, reporting, and accountability energize you instead of draining you.
  • You're a strong, resourceful problem solver who's comfortable figuring things out independently (no hand-holding required).
  • You move fast and you communicate well. You keep everyone aligned without being asked to.
  • You're on the pulse of the latest AI tools and how to use them for speed and efficiency. You stay current, and you get excited by working smarter.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Revenue growth through email
  • 80%+ retention
  • Projects consistently launch on time, predictably, not through last-minute heroics
  • Marketing reporting is accurate and timely, and leadership always has current visibility into key metrics
  • Marketing systems run smoothly, with automations and campaigns operating without constant patching
  • Campaigns get executed without needing oversight, because you own the details
  • Team communication improves, with clearer ownership and fewer status check-ins
  • Marketing becomes more scalable and less dependent on leadership stepping in

JOB OVERVIEW

Provides specialized application support to clients utilizing the company's revenue cycle management software, with a focus on therapy direct billing workflows. This role requires hands-on knowledge of the healthcare revenue cycle — from charge entry through claims submission, clearinghouse processing, and remittance — to accurately diagnose client issues and deliver clear, effective resolutions. Applies domain expertise in direct billing, payer configurations, and claim lifecycle management to resolve moderately to highly complex support cases. Establishes and contributes to resources that provide repeatable answers to common revenue cycle application questions and support patterns.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Respond to product application support inquiries from clients regarding revenue cycle workflows, including claims processing, payer configurations, remittance posting, and direct billing functions within the company's software
  • Receive and triage support cases, gathering relevant client information to accurately identify the nature and scope of the issue
  • Diagnose problems within revenue cycle software applications by reviewing client workflows, system logs, and claim data to pinpoint root causes and determine appropriate corrective action
  • Investigate claim submission and processing issues across the full claim lifecycle — from charge entry and clearinghouse transmission through 837/835 file processing, ERA receipt, and payment posting
  • Troubleshoot clearinghouse-related issues, including 837 transaction errors, acknowledgment (999/TA1) rejections, and 835 remittance file discrepancies, and communicate findings and resolution steps clearly to the client
  • Analyze payer-specific billing rules, claim edits, and rejection patterns to identify workflow gaps and recommend solutions within the software application
  • Work through identified issues methodically, leveraging internal tools, documentation, and system analytics to validate findings and confirm resolution
  • Communicate resolution steps, workflow corrections, and recommended best practices back to clients in a clear, structured manner aligned with their level of technical and billing expertise
  • Maintain thorough case documentation from intake through resolution, ensuring all troubleshooting steps, findings, and client communications are accurately recorded
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams with complete case context and documentation to facilitate efficient handoff
  • Leverage knowledge of direct billing workflows — including payer setup, claim submission, billing exception management, and remittance reconciliation — to support clients navigating therapy-specific billing environments
  • Support clients working within skilled nursing, outpatient therapy, or home health billing settings, applying familiarity with applicable payer requirements and claim form standards
  • Act as a voice of the customer by surfacing patterns, recurring issues, and client feedback to internal stakeholders for product and process improvements
  • Contribute to internal knowledge base resources, process documentation, and troubleshooting guides to support team consistency and scalability
  • Ensure consistent service quality during critical coverage windows, including holidays and off-hours, as needed
  • Some holiday, evening, and weekend hours will be required as needed to meet client needs and provide adequate coverage

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum education: High School Diploma or equivalent GED
  • 3+ years of experience in a revenue cycle, healthcare billing, or related application support role
  • Demonstrated experience with therapy direct billing workflows, including payer setup, claim submission, billing exception management, and remittance reconciliation — experience working within Optima Therapy strongly preferred
  • Prior experience with NetHealth direct bill RCM software strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with therapy-specific billing requirements including UB-04 and CMS-1500 claim forms, therapy cap tracking, and Medicare/Medicaid billing rules
  • Experience working with or supporting SNF, outpatient therapy, or home health billing teams in a billing, support, or implementation capacity

REQUIRED SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE

  • Microsoft Office
  • Common enterprise software solutions (i.e., NetSuite, Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, MS Project, SmartSheet, or equivalent)

  • Lead the execution and implementation of operational strategies and initiatives that support service delivery and organizational objectives.
  • Drive process standardization and workflow optimization across teams to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

  • Monitor operational performance and support teams in achieving established KPIs, service levels, and customer satisfaction targets.
  • Utilize technology, analytics, and reporting tools to reduce manual processes and improve operational productivity.
  • Support the execution of contact center transformation initiatives through process improvements, system enhancements, and scalable solutions.
  • Oversee the resolution of escalated operational issues and ensure consistent, timely communication and resolution processes.
  • Collaborate with department leaders to enhance operational processes and support alignment across teams.
  • Understand the organization’s underlying business processes and technologies to recommend improvements that drive efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Work with program and project leadership to implement processes and technologies that improve operational effectiveness and deliver business value.
  • Develop and maintain workflow rules and operational procedures that support consistency and scalability.
  • Maintain operational team performance and structure through analytics, processes, and tools; supports ongoing efficiency and productivity improvements.
  • Determines operational needs, identifies efficiency opportunities, and supports continuous improvement efforts aligned with corporate strategy.
  • Develops strong relationships with internal and external partners, including vendors and cross-functional stakeholders, to support operational execution.
  • Facilitate discussions and lead cross-functional initiatives to support Operations-critical priorities and execution of key programs.
  • Other related duties as needed.

EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business or accounting from an accredited college or university is required, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience.
  • Applicants should have at least eight years of management experience, with a proven track record of increased responsibilities. Preferred experience includes a focus on operations, customer service, contact centers, or the digital field, with a minimum of five years leading teams.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • High energy, motivated, self-starter, and applies professional concepts.
  • Exhibits professionalism in dealing with others and maintains constructive working relationships.
  • Must be able to accept constructive criticism; being flexible, versatile, and dependable.
  • Team skills, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships internally and externally.
  • Deep functional knowledge in two or more of the following areas: Operations, customer service transformation, customer service experience design and customer service process implementation, contact forecasting and work force management, quality management, center staffing and training, technology support.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, for interpersonal communication and collaborative management.
  • Exhibits a high degree of initiative and analytical skill to be able to handle and solve complex problems; thrives in a high-production environment.
  • Viewed as an expert resource by peers and coworkers; maintains a good working relationship with both internal and client management and has a thorough internal working knowledge of the enterprise.

  • A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace.
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced, community environment.
  • Excellent computer skills and proficient in Microsoft suite products, such as Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work in an environment that aligns with the company's diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging standards.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Demonstrate our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together, and Care Deeply.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This job is primarily sedentary and may involve repetitive motions; the colleague must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time, operate a computer and other office equipment, assess information and files stored electronically, and converse/exchange accurate information with others, simultaneously.
  • The colleague must be able to discern text displayed on a monitor, input data into specific fields using a keyboard, and adjust focus to distances of up to three feet.
  • Travel requirements include the colleague’s ability to move between work locations for client meetings and other fieldwork assignments.
  • The colleague must have the ability to learn new tasks, follow established processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, complete multiple tasks simultaneously, communicate professionally with colleagues and customers, and complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity requirement.
  • The colleague must be able to manage moderate to significant mental stress as a result of, but not limited to, a dynamic and heavy workload.

jobs.description:
Job Title: TikTok Shop Manager
Role: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Core Hours: 8am – 2pm PST
Salary Range: $700 - $900

ABOUT THE ROLE

As TikTok Shop Manager, you will be responsible for building our client's TikTok Shop from the ground up and managing it on an ongoing basis. You will handle everything from initial account registration and product catalog setup through to daily order operations, ad campaign management, affiliate program oversight, and monthly performance reporting. The ideal candidate has operated a high-volume TikTok Shop end-to-end and is comfortable navigating the full Seller Center toolkit.

PHASE 1 RESPONSIBILITIES — SHOP SETUP & CONFIGURATION

Shop Profile & Branding

  • Configure shop name, logo, banner imagery, categories, and storefront layout in Seller Center
  • Write a compelling, keyword-rich shop bio and description
  • Link the TikTok Business/Marketing Account(s) to the shop to enable shoppable video and product tagging

Product Catalog Setup

  • Audit the product range against TikTok's prohibited and restricted product policies and advise the client
  • List products individually or via bulk upload / Shopify catalog sync
  • Optimize product titles with niche search keywords, write detailed descriptions, and upload multi-angle imagery and demo videos
  • Understand and discuss with the client (and then implement) the optimal configuration for SKUs, variants, and pricing; set opening inventory levels
  • Submit all listings for TikTok product approval review and resolve any rejections
  • Conduct a test purchase to validate the full checkout and fulfillment flow

FBM and FBT Configuration

  • Configure FBM: Set warehouse / pickup and return addresses; create shipping templates covering rates, zones, and carrier selection
  • Configure FBT: enroll products, prepare inbound shipments to TikTok warehouses, and configure the free-shipping opt-in settings
  • If using Shopify: install and configure the TikTok channel app to enable real-time inventory and order sync
  • Author and publish the shop's return policy in compliance with applicable consumer protection laws
  • Draft 3PL to FBT ongoing inventory management plan and workflow.

Customer Service

  • Configure customer service notifications
  • Set up FAQs, saved responses, and response workflows
  • Establish return, refund, and cancellation handling procedures
  • Set escalation path for customer support issues

Advertising & Promotions Setup

  • Link TikTok Ads Manager to the shop and configure the primary ad account
  • Launch initial GMV Max campaign(s) — set target ROI, daily budget, and product selection
  • Set up TikTok Search Ads with relevant keyword targeting to capture intent-driven discovery
  • Configure TikTok Pixel if driving traffic to an external website or landing page
  • Build out and maintain welcome promotions, platform coupons, and launch discount strategies in Seller Center

Affiliate / Creator Program Setup

  • Enable and configure the Affiliate Center, including open and targeted collaboration plans
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to set baseline and tiered commission structures across product categories
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to establish a product seeding / free sample program and write a creator brief with content guidelines

PHASE 2 RESPONSIBILITIES — ONGOING MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor and respond to all buyer messages within 12 hours
  • Verify the processing and fulfillment of new orders
  • Review and action open return and refund requests in line with shop policy
  • Monitor product and video comments for customer questions, complaints, or escalations
  • Check the Shop Health dashboard daily for violations, warnings, or Late Dispatch Rate (LDR) increases

Weekly Operations

  • Review GMV Max campaign performance (cost, orders, CPA, ROI) and adjust target ROI as needed
  • Audit GMV Max creative assets and exclude under-performing videos
  • Review inventory levels and initiate restock for SKUs approaching low thresholds
  • Sync inventory counts across all sales channels to prevent overselling
  • Review Search Ads keyword performance and refine bids and match types
  • Monitor and respond to product reviews; flag patterns requiring action
  • Update product listings as needed: pricing, imagery, descriptions, or promotional badges

Monthly Operations

  • Produce a full performance report covering GMV, orders, ad spend, ROAS, and affiliate ROI
  • Export raw order data and build a net revenue / P&L analysis — accounting for referral fees, transaction fees, affiliate commissions, and fulfillment costs
  • Reconcile payouts against Seller Center invoices
  • Review TikTok's ACE Powered Insights for platform-generated growth recommendations
  • Analyze SKU-level performance and identify top and bottom performers
  • Plan and schedule upcoming promotions, flash sales, and seasonal campaigns
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator Team to review and adjust affiliate commission rates; roll out performance bonuses for top creators
  • Review FBT warehouse inventory and plan replenishment inbound shipments
  • Conduct a shop health audit covering seller score, policy compliance, and LDR trends
  • Monitor TikTok platform policy updates, fee changes, and new ad format rollouts

Quarterly / Strategic Operations

  • Set and document measurable growth goals for the upcoming quarter in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Evaluate catalog expansion opportunities: new SKUs, product bundles, or virtual bundles
  • Review and optimize the fulfillment strategy mix (FBT vs. seller-ship vs. 3PL)
  • Audit the full technology and integration stack: inventory sync tools, shipping apps, analytics platforms
  • Evaluate eligibility for premium seller tiers including Star Shop and Mall status

Crisis & Issue Management

  • Triage and respond to Shop Health violations — pause campaigns and slow order intake if LDR spikes
  • Conduct root cause analysis for fulfillment failures or policy incidents and implement corrective action
  • File TikTok support tickets with supporting documentation when external factors are responsible
  • Manage chargebacks, fraud disputes, and escalated return or refund claims

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Platform & Technical

  • Proven hands-on experience managing a TikTok Shop end-to-end via Seller Center — from initial registration through to active daily management
  • Deep familiarity with TikTok Shop Ads — specifically GMV Max campaign setup, optimization, and creative management
  • Working knowledge of Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT): inbound shipping, warehouse management, and fee structures
  • Experience with TikTok Shop's affiliate and creator program: collaboration setup, commission structures, and creator relationship management
  • Proficiency with TikTok Seller Center tools: Shop Health dashboard, ACE Powered Insights, order management, and promotions
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms for catalog and inventory sync
  • Familiarity with TikTok Search Ads and keyword-based campaign strategy

Operations & Analytics

  • Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's fee structure — referral fees, transaction fees, FBT costs, affiliate commissions, and refund admin fees
  • Ability to build and interpret P&L analyses and net revenue reports from raw Seller Center order data
  • Experience managing customer service operations within a 12-hour response SLA
  • Comfortable managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels and preventing overselling

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Highly organized and process-driven — able to manage multiple daily, weekly, and monthly operational rhythms simultaneously
  • Proactive communicator — surfaces issues, opportunities, and insights to stakeholders without prompting
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving platform environment where policies and features change frequently
  • Detail-oriented with a strong compliance mindset around TikTok's evolving seller policies

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • In the first 30 days: The shop is fully configured, the product catalog is live and approved, fulfillment is operational, the GMV Max campaign is running, and the affiliate program is open for creator applications.
  • By 90 days: The shop has an active roster of affiliate creators generating content, ad campaigns have been optimized based on real performance data, and a regular reporting cadence is in place.
  • Ongoing: The shop maintains a healthy seller score, a sub-12-hour message response rate, and a consistent upward GMV trend quarter-over-quarter.

Estamos a contratar: Senior Python Engineer

Localização: Portugal
Regime: Remoto

Estamos à procura de um(a) Senior Python Engineer para integrar uma equipa tecnológica focada no desenvolvimento de sistemas backend modernos, escaláveis e orientados a dados.

Esta função terá um papel central na construção de serviços cloud-native, APIs de elevada performance e pipelines de dados em tempo real, utilizando tecnologias modernas de cloud, streaming e automação.

Se tens forte experiência em Python, paixão por engenharia backend e interesse em ambientes distribuídos e orientados a dados, esta oportunidade é para ti.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Como Senior Python Engineer, serás responsável pelo desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de serviços backend robustos e escaláveis, trabalhando com arquiteturas modernas e plataformas cloud.

Irás colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para desenvolver soluções de elevada qualidade, garantindo performance, fiabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia.

Terás também um papel ativo na definição de arquitetura técnica, automação de infraestrutura e evolução contínua das plataformas tecnológicas.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços backend utilizando Python;
  • Construir APIs de elevada performance, preferencialmente com FastAPI;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para aplicações escaláveis;
  • Trabalhar com infraestrutura cloud, especialmente em Azure;
  • Implementar infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform;
  • Containerizar e orquestrar aplicações com Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Integrar workflows de dados com plataformas como Databricks, Snowflake ou Airflow;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados em tempo real com tecnologias de streaming (Kafka ou Kinesis);
  • Colaborar com equipas técnicas e de produto na entrega de soluções robustas;
  • Garantir boas práticas de qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

O que Procuramos

  • Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência profissional em Python;
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de APIs com FastAPI;
  • Forte conhecimento de Terraform, Kubernetes e Docker;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de modelação de dados;
  • Experiência com Databricks, Snowflake ou Airflow;
  • Experiência com plataformas Azure Cloud;
  • Forte experiência com tecnologias de streaming, especialmente Kafka;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação em inglês (oral e escrita).

Será valorizado:

  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD e práticas DevOps;
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas distribuídos e arquiteturas de microserviços;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitorização e logging;
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud-native de elevada escala.

O que Oferecemos

  • Regime totalmente remoto a partir de Portugal;
  • Participação em projetos modernos e tecnologicamente desafiantes;
  • Integração numa equipa técnica especializada e colaborativa;
  • Ambiente focado em inovação, automação e melhoria contínua;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento técnico e evolução profissional;
  • Contacto com tecnologias modernas de backend, cloud e data engineering;
  • Pacote salarial competitivo, ajustado à experiência.

Queres desenvolver sistemas backend modernos, escaláveis e orientados a dados?

Junta-te a nós e contribui para construir plataformas robustas, cloud-native e preparadas para o futuro.

jobs.description:
Job Description

IHME has an outstanding opportunity for a Managing Research Scientist to join their team.

About this Opportunity

Reporting to Faculty Team Leader, the Managing Research Scientist is responsible for the following: As a Managing Research Scientist, you will independently perform quantitative analyses, contribute to research design and dissemination, and supervise members on your research team. You will be responsible for managing the scope, timeline, and resources required to deliver high-quality study results, while coordinating with collaborating research sites and partners.

We are looking for someone to join a new initiative within the Program in Cardiovascular Health Metrics focused on heart disease in women. The project links gold-standard clinical registry data with large-scale administrative datasets to investigate the burden of coronary microvascular disease burden and its risk factors. This position is contingent on project funding

Key Responsibilities

Supervisory Responsibilities: 20%

  • Supervise employees to include hiring and training, leading workflow; priority setting; reviewing work and establishing quality standards; conducting regular performance assessments, providing mentorship and professional development for employees, and making recommendations for disciplinary action as needed.
  • Identify training needs and opportunities for team members to grow their skills and advance their careers; Ensure that the team has the necessary resources to complete their tasks effectively.
  • Promote positive morale and positive progress towards objectives across the team; lead effective and efficient team meetings that are structured, inclusive of consultation and constructive feedback, and result in identifiable next steps for team members.
  • Keep team members motivated and engaged, recognizing their achievements, and addressing any issues that may affect morale.
  • Monitor individual and team performance, providing feedback, and helping to resolve any performance issues; assist the team in overcoming obstacles, making decisions, and resolving conflicts.
  • Ensure that the team adheres to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Attend required trainings about team leadership, management, and related topics as designated by team and organizational leaders.

Project Management: 20%

  • Define, scope, and document the work for the assigned research project to deliver timely, high-quality results.
  • Identify key priorities while balancing competing project objectives; propose work-plan adjustments, and proactively raise risks to delivery along with recommendations for mitigation.
  • Set and meet deadlines for the project team and for direct reports; maintain central tracking mechanisms to communicate progress on research outputs to internal and external stakeholders.

Research Dissemination 60%

  • Exhibit command of team research area, including the methodology, components, and how it intersects and intertwines with the larger IHME research enterprise in order to effectively manage the work, engage partners in the research process, as well as lead trainings, give presentations, and conduct seminars on substantive research topics to internal and external partners.
  • Independently carry out quantitative analyses, including person-level longitudinal data analysis, interpret and vet results from your own results and from other team members, formulate conclusions, and inform team leaders.
  • Develop and implement new computational and statistical methods. Write, test, and maintain code in R, the primary language for the team’s analytic pipelines; experience with Python as a second language is a plus. Maintain, modify, and execute analytic machinery that generates results.
  • Contribute to research design and identify innovative solutions to issues.
  • Draft presentations and manuscripts and contribute to funding proposals. Lead and co-author scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Maintain scientific awareness and intellectual agility with data, methods, and analytic techniques; manage and anticipate change and guide others to adapt effectively in the iterative research process.
  • Grow a peer network where sought out as having solid command of disease and risk factor modelling methods, key indicators, and the related data sources and scientific underpinnings.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Department.

  • Master’s degree in public health, epidemiology, statistics, biostatistics, math, economics, quantitative social sciences, or related discipline plus four years’ related experience.

Additional Qualifications

  • Previous supervisory experience with hiring, developing employees, priority setting, setting quality standards, and performance coaching.
  • Excellent analytic, critical thinking, and quantitative disease modelling skills.
  • Intermediate knowledge of and experience with project management methods, including scoping work, setting deadlines, and tracking and reporting progress for self and supervisees.
  • Results- and detail-oriented; initiate and complete tasks under tight deadlines and changing priorities both independently and in a team environment.
  • Experience devising and executing statistical modeling techniques.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly recognize problems in results, identify root causes in data, methods, and code, and implement solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in designing, executing, and troubleshooting code in R.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills required, including track record of success in co-authorship on multiple scientific papers, presenting results, and representing research at meetings.
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute to and sustain collaborations with external research teams, and to coordinate work across interdependent teams.
  • Experience in working with large datasets, including devising strategies for reliable data management, computationally efficient modeling techniques, and critical evaluation of highly multidimensional model outputs.
  • Experience with small-area or geospatial epidemiologic models.
  • Ability to work both independently and in collaboration with a team.
  • Interest in a management-level research scientist position contributing to the overall mission of IHME’s research.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MD or PhD in public health, epidemiology, statistics, biostatistics, math, economics, or quantitative social sciences plus two years’ experience preferred.
  • Experience with cardiovascular disease and risk factor modelling using large datasets.
  • Experience with Python as a second programming language.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior employees on soft and technical skills.
  • Peer-reviewed publication record.
  • Experience implementing hierarchical models, particularly small area estimation or geospatial models.
  • Experience working with US survey, census, vital registration, and other data sources.

Working Conditions

  • Weekend and evening work are sometimes required and communicated in advance.
  • This position is open to anyone authorized to work in the US.
  • Working internationally is only allowed for IHME sponsored work that requires in-country participation.
  • Office is located in Seattle, Washington. This position is eligible to work fully remote in the US; work schedule required to overlap with 50% of IHME office hours, between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. Pacific Time as agreed upon between employee and supervisor.

Application Requirement

This recruitment requires references and a cover letter. Applications that do not include this will not be forwarded to the hiring department.

Please attach a cover letter to your application:

  • Please provide three references in your cover letter with at least one reference being a past or present supervisor.

About the Team

The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) is an independent research organization at the University of Washington (UW). Its mission is to deliver to the world timely, relevant, and scientifically valid evidence to improve health policy and practice. IHME carries out its mission through a range of projects within different research areas including the Global Burden of Diseases (GBD), Injuries, and Risk Factors; Future Health Scenarios; Cost Effectiveness and Efficiency; Resource Tracking; and Impact Evaluations.

Compensation, Benefits and Position Details

Pay Range Minimum:

$120,000.00 annual

Pay Range Maximum:

$143,820.00 annual

Other Compensation:

-

For information about benefits for this position, visit

Shift:

This is a regular position

About the UW

Working at the University of Washington provides a unique opportunity to change lives – on our campuses, in our state and around the world.

UW employees bring their boundless energy, creative problem-solving skills and dedication to building stronger minds and a healthier world. Position Overview

The Chief Learning Officer (CLO) is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise-wide learning, development, and workforce capability strategy. The CLO drives a culture of continuous learning by designing and implementing programs that enhance employee skills, leadership capabilities, performance, and organizational effectiveness. This role ensures the workforce remains future-ready by aligning learning initiatives with business objectives, digital transformation efforts, and evolving industry demands.

Key Responsibilities

Learning & Development Strategy

Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise learning and development strategy aligned with business goals.

Establish a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

Identify future workforce capabilities and skills required to support organizational success.

Leadership Development & Succession Planning

Design and implement leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

Support succession planning initiatives to strengthen leadership pipelines.

Develop executive coaching and mentoring programs.

Talent Development & Workforce Capability

Assess organizational skills gaps and implement targeted development initiatives.

Create learning pathways that support career progression and internal mobility.

Drive workforce upskilling and reskilling initiatives.

Learning Technologies & Digital Learning

Oversee learning management systems (LMS), digital learning platforms, and educational technologies.

Leverage e-learning, microlearning, AI-driven learning tools, and virtual training solutions.

Ensure accessibility and scalability of learning programs across the organization.

Organizational Effectiveness

Partner with business leaders to align learning initiatives with strategic priorities.

Support organizational transformation and change management through learning interventions.

Improve employee productivity and performance through targeted development programs.

Performance & Learning Analytics

Develop metrics and KPIs to measure learning effectiveness and business impact.

Monitor employee participation, skill development, certification attainment, and performance outcomes.

Use analytics to continuously improve learning programs.

Compliance & Regulatory Training

Ensure delivery of mandatory compliance, regulatory, and risk management training.

Maintain records and reporting to support audit and compliance requirements.

Partner with legal, compliance, and risk teams to ensure training effectiveness.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Collaborate with HR, talent management, operations, technology, and business leaders.

Engage external training providers, universities, professional bodies, and industry partners.

Support employer branding through workforce development initiatives.

Innovation & Knowledge Management

Promote knowledge-sharing practices across the organization.

Develop learning communities, mentorship programs, and centers of excellence.

Introduce innovative approaches to employee learning and development.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead and mentor learning and development teams.

Build high-performing learning organizations capable of supporting enterprise growth.

Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

12–15+ years of progressive experience in learning and development, talent management, organizational development, or workforce transformation roles.

Proven experience leading enterprise learning strategies and leadership development programs.

Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and learning technologies.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic learning and workforce development expertise.

Leadership development and succession planning capabilities.

Strong organizational development and change management skills.

Expertise in learning technologies and digital learning platforms.

Excellent communication, coaching, and facilitation skills.

Analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities.

Executive stakeholder management and influence.

Performance Metrics

Employee learning participation and completion rates.

Leadership pipeline strength and succession readiness.

Workforce upskilling and reskilling outcomes.

Learning program effectiveness and ROI.

Employee engagement and development satisfaction scores.

Compliance training completion and audit results.

Organizational capability and productivity improvements.

Ideal Background

Candidates typically come from:

Corporate Learning & Development Leadership

Talent Development & Organizational Development

Human Resources Executive Leadership

Leadership Development & Executive Coaching

Higher Education & Corporate Training

Learning Technology & Workforce Transformation

Consulting Firms specializing in Talent and Organizational Effectiveness

jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewThe Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments. The role focuses on driving long-term client value, satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring exceptional service delivery and deep, trusted client relationships. The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive client strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client base.
  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality client experience across all touchpoints.
  • Oversee client onboarding, engagement, and success management processes.
  • Implement frameworks to measure and improve client satisfaction (NPS, CSAT).

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee key account management teams and client delivery functions.
  • Ensure client expectations are met through effective service delivery.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, operations, product, marketing, and support teams.
  • Ensure client feedback is integrated into product development and service improvements.
  • Align internal teams around client needs and priorities.

Client Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze client behavior, feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve client engagement and satisfaction.
  • Provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in acquiring high-value clients and strategic accounts.
  • Participate in client pitches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Strengthen executive-level client relationships during pre- and post-sales cycles.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs for client success, retention, and growth.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to CEO and executive leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor client success, account management, and service teams.
  • Build a client-centric culture across the organization.
  • Drive continuous training and professional development initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in client management, account management, customer success, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or high-value client relationships.
  • Strong experience in service delivery, relationship management, or client success leadership.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking.
  • Customer-centric leadership mindset.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills.
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management.

Performance Metrics

  • Client retention and churn rate.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Revenue growth from existing clients.
  • Success of key account management initiatives.
  • SLA adherence and service quality performance.

If you want, I can also create:

  • LinkedIn Boolean search for Chief Client Officers
  • Yes/No prerequisite screening questions
  • MCQ knockout questions
  • Short LinkedIn job post version
  • Industry-specific versions (banking, SaaS, consulting, fintech)
