Chief Strategy Officer (CSO)

Location: [City, Country]
Reports To: CEO / Chief Executive Officer / Board of Directors

Position Overview

The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The role focuses on identifying growth opportunities, driving transformation initiatives, improving competitive positioning, and ensuring alignment of all business units with corporate objectives. The CSO acts as a key advisor to the CEO and leadership team on strategic direction and enterprise-wide priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy Development

  • Develop and execute the organization's short-, medium-, and long-term strategic plans.
  • Define strategic priorities aligned with business growth and market positioning.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on market trends, competition, and internal performance.

Growth & Expansion Strategy

  • Identify new markets, business opportunities, and revenue streams.
  • Lead initiatives for geographic expansion, diversification, and innovation.
  • Support scalable and sustainable business growth strategies.

Business Transformation & Execution

  • Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives (digital, operational, organizational).
  • Translate strategic plans into actionable business roadmaps.
  • Ensure execution alignment across all departments and business units.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and macroeconomic factors.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve competitive advantage.
  • Identify risks and opportunities impacting business performance.

Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

  • Lead or support M&A strategy, due diligence, and integration planning.
  • Evaluate strategic partnerships, alliances, and joint ventures.
  • Assess investment opportunities aligned with long-term strategy.

Performance Monitoring & KPIs

  • Define key strategic KPIs and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Monitor execution of strategic initiatives across the organization.
  • Provide regular updates and insights to CEO and Board.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with finance, operations, HR, marketing, product, and technology teams.
  • Ensure alignment of departmental strategies with enterprise goals.
  • Drive organization-wide coordination of strategic initiatives.

Innovation & Future Planning

  • Identify emerging trends, technologies, and business models.
  • Drive innovation initiatives and future-focused strategic planning.
  • Support digital transformation and modernization efforts.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Engage with investors, partners, and external stakeholders on strategic matters.
  • Act as a key advisor to the CEO on critical business decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate development, or executive leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in leading strategic initiatives and business transformation.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and organizational strategy.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent analytical and business acumen.
  • Leadership and executive influence skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation capabilities.
  • Ability to drive change and manage complex transformations.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of strategic growth objectives.
  • Success of transformation and execution initiatives.
  • Market share and competitive positioning improvement.
  • M&A and partnership value creation.
  • Alignment and execution efficiency across business units.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.

Requirements

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Highlights

Build next-generation AI agents using C#, Azure, MCP and Azure OpenAI. Join AnywhereNow's Agent Factory team to create enterprise AI solutions that move from concept to production.

jobs.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer

(.NET / C# & React)

Remote | LATAM | Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD $23–26/hour (approximately $3,680–$4,160/month)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript to join an innovative engineering team building scalable, high-quality web applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both front-end and back-end development, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving complex technical challenges.

This is an AI-first engineering environment where AI-assisted and agentic development are integral to the software development process. You should have hands-on experience leveraging AI coding assistants and autonomous agents to accelerate development, improve efficiency, and deliver reliable solutions.

Beyond using AI tools, you must be able to critically evaluate, test, and take ownership of AI-generated code, ensuring it meets production standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript.

  • Build responsive front-end experiences and reliable back-end services.

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Review, debug, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams to design and deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.

  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and AI-powered engineering tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

  • Strong proficiency in .NET (C#) and experience developing back-end applications.

  • Solid front-end development skills with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

  • Hands-on professional experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic development tools to build, debug, and improve software.

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling.

  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.

  • Understanding of web application security best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Experience customizing AI development workflows, including custom prompts, tool integrations, or multi-agent systems.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Compensation & Engagement Details

  • Engagement: International Independent contractor

  • Compensation: USD $23–26/hour (approximately $3,680–$4,160/month).

  • Timesheets: Hours worked must be documented and submitted through timesheets.

  • Time Off: Days off, sick days, and local public holidays are unpaid and non-billable. There may be opportunities to work on certain holidays.

  • Equipment: The company will provide and ship the required hardware.

  • Expected Start Date: Approximately four weeks after signing the offer to allow for equipment shipment and setup.

Recruitment Process

Candidates can expect the following steps:

  1. Latino Legends Application: Complete our application for through our website.

  2. Recorded Screening Questionnaire: Short recorded responses to help us assess your experience and communication skills. Successful candidates will be submitted to the client's ATS.

  3. Initial Technical Challenge: A one-hour technical exercise. Candidates are not expected to complete the entire task; the goal is to demonstrate their approach and problem-solving skills.

  4. Hiring Manager Interview: Discuss your technical challenge, approach, and implementation decisions.

  5. Peer Interview: Meet with members of the engineering team.

  6. Final Interview: Conversation with the SVP of Engineering.

  7. Reference Checks: Successful finalists will be asked to provide 2–3 professional references from previous supervisors, managers, or team leaders before the formal offer is issued.

Ready to take the next step in your engineering career? Apply through Latino Legends!

Clovr Labs is recruiting a Software Engineer to work on new and interesting projects.

Clovr Labs is incorporated in Spain and the team meets regularly in Barcelona. We speak English and Spanish, most of the time at the same time, but we would appreciate it if you could send us the contents of your application in English.

Data Scientist

Location: Cape Town (Remote)

Our client, a dynamic UK-based tech startup is seeking a Data Scientist to help transform complex geospatial and radar data into actionable insights that enhance transport and logistics operations for global brands and public-sector clients.

This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to collaborate with an international team, contribute to groundbreaking machine learning initiatives, and grow within a fast-paced, venture-backed environment.

Introduction

Are you passionate about leveraging data to solve complex, real-world problems?
Our client is looking for a skilled Data Scientist to lead the development of advanced machine learning models and geospatial analytics that power smarter transport and logistics solutions.

If you have experience with spatial data, radar analytics, and predictive modeling and thrive in an innovative startup environment where autonomy, creativity, and technical depth are valued this role is your opportunity to make a tangible impact.

You'll join a collaborative team bridging the UK and South Africa, turning rich sensor and geospatial datasets into intelligence that drives meaningful operational improvements for top-tier clients and major government agencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop machine learning models to analyze geospatial and radar data for transport and logistics applications.

  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that optimize vehicle and people movement across public and private sectors.

  • Collaborate with UK-based leadership and South African technical teams to design and implement innovative data-driven solutions.

  • Continuously improve data collection, processing, and predictive modeling methods to enhance performance and accuracy.

  • Manage the full data science lifecycle from problem definition and model development to deployment and performance monitoring.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, iterating quickly and refining solutions based on client feedback.

  • Contribute to building and scaling the data science function, with potential to lead and mentor future team members.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelors, Honours, Masters, or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • 3 - 5 years of professional experience in data science, including end-to-end project delivery.

  • Proven expertise in machine learning (e.g., linear regression, XGBoost) and predictive modeling.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL, with experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with geospatial data, GIS, or radar analytics is highly advantageous.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with technical depth and minimal client-facing focus.

  • Comfortable working in an agile startup setting with fast iteration cycles and evolving priorities.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to translate complex technical insights effectively.

Core Skills & Experience

  • Machine learning & data science: Building and validating classification/regression models; applying precision/recall, confusion matrices, and error analysis to drive improvements.

  • Python expertise: Strong experience with ML, data processing, and visualisation libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, matplotlib, plotly, etc.).

  • Sensor data handling: Comfortable working with spatial time-series data (radar point clouds, GPS, UWB, accelerometer, etc.).

  • Visualisation & dashboards: Translating outputs into actionable insights via plots, overlays, and interactive dashboards.
    Cloud data engineering: Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for data ingestion, storage, and analytics (e.g., IoT Hub, S3, Pub/Sub, CosmosDB/BigQuery).

  • Collaboration & documentation: Effective cross-disciplinary communication; producing reproducible code, pipelines, and well-documented results.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Radar data: Exposure to radar sensors and features (RCS, Doppler, track stability) a strong advantage.

  • Data fusion: Combining multiple sensor data streams (radar, video, GPS, UWB) into coherent datasets.

  • Contextual data integration: Enriching sensor data with external sources such as weather, points of interest, events, and demographic data.

  • Geospatial data: Experience with maps, coordinate systems, overlays, and spatial/temporal data joins.

  • Cloud-native pipelines: Deploying ML/data pipelines using serverless functions, containers, and workflow tools (e.g., Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, GCP Dataflow).

  • Scalable storage & analytics: Handling large datasets using distributed processing and query engines (e.g., SQL, Spark, Databricks).

Ready to Make an Impact?

If youre ready to transform geospatial and radar data into meaningful insights that drive smarter, more efficient transport and logistics solutions, our client wants to hear from you.

Join an ambitious, globally connected team where your machine learning expertise will directly shape real-world outcomes and accelerate innovation in the data science space.

Job Description
As a Platform Engineer, you'll build and own the software that takes our ML models from research to production: the Theia SDK that runs real-time inference at the edge, the APIs and services our customers and partners integrate with, and the cloud infrastructure behind our data and model pipelines. You'll work closely with our ML engineers and researchers, so you'll need to understand how models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, but your core focus is building reliable, well-designed systems around them.

What You'll Do

  • SDK Development: Design, build, and maintain the Theia SDK in Python and C++, delivering real-time eye-tracking inference across desktop, mobile, embedded, and XR platforms. Own packaging, performance, versioning, and the developer experience.
  • API & Backend Development: Design and implement APIs and backend services for data ingestion, model serving, licensing, and customer integrations, with a focus on clean interfaces, reliability, and security.
  • Cloud Engineering: Build and operate infrastructure on AWS, including containerized services on Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Full Stack: Build internal tools, dashboards, and customer-facing web interfaces that make our data and models accessible.
  • Data Science Engineering: Build and scale the pipelines that process millions of eye-tracking records for training, evaluation, and analytics. Clean, transform, validate, and analyze large tabular datasets, and build the tooling that lets our ML team explore and work with data efficiently.
  • ML Productionization: Partner with ML engineers to deploy, optimize, and monitor models in production and at the edge, including model conversion, latency and memory optimization, and inference pipelines.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience building production systems
  • Strong Python skills, including packaging and distributing libraries
  • Working familiarity with C++ (reading, modifying, and building C++ code in a cross-platform codebase)
  • Experience designing and building APIs (REST, gRPC, or similar) and backend services
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, containers, and CI/CD
  • Experience working with large tabular datasets in pandas (data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, and performance at scale)
  • Working familiarity with machine learning: you understand the model lifecycle and have helped deploy or integrate ML models in a product
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working across engineering and research teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience building and shipping SDKs or libraries used by external developers
  • SQL and database engineering (schema design, query optimization, PostgreSQL or similar)
  • Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)
  • Frontend experience (React or similar)
  • Edge or on-device inference (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, Core ML, or similar)
  • Python compilation or distribution tooling (Nuitka, Cython, pybind11, or similar)
  • Exposure to time-series, sensor, or signal-processing data
  • Interest in VR/AR, eye tracking, or human-computer interaction
  • 1 year experience in a research setting (developing or working with ML research domains)

Why Join Us

  • Remote role with room to grow into automation, tooling, and AI-engineering work—not a pure manual-QA seat
  • Direct exposure to a novel technical stack: real-time eye-tracking, ML pipelines, SDKs, and VR/AR integrations
  • Tight feedback loop with senior engineering and leadership—the work you ship is felt across the company

How to Apply

This position reports into the engineering team. We're looking for someone who pairs solid QA fundamentals with curiosity for automation and AI-assisted workflows.

With your submission please attach:

  1. Your resume
  2. GitHub profile, portfolio, or links to relevant work (test suites, scripts, automations welcome)
  3. A short note on a bug you're proud of finding—or an automation/script that saved you or your team meaningful time

HarmonEyes is the world's only open, AI-powered eye-tracking platform that identifies and predicts a person's cognitive, emotional, and physical state based on eye movements alone. Compatible with any camera-based device, HarmonEyes provides a one-stop shop to analyze eye-tracking data, develop models, and deploy solutions to applications at scale with the Theia™ SDK. Backed by 60+ years of eye-tracking experience and born from the largest validated eye-tracking database (14 million unique records), HarmonEyes is used by the world's leading organizations in technology, aviation/automotive, healthcare, and elite performance in military and sports.

We follow philosophies such as Secure by Design, Defense in Depth, and Zero Trust networking. We are a team of software engineers and builders. We pride ourselves in first principles thinking and we are driven to become an innovation hub in the Security industry.

As a core member of the security team, you will contribute to multiple domains such as Cloud Security, Application Security, Detection & Response, and Privacy. You will write code, build systems, and work cross-functionally with every team at Pipe in order to support Security's mission. You will work with our IT team to ensure that we set appropriate security standards to maintain a compliant organization, and work with our Infrastructure team to ensure that we consistently meet those standards. You will be responsible for continually monitoring and updating the team's security posture, and maintaining processes and a culture that encourages a secure mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Review and help design robust security standards and monitoring
  • Maintain and improve our policy-as-code platform to enable rapid detection and response
  • Work closely with our Infrastructure team to ensure cloud-based deployments have proper monitoring and adhere to our policies
  • Manage SOC II audits, set a high standard for compliant software and processes, and ensure we consistently meet those standards
  • Participate in on-call rotation to support critical security issues
  • Own the vulnerability disclosure program and triage inbound reports to security@
  • Run periodic tabletop exercises and incident response drills
  • Maintain security policies and lead recurring reviews (e.g., firewall changes, security reviews)
  • Lead responses to partner and customer security questionnaires
  • Maintain the security risk register, track remediation, and produce periodic security metrics for leadership

Tech Stack

We are committed to using the right tools for the problems we are trying to solve. We are not dogmatic, but our current stack includes:

  • Frontend: Typescript, React, Next.js
  • Backend: Go, PostgreSQL, BigQuery
  • Data: BigQuery, Sqlmesh, Python
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Pulumi, Buildkite, Google Cloud Platform
  • Security: Panther, Wiz, Vanta

Our stack reflects the tools we've found most effective for the problems we solve. Strong candidates will have hands-on experience with most of these technologies and the technical range to pick up what's new quickly.

Technical Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes security
  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript - enough to build and maintain internal tooling
  • Experience owning SOC 2 (or equivalent) compliance programs end-to-end, including evidence collection, auditor management, and remediation
  • Experience running incident response, including on-call, post-mortems, and tabletop exercises
  • Experience managing vendor risk reviews and responding to customer security questionnaires
  • Strong written communication - this role interfaces with auditors, customers, partners, and engineers

You will be successful at Pipe if you:

  • Want to join a remote-first startup and make a real impact
  • Hold yourself and your teammates to high standards
  • Have a strong technical foundation and use your skills to help customers succeed
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your work and enjoy collaborating across functions

Compensation and Benefits

We are a fully remote company and we believe in taking care of our employees. As a Pipe employee, you'll receive:

  • The best equipment to help you do your job
  • Flexible vacation and work hours - we believe in a healthy work-life balance (really!)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous parental leave for anyone growing their family, regardless of gender

Before You Apply

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer who thrives on building secure, scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

You'll join an international engineering organisation responsible for the cloud platforms powering enterprise software used by customers worldwide.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes, you'll help ensure that critical applications remain secure, available and performant while making it easier for engineering teams to build, test and deploy software.

This is a hands-on role combining cloud engineering, site reliability, security and automation.

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating repetitive tasks and improving how software is delivered, this could be an excellent opportunity.

What You'll Be Working On

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes

  • Manage, maintain and optimise cloud infrastructure hosted on Microsoft Azure.
  • Operate and secure production Kubernetes environments, particularly Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Work across cloud networking, identity management, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Maintain reliable, scalable environments supporting enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Deliver platform upgrades, patches and hotfixes while minimising disruption to customers.

Site Reliability & Performance

Reliability isn't just about responding when something breaks. It's about engineering systems that are less likely to fail.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Defining and monitoring Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Implementing monitoring, alerting and observability solutions.
  • Investigating production incidents and identifying root causes.
  • Participating in on-call support and coordinating incident resolution.
  • Conducting post-incident reviews and implementing lasting improvements.
  • Testing backup, restoration and disaster recovery procedures.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design, build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Integrate automated testing, quality checks and security controls into deployment workflows.
  • Improve software release processes to make deployments faster, safer and more predictable.
  • Establish standards for source control, development environments and release readiness.
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Reduce manual operational tasks through automation and infrastructure improvements.

Cloud Security

Security is an integral part of this role.

You'll help protect cloud infrastructure and customer environments by:

  • Identifying, prioritising and remediating vulnerabilities.
  • Managing security patches, certificates, secrets and access permissions.
  • Applying security best practices across Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Supporting secure configuration and maintenance of production environments.
  • Contributing to continuous improvements in infrastructure security.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with software engineers and technical teams across Europe, North America and Australia.
  • Help establish and improve engineering and operational standards.
  • Share knowledge and support other engineers in adopting DevOps best practices.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides and runbooks.
  • Contribute to a culture of reliability, automation and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or cloud operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Proven experience deploying, managing and securing Kubernetes in production, ideally using AKS.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps YAML.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Practical experience implementing monitoring, alerting and incident response processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security patching and secrets management.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing production environments.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server and SQL Server.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

Observability & Monitoring

  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Loki
  • Tempo
  • OpenTelemetry

Security & Compliance

  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  • Azure Policy
  • ISO 27001
  • SOC 2

Deployment & Operations

  • GitOps and ArgoCD
  • Feature flag management
  • ITIL or other IT service management practices

Professional Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure: AZ-104, AZ-400 or AZ-500
  • Kubernetes: CKA or CKS

How You Work

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive engineering mindset.

You:

  • Think about reliability first. You design systems to prevent problems rather than simply reacting to them.
  • Automate whenever possible. You recognise repetitive tasks as opportunities for improvement.
  • Take ownership. You investigate problems thoroughly and follow them through to resolution.
  • Care about security. You understand that protecting infrastructure and customer data is everyone's responsibility.
  • Communicate clearly. You can explain complex technical issues to engineers and other stakeholders.
  • Keep learning. You stay informed about emerging cloud technologies, tools and engineering practices.
  • Work collaboratively. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping your team succeed.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Work on infrastructure that matters

Support cloud platforms powering enterprise applications used by customers around the world.

Solve meaningful engineering challenges

Work across reliability, security, automation and cloud infrastructure rather than focusing on a single narrow area.

Make a measurable impact

Your improvements will directly influence system availability, deployment efficiency, security and the developer experience.

Collaborate internationally

Work alongside experienced engineering professionals across multiple continents.

Build for the long term

Help create reliable, secure and maintainable infrastructure that supports the continued evolution of enterprise SaaS products.

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

If you're an experienced DevOps Engineer who enjoys working with Azure, Kubernetes and modern automation technologies, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now and help engineer the infrastructure behind tomorrow's enterprise software.

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
